packs.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire
ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

cards.name: Iârion's Pendant
cards.rulesText: Attached character gets +1 [willpower]. Response: Add Iârion’s Pendant to the victory display to cancel the ‘when revealed’ effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck, or to cancel a shadow effect just triggered.
cards.flavor:
“That is just what the Rangers are: the last remnant in the North of the great people.”
—Gandalf, The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Protect the Innocent
cards.rulesText: Side A Forced: After an attack damages a character, place 1 damage on Protect the Innocent. When progress would be placed on Protect the Innocent, remove that much damage from it instead. If Protect the Innocent has 10 or more damage on it (20 or more damage if there are 3 or 4 players in the game), the players lose the game. Side B Setup: Add Arnor Ravaged to the staging area with damage on it equal to the amount of damage marked for it in the Campaign Log. Forced: After an attack damages a character but does not destroy it, move 1 damage from Arnor Ravaged to that character.

cards.name: Mysterious Omens
cards.rulesText: Surge. Forced: After Mysterious Omens becomes the current quest, each player discards 1 random card from their hand. Forced: When Mysterious Omens is defeated, remove it from the Campaign Pool. Then, each player may choose 1 of the following boons and attach it to a hero they control: Cunning, Hardy, Resolute, Ruthless, or Stalwart.

cards.name: Cunning
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Add 2 resources to that hero’s resource pool. Action: Attached hero gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Hardy
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 hit points. Action: Ready attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Resolute
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: Cancel up to 2 points of damage just dealt to attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Ruthless
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Action: Move any amount of damage from attached hero to an enemy engaged with you. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Stalwart
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense]. Planning Action: Play an attachment from your discard pile on attached hero. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Amarthiúl's Courage
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to Amarthiúl. Otherwise, remove Amarthiúl’s Courage from the game. Amarthiúl gets +1 [willpower] and +1 hit point. Action: Ready Amarthiúl. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Thaurdir's Legacy
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game. Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir’s Legacy to the hero with the most resources. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: “Attached hero gets –2 [willpower] and is treated as if its printed text box were blank.”)

cards.name: Thaurdir's Majesty
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game. Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir’s Majesty to the hero with the most non-objective attachments. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: “Attached hero gets –2 [attack] and cannot commit to the quest.”)

cards.name: Thaurdir's Spite
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to Thaurdir (even if he is out of play). Otherwise, remove this card from the game. Forced: After a Sorcery treachery is revealed, move Thaurdir’s Spite to the hero with the most damage. (Counts as a Sorcery attachment with the text: “Attached hero gets –2 [defense] and cannot be healed.”)

cards.name: Determination
cards.rulesText: Action: Attach Determination to a unique character. Then, ready each character with a copy of Determination attached, as well as each character who is “determined” in the Campaign Log. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Forced: If you win this scenario, mark in the Campaign Log that attached character is ‘determined.’”)

cards.name: Fend off Despair
cards.rulesText: Each event card gains doomed 1. Forced: When Fend Off Despair is defeated, mark in the Campaign Log that each player’s starting threat is reduced by 2. (This reduction is cumulative.)
cards.flavor: The loss of Iârion at the hands of the wraith weighs upon you and your companions, sapping your resolve and making you question every decision you make in your pursuit. Yet if you give in, there will surely be no rescue for him from the foul sorcery of Angmar...

cards.name: Loot the Dungeons
cards.rulesText: Loot the Dungeons is considered to be in each player’s staging area and gets +4 quest points for each player in the game at every staging area. Forced: When Loot the Dungeons is defeated, each player (at every staging area) may choose one of the following boons and add it to their hand: Berelind, Chieftain’s Brooch, Coruhaer, Laermuin, Mail of Eärnur, or Silverthorn. Add the chosen cards to the Campaign Pool.

cards.name: Berelind
cards.rulesText: Response: After Berelind attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress on a quest card in play.
cards.flavor:
A light fell about her, and her hair shone in the sunrise.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Chieftain's Brooch
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Each ally that shares a Trait with attached hero gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
When the kingdom ended the Dúnedain passed into the shadows and became a secret and wandering people, and their deeds and labours were seldom sung or recorded.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Coruhaer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Coruhaer defends an attack, spend 1 resource to deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor:
A dread fell on them, even as they passed between the lines of ancient stones.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Laermuin
cards.rulesText: Response: After Laermuin commits to a quest, heal 1 damage from a character.
cards.flavor:
Ancient of days he seemed and yet in the flower of manhood; and wisdom sat upon his brow.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Mail of Eärnur
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 hit points. Response: After a player’s threat is reduced, heal 1 damage from attached hero.
cards.flavor:
So ended the evil realm of Angmar; and so Eärnur, Captain of Gondor, earned the chief hatred of the Witch-King.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Silverthorn
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. While attacking or defending against an enemy, attached hero gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] if that enemy shares a Trait with an enemy in the victory display. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, add that enemy to the victory display. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Losing Time
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: Each player must either raise their threat by 3 or exhaust a hero they control. Shadow: Attacking enemy either gets +3 [attack] or +3 [defense] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Daechanar's Brand
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead when attacking an Undead enemy). Response: After you play Daechnar’s Brand, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a Sorcery treachery and add it to the victory display. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Heirloom of Iârchon
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you play Heirloom of Iârchon, heal all damage from attached character.
cards.flavor:
“Iârchon, may this pendant guide you away from the shadow that dwells within us all.”
—Pendant Inscription

cards.name: Orders from Angmar
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead while defending against an Undead enemy). Response: After you play Orders from Angmar, discard a non-unique Undead enemy with 2 or less remaining hit points.

cards.name: Elrond's Champion
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy engages you, ready Elrond’s Champion.
cards.flavor:
"That is a chapter of ancient history which it might be good to recall; for there was sorrow then too, and gathering dark, but great valour, and great deeds that were not wholly vain."
—Gandalf, The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Lore of Ancient Arnor
cards.rulesText: Action: Each player returns 1 card from their discard pile to their hand (2 cards instead if you are the only player in the game) and shuffles the rest of their discard pile back into their deck. Then, remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Raiment of the Second Age
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack] and +2 hit points. Response: After attached character attacks and destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand."
—Elrond, The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: Rivendell Skirmishers
cards.rulesText: Response: After Rivendell Skirmishers exhausts to defend an attack from non-unique enemy, discard each shadow card from that enemy.
cards.flavor:
It was said that Angmar was for a time subdued by the Elvenfolk coming from Lindon and from Rivendell.
—The Lord of the Rings

cards.name: (MotK) Lily Cotton
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Lily Cotton to ready a different Hobbit ally and add Lily Cotton’s [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to that ally’s [willpower], [attack], and [defense] respectively until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to its owner’s hand. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
There is little or no magic about them, except the ordinary everyday sort which helps them disappear quietly and quickly…
—The Hobbit

cards.name: (MotK) Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bilbo Baggins commits to the quest, look at the top card of your deck. If that card has flavor text, you may (choose 1): leave it there, discard it, or spend 1 [lore] resource to add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: There he wandered long in a dream of music that turned into running water, and then suddenly into a voice. It seemed to be the voice of Bilbo chanting verses. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Morwen Steelsheen
cards.rulesText: Action: Put Morwen Steelsheen into play from your hand. Then, discard a Rohan or Gondor ally you control. Response: After a Rohan or Gondor ally leaves play, exhaust Morwen Steelsheen to either heal 2 damage from a character or reduce your threat by 1.

cards.name: (MotK) Young Tom
cards.rulesText: During the round that Young Tom enters play, enemies get +5 engagement cost.
cards.flavor: “Not all is well there,” said Frodo, “but certainly gardeners are honoured.” —The Two Towers

cards.name: (MotK) Gavin
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Response: After an encounter card without surge is revealed, exhaust Gavin to give that card surge and add 1 resource to the pool of a Scout hero you control. If the next encounter card revealed is not a location, discard it without resolving its effects.

cards.name: (MotK) Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Frodo Baggins to return a card from your discard pile to your hand. (Limit once per game.) If Frodo Baggins is destroyed, or if he is discarded from play by a card effect, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor:
“I wish it need not have happened in my time.”
—The Fellowship of the Ring

printings.name: ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

cards.name: (MotK) Théodwyn
cards.rulesText: Response: After Théodwyn enters play, either draw 1 card or add 1 resource to a Noble hero’s resource pool.
cards.flavor:
“She is fearless and high-hearted. All love her. Let her be as lord to Eorlingas while we are gone.”
—Háma, The Two Towers

cards.name: (MotK) King of the Dead
cards.rulesText: Cannot enter play unless Fulfil Your Oath is in the victory display. Oathbreaker characters get +2 [attack] while attacking an enemy with a Fear attachment.
cards.flavor: Ever there rose the same cry in the gathering night: ‘The King of the Dead! The King of the Dead is come upon us!’ —The Return of the King

cards.name: (MotK) Edrik Ravenhelm
cards.rulesText: Action: Trigger doomed 1 to give X Isengard characters +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. X is the tens digit of your threat. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: “Why don’t we get together and charge through?” —The Two Towers

cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Grip enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.

cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Fang enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: (MotK) Wolf
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Wolf enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: …most ferocious of the three… —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Bob
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bob enters play, search your deck for a Mount or Pony card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
“A poor old half-starved creature it is, but he won’t part with it for less than thrice its worth.”
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Drû-buri-Drû
cards.rulesText: Response: At the end of any phase, exhaust Drû-buri-Drû to move a [lore] card attached to an encounter card to another eligible encounter card.
cards.flavor: “Remnants of an older time they be, living few and secretly, wild and wary as the beasts.” —Elfhelm, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

printings.name: ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

cards.name: (MotK) Balin
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: After a card is discarded from the top of your deck, ready Balin. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: The others made no pretense of offering – except old Balin. —The Hobbit
cards.packName: ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

printings.name: ALeP - Messenger of the King Allies

cards.name: (MotK) Birna
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Birna and spend 1 [tactics] resource to put a Beorning ally from your discard pile into play. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play or in your discard pile, shuffle it into your deck.
cards.flavor: In that last hour Beorn himself had appeared - no one knew how or from where. —The Hobbit

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Immune to non-Master card effects. Setup: Attach to a hero you control and search your deck for a Master card. Add it to your hand and shuffle your deck. Your threat elimination level is reduced by 5. If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Frodo Baggins commits to the quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready another unique character committed to the quest. If you quest successfully this phase, reduce your threat by 1.
cards.flavor:
"Keep your tempers and hold your hands to the last possible moment!"
-The Return of the King

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Merry
cards.rulesText: Response: After Merry enters play, each unique ally you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"Shire-folk have been so comfortable so long they don"t know what to do. They just want a match, though, and they"ll go up in fire."
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Pippin
cards.rulesText: Pippin gets +2 [attack] while attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, ready Pippin.
cards.flavor:
"Down on your knees in the road and ask pardon, or I will set this troll"s bane in you!"
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Faramir
cards.rulesText: Response: After Faramir enters play, choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Engage that enemy and deal 2 damage to it (4 damage instead if it has an attachment on it).
cards.flavor:
"There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full."
-The Two Towers

cards.name: Derufin
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Ranged. Response: After Derufin participates in an attack which destroys an enemy engaged with a player, discard Derufin to reduce the engaged player's threat by X, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].

cards.name: The Gathering Storm
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy. Add that enemy to the staging area to reduce the cost of the first ally you play this phase by X, where X is that enemy's [threat]. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Put Off Pursuit
cards.rulesText: Attach to the active location. Limit 1 per location. Attached location gets +2 quest points. Response: After attached location is explored, discard cards from the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Add that location to the staging area to choose an non-unique enemy in the staging area and shuffle it into the encounter deck.

cards.name: The Master Ring
cards.rulesText: Response: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to cancel the effects of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck and discard that card. Then, reveal an encounter card.
cards.flavor:
"If I, wearing it, were to command you, you would obey, even if it were to leap from a precipice or to cast yourself into the fire."
-Frodo, The Two Towers

cards.name: The Ruling Ring
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to choose a non-Nazgul enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the phase, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor:
"He vanished. I have never seen such a thing happen before..."
-Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Ring of Power
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to ready the hero with The One Ring Attached. That hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"And behold! in our need chance brings to light the Ring of Power."
-Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Stinker
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: Gollum makes an immediate attack. If no attack was made this way, discard all tokens from Sméagol and flip him to Gollum. Shadow: Raise your threat by 2 (by 4 instead if Gollum is engaged with you). Shuffle Stinker back into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Sméagol
cards.rulesText: Side A Cannot have attachments. Setup: Shuffle 2 copies of Stinker into the encounter deck. Response: After you travel to a location, raise your threat by 1 to draw 1 card. Side B Immune to non-Gollum card effects. Gollum engages the first player. Forced: When Gollum is defeated, flip him to Sméagol and return him to his owner's control, exhausted.

cards.name: Fellowship
cards.rulesText: Side A You cannot play non-unique allies or put non-unique allies into play. Forced: When you control exactly 9 unique characters, flip this card over. Side B You cannot play allies or put allies into play. Each character you control gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Forced: After a character you control leaves play, flip this card over.
cards.flavor:
"I will choose you companions to go with you, as far as they will or fortune allows. The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy."
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring
"The company of the Ring shall be Nine; and the Nine Walkers shall be set against the Nine Riders that are evil."
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Faramir
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
Faramir gets +1 [attack] for each enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: "The road may pass, but they shall not! Not while Faramir is Captain." <cite>Mablung, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Sword of Morthond
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor ally. Attached ally gains the Outlands trait.
cards.flavor:
The Morthond Valye made a great bay that beat up against the sheer southern faces of the mountains.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Men of the West
cards.rulesText: Action: Return X Outlands allies from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
Death in the morning and at day's ending
lords took and lowly. Long now they sleep
under grass in Gondor by the Great River.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Knight of Minas Tirith
cards.rulesText: If each of your heroes has a printed [tactics] hero resource icon, Knight of Minas Tirith Tirith gains: "Response: After Knight of Minas Tirith enters play, choose an enemy in the staging area. Engage that enemy and exhaust Knight of Minas Tirith to declare it as attacker (and resolve its attack) against that enemy."

cards.name: Gondorian Fire
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor or Dúnedain hero. Action: Spend 1 resource from attached hero's resource pool to give attached hero +1 [attack] for each resource in its resource pool until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Pelargir Shipwright
cards.rulesText: Pelargir Shipwright gets +1 [willpower] for each hero you control with a printed [spirit] hero resource icon.
cards.flavor:
"It is forty leagues and two from Pelargir to the landings at the Harlond..."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Map of Earnil
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [spirit] hero. Reduce the cost to play Map of Earnil by 1 for each hero you control with a printed [spirit] resource icon. Action: Discard Map of Earnil to play any [spirit] event card in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Then, place that event on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Ranger Bow
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Ranger character. Action: Exhaust Ranger Bow and attached character to deal 1 damage to an enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
Two had great bows, almost of their own height, and great quivers of long green-feathered arrows.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Forest Patrol
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control at least 1 Ranger character. Action: Deal 3 damage to an enemy with at least 1 Trap card attached to it.
cards.flavor: "For coming unbidden to this play death is our law." <cite>Anborn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Palantir
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noble hero. Planning Action: Exhaust Palantir and attached hero to name a card type and look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. For each of those cards that matches the named type, draw a card. For each of those cards that does not match the named type, raise your threat by 2.

cards.name: Dori
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After another hero is declared as a defender, exhaust Dori to add his [defense] to the defending hero's [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor:
Dori was really a decent fellow in spite of his grumbling.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Ranger Provisions
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player adds 1 resource to each of his heroes' resource pools.
cards.flavor:
"Rangers have been here lately. It is they who left the firewood behind."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Message
cards.rulesText: Action: Search your deck for a side quest and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
"I called for the help of the Dúnedain, and their watch has doubled..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Longbeard Sentry
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard 2 cards from the top of your deck to give Longbeard Sentry sentinel and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"...many of them have had experience in the dreadful dwarf and goblin wars, of which you have no doubt heard."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Delay the Enemy
cards.rulesText: Battle. Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, each player may choose and discard a non-unique enemy engaged with him.

cards.name: Steed of Imladris
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [spirit] or Noldor hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to place 2 progress on the active location.
cards.flavor:
In the dusk its headstall flickered and flashed, as if it were studded with gems like living stars.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Fair and Perilous
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Noldor or Silvan character. Until the end of the phase, add that character's [willpower] to its [attack].
cards.flavor:
"...you saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the Firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Wellinghall Preserver
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Wellinghall Preserver readies, heal 1 damage from an Ent character.

cards.name: None Return
cards.rulesText: Limit 3 copies of None Return in the victory display. Response: After a non-unique enemy is destroyed, add None Return to the victory display to add that enemy to the victory display.
cards.flavor:
"None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lórien."
<cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hope Rekindled
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce the cost of the next event that has a Valour trigger you play this phase by 2. Valour Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for an event that has a Valour trigger and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
Hope he rekindled, and in hope ended;
over death, over dread, over doom lifted
out of loss, out of life, unto long glory.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gilraen
cards.rulesText: Setup: You may choose to give Gilraen –2 [willpower] and up to 2 other Dúnedain heroes +2 [willpower] until the end of the game. Action: Turn a shadow card dealt to an enemy faceup. Then, you may deal that enemy 1 additional faceup shadow card to draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
“I gave Hope to the Dúnedain, I have kept no hope for myself.”
—The Return of the King

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Aragorn gains a resource icon matching each Title attachment attached to him. Setup: Search your collection for a Title attachment with a printed cost of 1 and attach it to Aragorn. Action: Ready a Title attachment with a printed cost of 1 attached to Aragorn. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: A Fair Exchange
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard a unique card from your hand that shares a title with a card in play to search your deck for a different unique card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: “There is nothing like looking, if you want to find something…” —Thorin Oakenshield, The Hobbit

cards.name: Elessar
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noble hero or Aragorn. Attached character gains the Gondor trait. If attached character is Aragorn, he gains the Noble trait. Action: Exhaust Elessar to choose an ally that is defending an attack and shares a Trait with the attached character. Either ready that ally or give it +1 [defense] for that attack.
cards.flavor:
“Say not The Lords of Gondor. Say The King Elessar.”
—Prince Imrahil, The Return of the King

cards.name: The Renewer
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor hero or Aragorn. Attached character gains the Healer trait. Action: Exhaust The Renewer to choose a questing ally that shares a Trait with the attached character. Either ready that ally and heal 1 damage from it or give it +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
“The hands of the king are the hands of a healer.”
—Ioreth, The Return of the King

cards.name: Elendilmir
cards.rulesText: Guarded (location). Attach to a hero. Replace each instance of “once per phase” or “once per round” in the attached character’s text box with “twice per phase” or “twice per round” respectively. Action: Exhaust Aragorn to discard the location guarding Elendilmir. Then, attach Elendilmir to Aragorn.

cards.name: Estel
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain hero or Aragorn. Attached character gains the Noldor trait. Action: Exhaust Estel and discard 1 card from your hand to search the top X cards of your deck for 1 card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. X is the number of Traits on the attached character.

cards.name: Chieftain of the North
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Ranger hero or Aragorn. Attached character gains the Warrior trait. Action: Exhaust Chieftain of the North to choose an attacking ally that shares a Trait with the attached character. Either ready that ally or give it +1 [attack] for that attack.
cards.flavor: “Here is Aragorn son of Arathorn, chieftain of the Dúnedain…” —Faramir, The Return of the King

cards.name: Grey Companion
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: When you play Grey Companion from your hand, exhaust X Title attachments you control to reduce its cost by X.
cards.flavor: “But I did not summon you,” said Aragorn, “save only in wish.” —The Return of the King

cards.name: Andúril
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero with 4 or more Traits. Restricted. If attached hero is Aragorn, he gains a [leadership] resource icon. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Action: Exhaust Andúril to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: “You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought.” —Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Amarthiúl
cards.rulesText:
While you are engaged with at least 1 enemy, Amarthiúl gains the [tactics] resource icon.
While you are engaged with at least 2 enemies, add 1 additional resource to Amarthiúl's resource pool when you collect resources during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"The heirs of Elendil do not forget all things past..."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Guardian of Arnor
cards.rulesText:
Sentinel.
Guardian of Arnor gets +1 [defense] for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
"Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen give us scornful names."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Doom Hangs Still
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Until the end of the round, players do not raise their threat from questing unsuccessfully. Valour Planning Action: Raise each player's threat by 2 to skip the quest phase this round.
cards.flavor:
"Dooms hangs still on a thread. Yet hope there is still, if we can stand but unconquered for a little while."
<cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Beechbone
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Beechbone is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to him to deal X damage to the defending enemy. X is the amount of damage on Beechbone.

cards.name: Hold Your Ground!
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose and ready a sentinel character. Valour Action: Ready all sentinel characters.
cards.flavor:
Aragorn and Boromir did not heed the command, but still held their ground, side by side, behind Gandalf at the far end of the bridge.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lindir
cards.rulesText: Response: After Lindir enters play, if you have less than 3 cards in your hand, draw until you have 3 cards in your hand.
cards.flavor:
"To sheep other sheep no doubt appear different," laughed Lindir. "Or to shepherds. But Mortals have not been our study. We have other business."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lords of the Eldar
cards.rulesText: Lords of the Eldar can only be played from your discard pile. Action: Place Lords of the Eldar on the bottom of your deck from your discard pile. Then, until the end of the round all Noldor characters get +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].

cards.name: The Long Defeat
cards.rulesText: Attach to a quest card in play. Limit 1 per quest. Response: After attached quest card is defeated, each player either draws 2 cards or heals up to 5 damage from among characters he controls.
cards.flavor:
"...for ere the fall of Nargothrond or Gondolin I passed over the mountains, and together through ages of the world we have fought the long defeat."
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Quick Ears
cards.rulesText: Response: Exhaust a Dúnedain or Ranger hero to cancel an enemy card just revealed from the encounter deck. Then, shuffle it back into the encounter deck and reveal an additional encounter card.
cards.flavor:
"... though I cannot disappear, I have hunted many wild and wary things and I can usually avoid being seen, if I wish."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Favor of the Valar
cards.rulesText: Attach to a player's threat dial. Limit 1 per player. Forced: When you would be eliminated by reaching your threat elimination level, instead discard Favor of the Valar and reduce your threat to 5 less than your threat elimination level. You are not eliminated.
cards.flavor:
"...their hearts were lifted up in such a hope as they had not known since the darkness came out of the East..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Caldara
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Caldara to put 1 [spirit] ally from your discard pile into play for each other hero you control with a printed [spirit] resource icon. (Limit once per game.)
cards.flavor:
...there is no purpose higher in the world as it now stands than the good of Gondor...
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Squire of the Citadel
cards.rulesText: Response: After Squire of the Citadel leaves play, add 1 resource to a Gondor hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
As he spoke he struck a small silver gong that stood near his footstool, and at once servants came forward.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Tome of Atanatar
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] hero. Reduce the cost to play Tome of Atanatar by 1 for each hero you control with a printed [leadership] resource icon. Action: Discard Tome of Atanatar to play any [leadership] event card in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Then, place that event on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Guthlaf
cards.rulesText: If there is at least 1 Rohan hero in play, lower the cost to play Guthlaf by 1. If there is at least 1 Gondor hero in play, Guthlaf gains sentinel.

cards.name: The Hammer-stroke
cards.rulesText: Encounter Action: Engage each enemy in play.
cards.flavor:
..we have this honour: ever we bear the brunt of the chief hatred of the Dark Lord, for that hatred comes down out of the of the depths of time and over the deeps of the Sea.
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Emery
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard the top 3 card of your deck to put Emery into play from your hand, under any player's control. Then, if any of the discarded cards have the [tactics], [lore] or [leadership] sphere, discard Emery.

cards.name: Children of the Sea
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Silvan or Noldor ally you control. That ally gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, shuffle that ally into its owner's deck if it is still in play.
cards.flavor:
"For deep in the hears of all my kindred lies the sea-longing, which it is perilous to stir"
<cite>Legolas, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Anborn
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Anborn to return 1 Trap card from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
"I sent my keenest huntsmen to seek him, but he slipped them, and they had no sight of him till now, save Anborn."
<cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Poisoned Stakes
cards.rulesText:
Play Poisoned Stakes into the staging area unattached.
If unattached, attach Poisoned Stakes to the next eligble enemy that enters the staging area.
At the end of each round, deal 2 damage to attached enemy.

cards.name: Well-Equipped
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck. You may attach 1 attachment card discarded by this effect to an eligible Dwarf character in play.
cards.flavor:
Gimli the Dwarf alone wore openly a short shirt of steel-rings, for dwarves make light of burdens...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hirgon
cards.rulesText: Response: After Hirgon quests successfully, play a [tactics] ally from your hand, reducing its cost by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Then, you may raise your threat by 1 to give that ally +1 [attack] and +1 [defense]  until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "Hirgon I am, errand-rider of Denethor, who bring you this token of war." -The Return of the King

cards.name: Haradrim Spear
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Haradrim character. Attached character gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, it gets +3 [attack] for this attack. After this attack resolves, discard Haradrim Spear.

cards.name: Hunting Party
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Warrior trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After the players have committed characters to the quest, discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Then, reveal an encounter card.

cards.name: The Red Arrow
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a Gondor hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Valour Response: After attached hero quests successfully, add The Red Arrow to the victory display to search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally and put it into play.
cards.flavor: "The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years!" -Théoden, The Return of the King

cards.name: Keep Watch
cards.rulesText:
Limit 1 copy of Keep Watch in the victory display.
While Keep Watch is in the victory display, each non-unique enemy engaged with a player gets -1 [attack].
cards.flavor: "I called for the help of the Dúnedain, and their watch was doubled..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Rider of Rohan
cards.rulesText: While a side quest is in the victory display, Rider of Rohan does not exaust to quest.
cards.flavor: "Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?" said the Rider, using the Common Speech of the West… -The Two Towers

cards.name: Fireside Song
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] for each Song attached to it.
cards.flavor:
"I sit beside the fire and think
of how the world will be
when winter comes without a spring
that I shall ever see." -Bilbo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Dunedain Lookout
cards.rulesText: Response: Discard Dúnedain Lookout to cancel the 'When Revealed' effects of an enemy just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: "Travellers scowl at us, and countrymen gives us scornful names." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Doughty Ranger
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Ranger trait. Response: After you play Doughty Ranger from your hand, draw a card.
cards.flavor: ...he went forth clad only in rusty green and brown, as a Ranger of the wilderness. -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Free Peoples
cards.rulesText: Play only if the characters you control have a total of at least 9 different Traits between them. Action: Ready each character in play. Until the end of the phase, each character you control gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: "For the rest, they shall represent the other Free Peoples of the World: Elves, Dwarves and Men." -Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Galadriel
cards.rulesText: Galadriel cannot quest, attack, or defend. Allies you control do not exhaust to commit to the quest during the round they enter play. Action: Exhaust Galadriel to choose a player. That player reduces his threat by 1 and draws 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Heir of Mardil
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noble hero. Response: After attached hero gains any number of resources from a card effect, exhaust Heir of Mardil to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
"...in my turn I bore it, and so did each eldest son of our house, far back into the vanished years before the failing of the kings..."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Orophin
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Orophin enters play, return a Silvan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Orophin has now gone in haste back to our dwellings to warn our people." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Henneth Annûn Guard
cards.rulesText: You may give Henneth Annûn Guard doomed 1 when you play it from your hand. If you do, it gains: "Response: After you play Henneth Annûn Guard, choose a character. Until the end of the round, that character gets +2 [defense] and gains sentinel."
cards.flavor: "Does he think that men sleep without watch all night?" <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Charge of the Rohirrim
cards.rulesText: Action: Until the end of the phase, each Rohan character with a Mount attachment gets +3 [attack].
cards.flavor: "Arise, arise, riders of Théoden!" <cite>Théoden, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Galadriel's Handmaiden
cards.rulesText: Response: After Galadriel's Handmaiden enters play, choose a player. That player reduces his threat by 1.
cards.flavor: Her maidens stood silent about her, and a while she looked upon her guests. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Mirror of Galadriel
cards.rulesText: Attach to Galadriel. Action: Exhaust Mirror of Galadriel to search the top 10 cards of your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the rest back into your deck. Then, discard a random card from your hand.
cards.flavor:
"What you will see, if you leave the Mirror free to work, I cannot tell. For it shows things that were, things that are, things that yet may be."
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Wandering Ent
cards.rulesText:
Cannot have restricted attachments.
Enters play exhausted.
cards.flavor: There were songs about the hunt of the Ents for the Entwives sung among Elves and Men from Mirkwood to Gondor. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Cloak of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if the active location has the Forest trait).
cards.flavor: It was hard to say what colour they were: grey with the hue of twilight under the trees they seemed to be; and yet if they were moved, or set in another light, they were green as shadowed leaves... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Nenya
cards.rulesText: Attach to Galadriel. She gains a [lore] resource icon. Quest Action: Exhaust Nenya and Galadriel to add her [willpower] to another character's [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "The is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper." <cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Frodo Baggins is damaged, cancel the damage and instead raise your threat by the amount of damage he would have been dealt. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: Frodo began to feel restless, and the old paths seemed too well-trodden. he looked at maps and wondered what lay beyond their edges... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Warning
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains +1 [defense] Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Warning to another hero.

cards.name: Second Breakfast
cards.rulesText: Action: Each player returns the topmost attachment card from his discard pile to his hand.
cards.flavor:
...he was just sitting down to a nice little second-breakfast in the dinning-room...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Beorning Beekeeper
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Beorning Beekeeper from play to deal 1 damage to each enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: "We are getting near," said Gandalf. "We are on th eedge of his bee pastures." <cite> The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Born Aloft
cards.rulesText: Attach to an ally. Action: Discard Born Aloft from play to return attached ally to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: "Very well," said Gandalf. "Take us where and as far as you will!" <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Éomund
cards.rulesText: Response: After Éomund leaves play, ready all Rohan characters in play.
cards.flavor: "You I have not seen before, for you are young, but I have spoken with Eomund your father..." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Nor am I a Stranger
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Rohan trait.
cards.flavor: "Nor indeed am I a stranger: for I have been in this land before, more than once, and ridden with the host of the Rohirrim, though under other name and in other guise." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Longbeard Map-Maker
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to give Longbeard Map-Maker +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: On the table in the light of a big lamp with a red shade he spread a piece of parchment rather like a map. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: A Burning Brand
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] character. Restricted. Response: Exhaust A Burning Brand to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached character is defending.
cards.flavor:
"Keep close to the fire, with your faces outward!" cried Strider. "Keep some of th elonger sticks ready in your hands."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Song of Wisdom
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [lore] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
It sit beside the fire and think
of all that I have seen,
of meadow-flowers and butterflies
in summers that have been
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Prince Imrahil
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Spend 1 resource from Prince Imrahil's resource pool to search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally who shares at least 1 Trait with him, and put that ally into play. Shuffle your deck. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, shuffle it into your deck. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Knight of the White Tower
cards.rulesText: Knight of the White Tower's resource cost must be paid from a single hero’s resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"...to be only a man of arms of the Guard of the Tower of Gondor is held worthy in the City, and such men have honour in the land." 
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.rulesText: Response: When an enemy attacks a player, that player may declare up to 3 eligible characters as defenders against this attack. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [tactics] resources to ready each defending character that takes no damage from this attack.

cards.name: Soldier of Dol Amroth
cards.rulesText: Response: After Soldier of Dol Amroth enters play, reduce the cost of the next [tactics] card you play this phase by 1.
cards.flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Súlien
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to exhaust Súlien. Then, each location in the staging area gets –1 [threat] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a hero you control. Each hero with lower threat cost than the chosen hero gets +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [leadership] resources to give +2 [attack] to each hero with lower threat cost than the chosen hero until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Guardian of Ithilien
cards.rulesText: Response: After Guardian of Ithilien enters play, return an enemy engaged with you to the staging area.
cards.flavor:
From such men the Lord Denethor chose his forayers…to harry the Orcs and other enemies that roamed between the Ephel Dúath and the River.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ranger Spear
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Ranger character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead when attacking an enemy with an attachment on it).
cards.flavor:
Two had spears in their hands with broad bright heads.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Prince of Dol Amroth
cards.rulesText: Attach to Prince Imrahil. Price Imrahil gains the Outlands trait. While you control Outlands allies that belong to 4 different spheres, add 1 additional resource to Prince Imrahil's resource pool when you collect resources during the resource phase (if Prince Imrahil is a hero).

cards.name: Ingold
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Gondor or Warrior ally enters play under your control, draw 1 card. Then, either spend 1 resource from Ingold’s pool or raise your threat by 1. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: “We wish for no strangers in the land at this time, unless they be mighty men of arms in whose faith and help we can trust.” —The Return of the King

cards.name: Celador
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Reduce the total [threat] in the staging area by 1 for each unattached Trap you control. Response: After a Trap card you control is attached to an enemy, either ready Celador or reduce your threat by 1.
cards.flavor:
“Wise man trusts not to chance-meeting on the road in this land.”
—Faramir, The Two Towers

cards.name: Thengel
cards.rulesText: Response: After an ally is discarded from play, that ally’s owner searches the top 5 cards of their deck for an ally that shares a Trait with the discarded ally, puts it into play exhausted, and shuffles their deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: “My friend,” said Gandalf, “you had horses, and deeds of arms, and the free fields.” —The Return of the King

cards.name: Herubrand
cards.rulesText: Herubrand gets +1 [willpower] for each hero you control with at least 1 restricted attachment. Response: After an enemy in the staging area is destroyed, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
“What burden do you bear, Men of Rohan?”
—Imrahil, The Return of the King

cards.name: Deeping Bowman
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Ranged. Action: Discard Deeping Bowman to choose an enemy. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not count its [defense] while determining combat damage.
cards.flavor: “We loosed every arrow that we had, and filled the Dike with Orcs.” —The Two Towers

cards.name: Open the Gates
cards.rulesText: Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for an ally that shares a Trait with each of your heroes and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. At the end of the phase, if that ally did not leave play, add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: It seemed that word of their coming had gone before them; and at once they were admitted, silently, and without question. —The Return of the King

cards.name: Wealth of Adventure
cards.rulesText: Action: Search your deck for a card with the Skill trait and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
“It’s a dangerous business, Frodo, going out of your door,” he used to say. “You step into the Road, and if you don’t keep your feet, there is no knowing where you might be swept off to.”
—Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Feast of Plenty
cards.rulesText: Feast of Plenty’s resource cost must be paid from a single hero’s resource pool. Action: Ready up to 3 heroes and add 1 resource to each of their resource pools. Only 1 copy of Feast of Plenty can be played by the players each round.
cards.flavor: The feast was merry and the food all that his hunger could desire. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Deeping Defender
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: After Deeping Defender defends an attack, return the attacking enemy to the staging area and deal 1 damage to it.
cards.flavor: The sunset gilded their spears and helmets, and glinted in their pale flowing hair. —The Two Towers

cards.name: Morwen Steelsheen
cards.rulesText: Action: Put Morwen Steelsheen into play from your hand. Then, discard a Rohan or Gondor ally you control. Response: After a Rohan or Gondor ally leaves play, exhaust Morwen Steelsheen to either heal 2 damage from a character or reduce your threat by 1.

cards.name: It Should Be Spared
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Trap card you control attaches to an enemy, return it to your hand. Then, play it from your hand for no cost.
cards.flavor:
“But I do not slay man or beast needlessly, and not gladly even when it is needed.”
—Faramir, The Two Towers

cards.name: Spring the Trap
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Trap card you control attaches to an enemy, put a Ranger ally into play from your hand.
cards.flavor: “The road may pass, but they shall not! Not while Faramir is Captain.” —Mablung, The Two Towers

cards.name: Squire of the Mark
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Rohan ally you control is discarded from play, add Squire of the Mark to the victory display to put that ally into play exhausted.
cards.flavor: “Little service can I offer to your lord, but what I can do, I would do.” —Pippin, The Return of the King

cards.name: Rammas Lookout
cards.rulesText:
Devoted.
While each hero you control has at least 1 resource in its resource pool, Rammas Lookout gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
“Whatever betide, you have come to the end of the Gondor that you have known. Let me pass!”
—Gandalf, The Return of the King

cards.name: Théodwyn
cards.rulesText: Response: After Théodwyn enters play, either draw 1 card or add 1 resource to a Noble hero’s resource pool.
cards.flavor:
“She is fearless and high-hearted. All love her. Let her be as lord to Eorlingas while we are gone.”
—Háma, The Two Towers

cards.name: Light-footed Steed
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After a character you control leaves play, exhaust Light-footed Steed to ready attached hero. Then, if the character that left play was unique, attached hero gets +1 [attack] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: “…and don’t forget their horses! They can see the night-breeze, or so it’s said.” —Ugluk, The Two Towers

cards.name: Rammas Sentry
cards.rulesText: Devoted. While each hero you control has at least 1 resource in its resource pool, Rammas Sentry gains: “Response: Cancel 1 point of damage just dealt to a Gondor character. (Limit once per phase.)”
cards.flavor:
“For if we fall, who shall stand?”
—Beregond, The Return of the King

cards.name: Live Bait
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control an unattached Trap attachment. Action: Choose a non-unique enemy in play. Until the end of the round, treat the chosen enemy’s printed text box as if it were blank (except for Traits). Then, attach an unattached Trap attachment you control to that enemy.

cards.name: Worthy of Remembrance
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Discard a Rohan ally you control to choose an enemy. Deal 2 damage to that enemy (4 damage instead if the ally was unique).
cards.flavor:
Then the heart of Éowyn changed… suddenly her winter passed, and the sun shone on her.
—The Return of the King

cards.name: Need Brooks No Delay
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Need Brooks No Delay by 1 for each Rohan hero you control. Planning Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for a card with printed cost 2 or less (3 or less if it is unique) and set it aside. Shuffle your deck. Then, play the set aside card for no cost as if it were in your hand.

cards.name: The Last Alliance
cards.rulesText: Side A Choose two traits, A and B. Each of your starting heroes and each ally in your deck must have either the printed A or B trait, but cannot have both. You must have at least 1 starting hero and 10 allies in your deck with each trait. Setup: Flip this card over. Side B While you control more A characters than B characters, reduce the cost of the first B ally you play this round by 1, and vice versa. Action: Exhaust The Last Alliance to choose a card in your hand or a card in play under your control. Replace each printed instance of “A” or “B” in that card’s ability text with “A or B” until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
“The strength of the Elves to resist him was greater long ago; and not all Men were estranged from them.”
—Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Quickbeam
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 2 damage to Quickbeam to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "...he can move like a wind when he is roused." -Pippin, The Two Towers

cards.name: Halfast Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Halfast Gamgee by 1 for each side quest in the victory display. Response: After Halfast Gamgee enters play, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "He works for Mr. Boffin at Overhill and goes up to the Northfarthing for the hunting." -Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bulwark of the West
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard an ally you control to choose and discard a Condition attachment.
cards.flavor: "By our valour the wildfolk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the lads behind us…" -Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Beorning Guardian
cards.rulesText: Response: After Beorning Guardian participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, discard Beorning Guardian to place X progress on a location, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor: "...if it were not for the Beornings, the passage from Dale to Rivendell would long ago have become impossible." -Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Followed
cards.rulesText:
Play into your play area unattached. 
While unattached, attach to the next eligible enemy that engages you. 

While attached enemy is engaged with you, reduce the total [threat] in the staging area by X, where X is attached enemy's printed [threat].

cards.name: Flight to the Sea
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Planning Action: Shuffle a set aside Wind from the Sea into the encounter deck. Then, remove Flight to the Sea from the game.
cards.flavor: "...they may pass to the Sea unhindered and leave the Middle-earth forever." -Haldir, The Two Towers

cards.name: Emyn Arnen Ranger
cards.rulesText: Response: After Emyn Arnen Ranger commits to the quest, choose an enemy with a Trap attachment. Until the end of the phase, Emyn Arnen Ranger gets +X [willpower], where X is the chosen enemy's printed [threat].

cards.name: The Dam Bursts
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Ent trait and another unique character with the Hobbit trait. Action: Ready each damaged Ent character you control.

cards.name: Magic Ring
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero and 1 per deck. Action: Exhaust Magic Ring and raise your threat by 1 to (choose 1): heal 1 damage from attached hero, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool, or ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: "In Eregion long ago many Elven-rings were made, magic rings as you call them, and they were, of course, of various kinds..." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Wind from the Sea
cards.rulesText: Encounter. When Revealed: Ready each hero committed to the quest and remove Wind from the Sea from the game. Shadow: Ready the defending character

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Aragorn commits to a quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
cards.flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Théodred
cards.rulesText: Response: After Théodred commits to a quest, choose a hero committed to that quest. Add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Glóin
cards.rulesText: Response: After Glóin suffers damage, add 1 resource to his resource pool for each point of damage he just suffered.
cards.flavor:
His beard, very long and forked, was white, nearly as white as the snow-white cloth of his garments.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Gimli
cards.rulesText: Gimli gets +1 [attack] for each damage token on him.
cards.flavor: "Men need many words before deeds. My axe is restless in my hands." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Legolas
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, place 2 progress tokens on the current quest.
cards.flavor:
"I can walk this path, but others have not this skill."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Thalin
cards.rulesText: While Thalin is committed to a quest, deal 1 damage to each enemy as it is revealed by the encounter deck.

cards.name: Éowyn
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to give Éowyn +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. This effect may be triggered by each player once each round.
cards.flavor:
Slender and tall she was in her white robe girt with silver; but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Eleanor
cards.rulesText: Response: Exhaust Eleanor to cancel the "when revealed" effects of a treachery card just revealed by the encounter deck. Then, discard that card, and replace it with the next card from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"Gondor wanes, you say. But Gondor stands, and even the end of its strength is very strong."
<cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnhere
cards.rulesText: Dúnhere can target enemies in the staging area when he attacks alone. When doing so, he gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor:
Captains rode to meet him at the ford, bearing messages from Gandalf. Dúnhere, chieftain of the folk of Harrowdale, was at their head.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Denethor
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Denethor to look at the top card of the encounter deck. You may move that card to the bottom of the deck.
cards.flavor:
"And the lord Denethor is unlike other men: he sees far."
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.rulesText: Action: Pay 1 resource from Glorfindel's pool to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"You saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the firstborn."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Beravor
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Beravor to choose a player. That player draws 2 cards. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor:
But in the wild lands beyond Bree there were mysterious wanderers. The Bree-folk called them Rangers, and knew nothing of their origin.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Guard of the Citadel
cards.flavor:
"But the Lords of Minas Tirith still fight on, defying our enemies, keeping the passage of the River from Argonath to the Sea."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Faramir
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end."
<cite>Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Son of Arnor
cards.rulesText: Response: After Son of Arnor enters play, choose an enemy card in the staging area or currently engaged with another player. Engage that enemy.
cards.flavor:
...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor above the mouths of Anduin.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Snowbourn Scout
cards.rulesText: Response: After Snowbourn Scout enters play, choose a location. Place 1 progress token on that location.
cards.flavor:
...he saw not a shadow, nor a blur, but the small figures of horsemen, many horsemen, and the glint of morning on the tips of their spears was like the twinkle of minute stars beyond the edge of mortal sight.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Silverlode Archer
cards.rulesText: Ranged.
cards.flavor:
"We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north towards Moria, along the skirts of the mountains, many days ago."
<cite>Haldir of Lórien, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Longbeard Orc Slayer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Longbeard Orc Slayer enters play, deal 1 damage to each Orc enemy in play.
cards.flavor:
Five dead Orcs lay there. They had been hewn with many cruel strokes, and two had been beheaded. The ground was wet with their dark blood.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Brok Ironfist
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Dwarf hero you control leaves play, put Brok Ironfist into play from your hand.
cards.flavor:
...there is no knowing what a Dwarf will not dare and do for revenge and the recovery of his own.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose and ready 1 ally card.
cards.flavor:
"...no road looks toward safety any longer. Be vigilant!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Common Cause
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust 1 hero you control to choose and ready a different hero.
cards.flavor:
"We will make such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men."
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: For Gondor!
cards.rulesText: Action: Until the end of the phase, all characters get +1 [attack]. All Gondor characters also get +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
And the tree that was withered shall be renewed,
and he shall plant it in high places,
and the City shall be blessed.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Sneak Attack
cards.rulesText: Action: Put 1 ally card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor:
There is a seed of courage hidden (often deeply, it is true) in the heart of the fattest and most timid hobbit, waiting for some final and desperate danger to make it grow.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Valiant Sacrifice
cards.rulesText: Response: After an ally card leaves play, that card's controller draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor:
"He fell defending the Hobbits, while I was away upon the hill.
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready all character cards in play.
cards.flavor: "If there is only one way, then I must take it. What comes after must come." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Steward of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Action: Exhaust Steward of Gondor to add 2 resources to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"It was commanded yesterday."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Celebrían's Stone
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +2 [willpower]
If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [spirit] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
"You needn't," said Bilbo. "As a matter of fact it was all mine. Except that Aragorn insisted on my putting in a green stone. He seemed to think it important. I don't know why."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Veteran Axehand
cards.flavor: "I am glad to have you standing nigh with your stout legs and your hard axe." <cite>Legolas, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Gondorian Spearman
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Gondorian Spearman is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor: More than a thousand were there mustered. Their spears were like a sprining wood. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Horseback Archer
cards.rulesText: Ranged.
cards.flavor: A few of the riders appeared to be bowmen, skilled at shooting from a running horse. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Beorn
cards.rulesText: Action: Beorn gains +5 [attack] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase in which you trigger this effect, shuffle Beorn back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I don't need your service, thank you...but I expect you need mine." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Blade Mastery
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains +1 [attack] and +1 [defense].
cards.flavor:
Throwing back his cloak, he laid his hand on the hilt of a sword that had hung concealed by his side. They did not dare to move.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rain of Arrows
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a character you control with the ranged keyword to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
cards.flavor: Arrows thick as the rain came whistling over the battlements, and fell clinking and glancing on th estones. Many found their mark. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Feint
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor: A few brave men were strung before them to make a feint of resistance, and many there fell before the rest drew back and fled to either side. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Quick Strike
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a character you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target.
cards.flavor: "...for he that strikes the first blow, if he strikes it hard enough, may need to strike no more." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Thicket of Spears
cards.rulesText: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card. Action: Choose a player. That player's engaged enemies cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor:
With a word or cry, suddenly, the Riders halted. A thicket of spears were pointed towards the strangers...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Swift Strike
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character is declared as a defender, deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.
cards.flavor:
A swift stroke she dealt, skilled and deadly.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Stand Together
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. That player may declare any number of his eligible characters as defenders against each enemy attacking him this phase.
cards.flavor: ...and when the task was done, there they would come to an end, alone, houseless, foodless in the midst of a terrible desert. There could be no return. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Blade of Gondolin
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] when attacking an Orc. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress token on the current quest.
cards.flavor:
It was rather splendid to be wearing a blade made in Gondolin for the goblin-wars of which so many songs had sung...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Citadel Plate
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +4 Hit Points.
cards.flavor:
"Go to the armouries of the Citadel, and get you there the livery and gear of the Tower."
<cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Dwarven Axe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gains +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attached hero is a Dwarf.)
cards.flavor:
"But keep your bow ready to hand, and I will keep my axe loose in my belt."
<cite>Gimli, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Horn of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Response: After a character is destroyed, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor:
'Slow should you be to wind that horn again, Boromir,' said Elrond, 'until you stand once more on the borders of your land, and dire need is on you.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Wandering Took
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce your threat by 3 to give control of Wandering Took to another player. Raise that player's threat by 3. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: ...but certainly there was still something not entirely hobbit-like about them, and once in a while members of the Took-clan would go and have adventures. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Lórien Guide
cards.rulesText: Response: After Lórien Guide commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on the active location.
cards.flavor: "Indeed deep in the wood they dwell..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Northern Tracker
cards.rulesText: Response: After Northern Tracker commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on each location in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
"What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Galadhrim's Greeting
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce one player's threat by 6, or reduce each player's threat by 2.
cards.flavor:
"Welcome to Caras Galadhan!" he said. "Here is the city of the Galadhrim where dwell the Lord Celeborn and Galadriel the Lady of Lórien"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Strength of Will
cards.rulesText: Response: After you travel to a location, exhaust a [spirit] character to place 2 progress tokens on that location.
cards.flavor:
Then Aragorn lead the way, and such was the strength of his will in that hour that all the Dúnedain and their horses followed him.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Hasty Stroke
cards.rulesText: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
'The hasy stroke goes oft astray,' said Aragorn. 'We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait on him for the next move.'
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Will of the West
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. Shuffle that player's discard pile back into his deck. Remove Will of the West from the game.
cards.flavor:
"If Gondor has such men still in these days of fading, great must have been its glory in the days of its rising."
<cite>Legolas, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: A Test of Will
cards.rulesText: Response: Cancel the "when revealed" effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"There is naught that you can do, other than to resist, with hope or without it"
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Stand and Fight
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an ally with a printed cost of X in any player's discard pile. Put that ally into play under your control. (The chosen ally can belong to any sphere of influence.)
cards.flavor: "...we will fight on." <cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: A Light in the Dark
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. Return that enemy to the staging area.
cards.flavor:
The light of the torches and the fire flickered about them...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Dwarven Tomb
cards.rulesText: Action: Return 1 [spirit] card from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
The dwarves no more shall suffer wrong,
The dwarves of yore made mighty spells,
While hammers  v  fell like ringing bells
In places deep, where dark things sleep,
In hollow halls beneath the fells.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Fortune or Fate
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a hero in any player's discard pile. Put that card into play, under its owner's control.
cards.flavor:
'Yes, fortune or fate have heped you,' said Gandalf, 'not to mention courage.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Favor of the Lady
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
"You are indeed high in the favor of the Lady!"
<cite>Unnamed Elf of Lórien,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Power in the Earth
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a location.
Attached location gets -1 [threat].
cards.flavor:
"Power to defy our Enemy is not in him, unless shuch power is in the earth itself."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Unexpected Courage
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Unexpected Courage to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
"Here am I, naughty little fly;
you are fat and lazy.
You cannot trap me, though you try,
in your cobwebs crazy."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Daughter of the Nimrodel
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Daughter of the Nimrodel to heal up to 2 damage on any 1 hero.
cards.flavor: "Here is Nimrodel! Of this stream the Silvan Elves made many songs long ago, and still we sing them in the North...I will bate my feet, for it is said that the water is healing to the weary." <cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Erebor Hammersmith
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Erebor Hammersmith, return the topmost attachment in any player's discard pile to his hand.
cards.flavor: "In Erebor in the Kingdom of Dain there is such skill..." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Henamarth Riversong
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"And I reckon there's Elves and Elves. They're all elvish enough, but they're not all the same."
<cite>Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Miner of the Iron Hills
cards.rulesText: Response: After Miner of the Iron Hills enters play, choose and discard 1 Condition attachment from play.
cards.flavor:
...while the four dwarves sat around the table, and talked about mines and gold and troubles with goblins...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Gléowine
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Gléowine to choose a player. That player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Then the Riders of the King's House upon white horses rode round about the barrow and sang together a song of Théoden Thengle's son that Gléowine his minstrel made...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Lore of Imladris
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a character. Heal all damage from that character.
cards.flavor:
"...understanding, making and healing...These things the Elves of Middle-earth have in some measure gained, though with sorrow."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lórien's Wealth
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. That player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor:
"That is the fairest of all the dwellings of my people. There are no trees like the tress of that land."
<cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Radagast's Cunning
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not contribute its [threat]
cards.flavor: "Radagast is, of course, a worthy Wizard, a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts, and birds are especially his friends." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>
