cards.name: Secret Paths
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location does not contribute its [threat]
cards.flavor: ...Beorn advised them to take this way; for at a place a few days' ride due north of the Carrock was the gate of a little-known pathway through Mirkwood... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Gandalf's Search
cards.rulesText: Action: Look at the top X cards of any player's deck, add 1 of those cards to its owner's hand, and return the rest to the top of the deck in any order.
cards.flavor:
"Less welcome did the Lord Denethor show me then than of old, and grudgingly he permitted me to search among his hoarded scrolls and books."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Beorn's Hospitality
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. Heal all damage on each hero controlled by that player.
cards.flavor:
"...and my house is open to you, if ever you come back this way again."
<cite>Beorn, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Forest Snare
cards.rulesText:
Attach to an enemy engaged with a player.
Attached enemy cannot attack.
cards.flavor:
"We shall have it like a coney in a trap. Then we shall learn what kind of thing it is."
<cite>Unidentified Man of Gondor,
The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Protector of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard a card from your hand to give attached hero +1 [defense] or +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. Limit 3 times per phase.
cards.flavor:
'Speak no evil of the lady Galadriel!' said Aragorn sternly. 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dark Knowledge
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets -1 [willpower] Response: Exhaust Dark Knowledge to look at 1 shadow card that was just dealt to an enemy attacking you.
cards.flavor:
'Go on then!' said Frodo. 'What do you know?'
'Too much; too many dark things,' said Strider grimly.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Self Preservation
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Action: Exhaust Self Preservation to heal 2 points of damage from attached character.
cards.flavor:
...how much more of this would they have to endure, or could they endure?
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Gandalf
cards.rulesText: At the end of the round, discard Gandalf from play. Response: After Gandalf enters play, (choose 1): draw 3 cards, deal 4 damage to 1 enemy in play, or reduce your threat by 5.

cards.name: Saruman
cards.rulesText: When a player card effect would reduce your threat by any amount, reduce that amount to 1. While playing an event with the printed doomed keyword, Saruman gains the printed [leadership], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Response: After you play a card with the doomed keyword, ready Saruman.

cards.name: Power of Command
cards.rulesText: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to give each other unique character you control +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Horns! Horns! Horns!
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may put one ally card into play from his hand. At the end of the phase, shuffle each of those allies that are still in play into their owners' decks.

cards.name: Soldier of Isengard
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Response: After a player raises his threat from the doomed keyword, give control of Soldier of Isengard to that player.
cards.flavor:
"...the keepers of the gate were on the watch for me and told me that Saruman awaited me."
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Far-sighted
cards.rulesText: Doomed 1. Action: Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Put them back in the same order.
cards.flavor:
...Legolas was standing, gazing northwards into the darkness, thoughtful and silent as a young tree in a windless night.
-The Two Towers

cards.name: Nori
cards.rulesText: Response: After Nori participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, put the top card of your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor:
"You've left the burglar behind again!"
-Nori, The Hobbit

cards.name: Golden Belt
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. 
Attached hero can have 1 additional restricted attachment.
cards.flavor:
The lady bowed her head, and she turned then to Boromir, and to him she gave a belt of gold...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Rohirrim Scout
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Rohirrim Scout to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. That enemy does not make engagement checks against you this round.
cards.flavor:
Swiftly a scout rode back and reported that wolf-riders were abroad in the valley...
-The Two Towers

cards.name: The Muster of Rohan
cards.rulesText: While paying for The Muster of Rohan, each Rohan hero you control is considered to have a [spirit] icon. Planning Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for up to 4 Rohan allies and put them into play. Shuffle your deck. If any of those allies are still in play at the end of the round, discard them.

cards.name: Saruman's Staff
cards.rulesText: Attach to Saruman. Restricted. Action: Exhaust Saruman's Staff to (choose one): Reduce the X value of the next Doomed X event you play this phase by 2, or search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Doomed event and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.)
cards.flavor:
His hand clutched his heavy black staff like a claw.
-The Two Towers

cards.name: The Grey Wanderer
cards.rulesText: Side A You cannot choose more than 1 starting hero. Setup: Search your deck for an attachment with a printed cost of 1 and put it into play. Then, flip this card over. Side B The first non-unique card you play each planning phase does not require a resource match. Action: Exhaust this card and raise your threat by 1 to (choose two): Ready your starting hero, add 2 resources to your starting hero's resource pool, or heal 3 damage from your starting hero.
cards.flavor:
"...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small. But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care."
-Gandalf, The Return of the King
“...this shall be his great task, and maybe the end of his labours.”
–Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Armor Plating
cards.rulesText: SideA When Armor Plating leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [defense]. SideB When Armor Plating leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [defense]. Response: After attached Ship defends against an enemy, discard 1 shadow card from another enemy.

cards.name: Ballista
cards.rulesText: SideA When Ballista leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [attack]. SideB When Ballista leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged. Response: After attached Ship attacks, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy and remove 1 resource from that enemy.

cards.name: Enlarged Quarters
cards.rulesText: SideA When Enlarged Quarters leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +3 hit points and can be committed to any Sailing test. SideB When Enlarged Quarters leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +3 hit points and can be committed to any Sailing test. It counts as 1 additional character when committed to a Sailing test.

cards.name: Extra Sails
cards.rulesText: SideA When Extra Sails leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [willpower]. SideB When Extra Sails leaves play, remove it from the game. Attached Ship gets +1 [willpower]. Response: When a non-unique Ship enemy engages you, spend 1 resource and exhaust Extra Sails to reduce that enemy’s Boarding value by 1.

cards.name: Ominous Fate
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Each player must either reveal an encounter card, raise their threat by X, or deal X damage divided among characters they control. X is the campaign card’s part number. The players may add Ominous Fate to the victory display.

cards.name: Thunderstruck
cards.rulesText: Thunderstruck gets +2 hit points per player and cannot take more than 4 damage each round.

cards.name: Crowley
cards.rulesText: For each resource on Crowley, he gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit points. If Crowley has 3 or more resources on him, he gains victory 3.NNN Forced: When Crowley engages you, place 1 resource on him. At the end of the combat phase, return him to the staging area.

cards.name: Spyglass
cards.rulesText: SideA Action: Exhaust Spyglass to choose one: • Look at a shadow card. • Look at the top and bottom card of your deck. • Place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if it is Uncharted). SideB Action: Exhaust Spyglass to choose one: • Look at a shadow card. You may discard it. • Look at the top and bottom card of any deck. • Place 1 progress on a location (4 progress instead if it is Uncharted).

cards.name: Revenant
cards.rulesText: Forced: When 3 or more damage would be placed on Revenant, place 2 damage instead. Forced: After Revenant is destroyed, shuffle it into the encounter deck. Place 1 resource on the campaign card.

cards.name: Black Key
cards.rulesText: SideA Attached character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. SideB Attached character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached character quests successfully, place 1 resource on them. Action: Exhaust Black Key and remove 3 resources from attached character to ready them.

cards.name: Galdor's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Action: Add X resources to any hero’s resource pool. X is half the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([leadership]), rounded up. Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

cards.name: Galdor's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Action: Deal X damage to a non-unique enemy. X is the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([tactics]). Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

cards.name: Galdor's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Action: Place X progress on a non-unique location in the staging area. X is the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([spirit]). Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

cards.name: Galdor's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Action: Look at the top X or bottom X cards of your deck, add any number of them to your hand, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of your deck in any order. X is half the level of Galdor’s Counsel ([lore]), rounded up. Add Galdor’s Counsel to the victory display.

cards.name: Graxar
cards.rulesText: Graxar gets +1 [attack] for each damage on him and +1 [defense] for each resource on him. Forced: When Graxar is dealt a shadow card, place 1 resource on him.

cards.name: Parrying Cutlass
cards.rulesText: SideA Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if it has 2 or more resources in its resource pool). SideB Attached hero gets +2 [defense] (+3 [defense] instead if it has 2 or more resources in its resource pool). Response: When attached hero defends against an enemy, exhaust Parrying Cutlass to move 1 resource from that enemy to attached hero’s resource pool.

cards.name: Throwing Axe
cards.rulesText: SideA Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if it has 2 or more damage on it). SideB Attached hero gets +2 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if it has 2 or more damage on it) Action: Either deal 1 damage to an enemy, or toss Throwing Axe. If it travels at least two feet across the playing area and stops on any enemies, deal 4 damage to one of them. Reattach Throwing Axe to its hero. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: Black Key
cards.rulesText: SideA Attached enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and gains immune to player card effects. Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if Captain Sahír is in play, place 1 resource on him for each player in the game. SideB Attached enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and gains immune to player card effects.

cards.name: Calaerion
cards.rulesText: SideA Action: Spend 3 resources and exhaust Calaerion to ready the Dream-chaser and give it +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase. SideB Response: After a card is discarded from the encounter deck, shuffle it into that deck. (Limit once per round.) Action: Spend 2 resources and exhaust Calaerion to ready another ally and give it +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.

cards.name: Come Together
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose up to X characters. X is the level of Come Together, then add it to the victory display. Until the end of the round, each of those characters… ...get +2 [defense] if you control a [leadership] hero. ...get +2 [attack] if you control a [tactics] hero. ...get +2 [willpower] if you control a [spirit] hero. ...gain a Trait of your choice and heal 2 damage from each of them if you control a [lore] hero

cards.name: Sea Serpent
cards.rulesText: SideA Forced: After Sea Serpent attacks and destroys an ally, the defending player deals X damage divided among characters they control. Forced: After Sea Serpent is destroyed, flip it over and put it into play in the staging area. SideB Forced: After Sea Serpent attacks and destroys an ally, the defending player deals X damage divided among characters they control. Forced: At the end of the round, Sea Serpent makes an attack against the first player.

cards.name: Starla
cards.rulesText: Response: After Starla is discarded from your hand or deck, play her. Response: After Starla exhausts, place 1 progress on a location.

cards.name: Recurring Nightmare
cards.rulesText: When Recurring Nightmare leaves play, shuffle it into any player’s deck. Forced: When Recurring Nightmare enters your hand, add it to the staging area.

cards.name: Command
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Command ([leadership]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [defense] until the end of the round. • An enemy gets –2 [defense] until the end of the round. • Ready a character with Círdan’s Blessing on it. • Put an ally with cost X or less in your discard pile into play. Discard it at the end of the phase.

cards.name: Command
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Command ([lore]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • Remove X resources from a non-unique enemy. • Add 2 resources to each Círdan’s Blessing. • Add the bottom card of your deck to your hand. • Look at the top 10 cards of the encounter deck, discard any number of them, and shuffle it.

cards.name: Command
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Command ([spirit]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the round. • Each character with Círdan’s Blessing on it does not exhaust to commit to a quest this round. • Place 2 progress on a non-unique location. • Put Spyglass into play attached to a hero.

cards.name: Command
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Command ([tactics]) to the victory display to choose up to X options, where X is its level: • A hero gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round. • An enemy gets –2 [attack] until the end of the round. • Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may engage it. • Ready an attachment. You may move it to an eligible character.

cards.name: Cirdan's Blessing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([leadership]). Response: When attached character defends, remove 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to give that character +3 [defense] for this attack.

cards.name: Cirdan's Blessing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([tactics]). Response: When attached character attacks, remove 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to give that character +3 [attack] for this attack.

cards.name: Cirdan's Blessing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([spirit]). Action: Exhaust Cirdan’s Blessing and remove 1 resource from it to give attached character +3 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Cirdan's Blessing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Cirdan’s Blessing enters play with X resources on it. X is 1 more than the level of Círdan’s Blessing ([lore]). Response: After the active location is explored, move 1 resource from Cirdan’s Blessing to attached hero’s resource pool. Then, heal 1 damage from attached hero.

cards.name: Gavin
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Shuffle Gavin and 1 random set-aside Send for Help into the encounter deck. When Revealed: Put Gavin into play under any player’s control committed to the quest. Add 1 resource to Lanwyn’s resource pool, if able.

cards.name: Send for Help
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Choose a player to search the top 10 cards of their deck for a card, draw it or play it at no cost, and shuffle their deck. If Send for Help ([leadership]) is upgraded, repeat this effect. Remove Send for Help from the game.

cards.name: Send for Help
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Search the players’ collections for a hero and put it into play under any player’s control. If Send for Help ([tactics]) is upgraded, repeat this effect. At the end of the round, or if those heroes leave play, remove them from the game. Remove Send for Help from the game.

cards.name: Send for Help
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Choose one: resource, planning, combat, or refresh. After the current phase, there is an additional instance of the chosen phase. If Send for Help ([spirit]) is upgraded, choose two instead (resolve them in any order). Remove Send for Help from the game.

cards.name: Send for Help
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Search the players’ collections for Gandalf ally (core set 73) and put him into play under any player’s control, ignoring uniqueness. If Send for Help ([lore]) is upgraded, that player chooses up to 3 of Gandalf’s options instead of 1. Remove Send for Help from the game.

cards.name: The Black Sword
cards.rulesText: SideA Captain Sahír gets +2 [attack] and gains indestructible. Forced: After Captain Sahír attacks for the first time each round, he makes an attack against each other player (in turn order). SideB Captain Sahír gains indestructible. Forced: After Captain Sahír attacks for the first time each round, he makes an attack against each other player (in turn order).

cards.name: Argalad
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Action: Exhaust Argalad to choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that enemy gets -X [threat], where X is Argalad's [attack]. If this effect reduces the enemy's [threat] to 0, deal 1 damage to it. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Dwarven Sellsword
cards.rulesText: Forced: At the end of the round, discard Dwarven Sellsword unless the players as a group spend 1 [leadership] resource.
cards.flavor:
...he did not altogether approve of dwarves and their love of gold...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Remedy
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Response: After Dúnedain Remedy is attached to a hero, heal 1 damage on that hero. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's resource pool to attach Dúnedain Remedy to another hero.

cards.name: Marksman of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Marksman of Lórien enters play, choose an enemy. That enemy gets -2 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"Keen are the eyes of the Elves."
<cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Battle-fury
cards.rulesText: Play only before the staging step. Quest Action: Exhaust a hero you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target. Then, the players as a group may spend 1 [spirit] resource to commit that hero to the quest.
cards.flavor:
Fey he seemed, or the battle-fury of his fathers ran like new fire in his veins...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Woodland Courier
cards.rulesText: Response: After Woodland Courier enters play, place 1 progress on a location (2 progress instead if that location has the Forest trait).

cards.name: Hithlain
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location Response: After a player plays a Silvan ally from his hand, place 1 progress on attached location.
cards.flavor:
He made his end of the rope fast about another tree, and then ran lightly along it, over the river and back again, as if he were on a round.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Robin Smallburrow
cards.rulesText: Response: After you travel to a location, spend 1 [spirit] resource to raise the engagement cost of each enemy in play by X until the end of the round, where X is that location's quest points. Any player may trigger this response.
cards.flavor:
"Gave me a chance of walking round the country and seeing folk, and hearing the news, and knowing where the good beer was."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Interrogation
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an enemy with an attached Trap card. Look at the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is that enemy's printed [threat]. You may discard 1 of those cards. Return the rest to the top of the deck, in the same order.

cards.name: Strider
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
While you control 2 or fewer heroes, attached hero does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
While you control 5 or fewer characters, attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
"Strider can take you by paths that are seldom tridden. Will you have him?"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Folco Boffin
cards.rulesText: Folco Boffin gets -1 threat cost for each Hobbit hero you control. Action: Discard Folco Boffin to reduce your threat by 7. (Limit once per game.)
cards.flavor: ...he had a good many friends, especially among the younger Hobbits (mostly descendants of the Old Took)... -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Knight of Dale
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [leadership] resource to ready Knight of Dale. (Limit once per round.) Valour Action: Ready Knight of Dale. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: By that time all the bells were ringing in Dale and the warriors were arming. -The Hobbit

cards.name: Diligent Noble
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Noble trait. Response: After you play Diligent Noble from your hand, draw a card.
cards.flavor: "The wise will stay here and hope to rebuild our town, and enjoy in times its peace and riches." -The Master, The Hobbit

cards.name: Riddermark Knight
cards.rulesText: Response: After Riddermark Knight is declared as an attacker, it gets +2 [attack] for this attack. At the end of this attack, discard Riddermark Knight.
cards.flavor: After him thundered the knights of his house... -The Return of the King

cards.name: Fierce Defense
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Deal 3 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with you. Valour Action: Discard a non-unique enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed, except for Sam who had a scratch along the scalp. -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Eregion Survivor
cards.rulesText: While you have no cards in your hand, Eregion Survivor gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
cards.flavor: "Much evil must befall a country before it wholly forgets the Elves, if once they dwelt there." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Heirs of Earendil
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noldor trait and another unique character with the Dúnedain trait. Action: Choose a non-unique location in the staging area and raise your threat by X to discard it. X is the chosen location's printed quest points.

cards.name: Leaflock
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Leaflock gets +1 [willpower] for each damaged Ent character you control. (Limit +4 [willpower].)
cards.flavor: "Leaflock has grown sleepy, almost tree-ish, you might say…" Treebeard, The Two Towers

cards.name: Legacy Blade
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] for each side quest in the victory display. (Limit +3 [attack].)
cards.flavor: … glad would he have been to know its fate who wrought it slowly long ago in the North-kingdom when the Dúnedain were young… -The Return of the King

cards.name: Open the Armory
cards.rulesText: Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for a Weapon or Armor attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Valour Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Weapon or Armor attachment and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Turayn
cards.rulesText: Response: After Turayn exhausts, choose another character. The next time that character would be dealt damage this round, cancel 1 of that damage.

cards.name: A Growing Threat
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Set aside the topmost non-unique, non-objective, non-burden encounter card in the encounter discard pile. During quest resolution, add a copy of that card to the campaign pool, if able. Remove A Growing Threat from the game.

cards.name: Melanwar
cards.rulesText: Response: After the travel phase begins, exhaust Melanwar to place 1 progress on the active location. If you quested unsuccessfully this round, place 3 progress on the active location instead.

cards.name: Isolde
cards.rulesText: Isolde gets +2 [willpower] while she has an Item attachment. Response: After you engage an enemy, ready Isolde.

cards.name: The Threat to Wilderland
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add The Threat to Wilderland to the staging area with X resources on it. X is the campaign card’s part number. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, remove a resource from The Threat to Wilderland. Then, either raise each player’s threat by 2 or all encounter cards are immune to player card effects until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Dagnir's Spawn
cards.rulesText: Cannot have non-Dragon attachments. X is the campaign card’s part number. When Revealed: Each player may distribute X damage among characters they control. If they do, shuffle Dagnir’s Spawn into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Abandoned Ruin
cards.rulesText: Setup: Shuffle Abandoned Ruin into the Caves deck, if able. Otherwise, remove it from the game. Response: After Abandoned Ruin becomes the active location, look at 3 random undiscovered treasures and attach 1 of them to Abandoned Ruin as a guarded objective. When that treasure is free of encounters, the players claim it and attach it to an eligible character. Limit once per game for the group.

cards.name: Master of the Hunt
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 hit point. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, choose a player to look at the top 3 cards of their deck. They put 1 of those cards on the top of their deck and put the rest on the bottom of their deck in any order.

cards.name: Unbroken
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense]. Action: Discard a card from your hand to heal 1 damage from attached hero. This ability may be triggered by each player once each round.

cards.name: The Steadfast
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached hero commits to the quest, if your threat is 40 or higher, place 1 progress on the current quest.

cards.name: Dragon-slayer
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Response: After a non-unique enemy is added to the staging area, exhaust Dragon-slayer to engage that enemy. It makes an immediate attack against you.

cards.name: The Canny Huntsman
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Look at the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. Put any number of those cards on top of the encounter deck and the rest on the bottom in any order. The hero with Master of the Hunt attached gets +3 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: A Tale of Victories
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Draw a card for each enemy engaged with you. Heal 3 damage from the hero with Unbroken attached. The next time that hero would be dealt damage this phase, cancel 3 of that damage.

cards.name: Lay of Courage
cards.rulesText: Quest Response: Cancel the “when revealed” effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck. Ready the hero with The Steadfast attached. Add Lay of Courage to the victory display.

cards.name: Rhyme of the Slayer
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Choose an enemy. That enemy gets –4 [attack] until the end of the phase. The hero with Dragon-slayer attached gets +4 [attack] while attacking that enemy this phase.

cards.name: Urdug's Cunning
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. For each enemy discarded this way, each player must deal 1 damage to a character they control.

cards.name: Misplaced Trust
cards.rulesText: Setup: Shuffle Misplaced Trust into your deck. (Do this after drawing your starting hand.) Forced: After you draw this card, attach it to a hero you control. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached character cannot have player card attachments and is immune to player card effects.”)

cards.name: Beldis
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 resource and mark a use in the campaign log to heal 3 damage from a character. Any player may trigger this ability. (Each player has 4 uses for the campaign.)

cards.name: Ashen Brazier
cards.rulesText: If unattached, the first player claims Ashen Brazier and attaches it to a hero they control. Action: Exhaust Ashen Brazier to look at a facedown shadow card.

cards.name: Gundabad Hunter
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Choose a player that is engaged with a unique enemy, if able. Gundabad Hunter makes an immediate attack against that player.

cards.name: Gundabad Stalker
cards.rulesText: Gundabad Stalker cannot be optionally engaged except by a player who is engaged with a unique enemy.

cards.name: Dragon-sickness
cards.rulesText: When Revealed: Attach to a character with 1 or more treasures attached, then attach all unguarded treasures in play to that character. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Forced: After attached character exhausts, raise your threat by 1 for each treasure attached to it.”)

cards.name: Anvil of Gundabad
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Response: After you claim or play Anvil of Gundabad, search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Item attachments and add them to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Action: Exhaust Anvil of Gundabad and attached character to play an Item attachment from your hand, reducing its cost by 1.

cards.name: Axe of the Edain
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After you play Axe of the Edain, deal 2 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with you.

cards.name: Durin's Dagger
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 [attack]. You may play Durin’s Dagger from your discard pile.

cards.name: Dwarf-Lord's Crown
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Dwarf-Lord’s Crown to give each ally that shares a Trait with attached hero +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Glittering Lute
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [willpower]. Response: After you play Glittering Lute, each player may discard a card from their hand. Each player who does so reduces their threat by 2.

cards.name: Gondolin Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [defense] and gains sentinel. Response: Exhaust Gondolin Shield and spend 1 resource to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached character is defending. Then, deal the attacking enemy another shadow card.

cards.name: Helm of Heroes
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [defense]. Response: After attached character takes 1 or more damage from an enemy’s attack, add 1 resource to any hero’s resource pool.

cards.name: Jewels of Wilderland
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 [willpower]. Action: Exhaust Jewels of Wilderland and discard a card from your hand to draw a card.

cards.name: Masterwork Bow
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged. Response: After attached character attacks and defeats an enemy, place 1 progress on a location in the staging area.

cards.name: Pippin
cards.rulesText: If each hero you control has the Hobbit trait, Pippin gains: "Response: After an enemy engages you, raise your threat by 3 to return it to the staging area. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot engage you."
cards.flavor: "There must be someone with intelligence in the party." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Denethor
cards.rulesText:
Denethor gets -1 [willpower] for each damaged hero you control.
Discard Denethor if his [willpower] is 0 or less.
cards.flavor: "Denethor is of another sort, proud and subtile, a man of far greater lineage and power, though he is not called a king." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Lord of Morthond
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor or Outlands hero. If each hero you control has a printed [leadership] resource icon, Lord of Morthond gains: "Response: After you play a [lore], [spirit], or [tactics] ally, draw 1 card."
cards.flavor: "The Captains of the Outlands are expected up the South Road ere sundown. Come with us and you will see." <cite>Bergil, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Book of Eldacar
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] hero. Reduce the cost to play Book of Eldacar by 1 for each hero you control with a printed [tactics] resource icon. Action: Discard Book of Eldacar to play any [tactics] event card in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Then, place that event on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Gondorian Discipline
cards.rulesText: Response: Cancel up to 2 points of damage just dealt to a Gondor character.
cards.flavor: At last, less than a mile from the City, a more ordered mass of men came into view, marching not running, still holding together. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Minas Tirith Lampwright
cards.rulesText: Response: After an encounter card with surge is revealed, discard Minas Tirith Lampwright to name enemy, location, or treachery. If the next encounter card revealed is the named type, discard it without resolving its effects.

cards.name: Small Target
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Hobbit hero you control exhausts to defend an attack, choose another enemy engaged with you and reveal the attacking enemy's shadow card. If that shadow card has no shadow effect, resolve this enemy's attack against the chosen enemy. If that shadow card has a shadow effect, resolve this attack as normal.

cards.name: Ithilien Archer
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Ithilien Archer attacks and damages an enemy, return that enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Ithilien Pit
cards.rulesText:
Play Ithilien Pit into the staging area unattached.
If unattached, attach Ithilien Pit to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area.
Any character may choose attached enemy as the target of an attack.

cards.name: Hobbit-sense
cards.rulesText: Play only if each of your heroes is a Hobbit. Combat Action: Enemies engaged with you do not attack this round. You cannot declare attacks this round.
cards.flavor:
They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rossiel
cards.rulesText: If the active location shares a Trait with a location in the victory display, Rossiel gets +2 [willpower]. If the attacking enemy shares a Trait with an enemy in the victory display, Rossiel gets +2 [defense].
cards.flavor:
"Did you not say that you wished to see Elf-magic?"
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Veteran of Osgiliath
cards.rulesText: Veteran of Osgiliath gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] while your threat is 40 or higher.
cards.flavor:
"So do we ever watch the shores nigh Osgiliath, which our enemies now partly hold, and issue from it to harry our lands."
<cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Descendants of Kings
cards.rulesText: Ready up to X Dúnedain characters you control. X is the number of enemies engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
"But when dark things come from the houseless hills, or creep from sunless woods, they fly from us."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Derndingle Warrior
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. While Derndingle Warrior is defending, it gains: "Action: Deal 1 damage to Derndingle Warrior to give it +3 [defense] for this attack." (Limit once per attack.)

cards.name: Boomed and Trumpeted
cards.rulesText: Response: After an Ent character takes any amount of damage, ready it. That character gets +3 [attack] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "They roared and boomed and trumpeted, until stones began to crack and fall at the mere noise of them." <cite>Merry, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Elven Jeweler
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard 2 cards from your hand to put Elven Jeweler into play from your hand, under your control.
cards.flavor: "...to the Elven-smiths they were but trifles..." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Double Back
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, reduce each player's threat by 5.
cards.flavor: He was taking a wandering course with many turns and doublings, to put off any pursuit. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Leave No Trace
cards.rulesText: Limit 3 copies of Leave No Trace in the victory display. Response: After a non-unique location is explored, add Leave No Trace to the victory display to add that location to the victory display.

cards.name: Distant Stars
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a Ranger or Scout character to discard a non-unique active location. Then, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a non-unique location and make it the active location. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"I have crossed many mountains and many rivers, and trodden many plains, even into the far countries of Rhûn and Harad where the stars are strange..."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Keen as Lances
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Keen as Lances by 1 for each card worth no victory points in the victory display. Action: Add Keen as Lances to the victory display. Then, choose one: add 2 resources to a hero's resource pool, draw 3 cards, or reduce your threat by 4.

cards.name: Castellan Wilhelm
cards.rulesText: Increase your threat elimination level by 2 for each ally you control with the word “doomed” in their text box. Setup: Search your collection for Ring Wall A and Ring Wall B and put them into play under your control (they are considered to be attached to your play area).

cards.name: Saruman
cards.rulesText: While Saruman has an Artifact card attached, he is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Artifact cards cannot be attached or unattached from him except by the effect below. Action: Attach an Artifact card from your hand to Saruman. Ignore eligibility and the guarded (X) keyword. At the end of the round, discard it.

cards.name: Dweller of Dunharrow
cards.rulesText: Cannot enter play unless Fulfil Your Oath is in the victory display. Action: Attach to an enemy. Counts as a Fear attachment with the text: “Attached enemy cannot be dealt shadow cards.”

cards.name: Man of the Mountain
cards.rulesText: Cannot enter play unless Fulfil Your Oath is in the victory display. Action: Attach to an enemy. Counts as a Fear attachment with the text: “Treat all Forced effects in the attached enemy’s text box as blank.”

cards.name: King of the Dead
cards.rulesText: Cannot enter play unless Fulfil Your Oath is in the victory display. Oathbreaker characters get +2 [attack] while attacking an enemy with a Fear attachment.
cards.flavor: Ever there rose the same cry in the gathering night: ‘The King of the Dead! The King of the Dead is come upon us!’ —The Return of the King

cards.name: Ring Wall Sentry
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Trigger doomed 1 to have each copy of Ring Wall Sentry gain sentinel until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.) Response: After Ring Wall Sentry defends an attack, ready it. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Edrik Ravenhelm
cards.rulesText: Action: Trigger doomed 1 to give X Isengard characters +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. X is the tens digit of your threat. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: “Why don’t we get together and charge through?” —The Two Towers

cards.name: Army of the Dead
cards.rulesText: Play only if Fulfil Your Oath is in the victory display. Action: Choose an enemy with a Fear attachment you control. Deal 2 damage to the enemy and return that attachment to your play area as an ally, if able. Repeat this effect any number of times. Remove Army of the Dead from the game.

cards.name: Lord of Isengard
cards.rulesText: Attach to Saruman. He gains the Noble trait. Action: Exhaust Lord of Isengard to search the top 5 cards of your deck for 1 Artifact or Isengard card and add it to your hand. If Saruman has an exhausted Palantir attached, search your whole deck instead. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Ring Wall A
cards.rulesText: Cannot be included in a deck. Wall cards are immune to non-Wall card effects. You cannot control more than 2 Wall cards. Planning Action: Arrange up to X allies you control into a row between your Wall attachments. X is the tens digit of your threat. Allies cannot be placed or rearranged between your Wall attachments except by this ability.

cards.name: Ring Wall B
cards.rulesText: Cannot be included in a deck. Response: After an ally between your Wall attachments exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust a Wall attachment and trigger doomed 1 to exhaust any number of other eligible allies between your Wall attachments and declare them as defenders for that attack.

cards.name: The White
cards.rulesText: Doomed 1. Limit 1 per deck. Attach to an Istari character. Attached character cannot be discarded from play by card effects. Action: Exhaust a Staff attachment on the attached character to discard a Condition attachment from play.

cards.name: Fulfil Your Oath
cards.rulesText: Side A Limit 1 per deck. Cannot be included in your deck unless you also include at least 3 Oathbreaker cards in your deck. Cannot be included in your deck if another player has included this card in their deck. Setup: Put this quest into play from your deck, this side up, and shuffle your deck. If Aragorn is in play, place 3 progress on this quest. Forced: After this card is added to the victory display, flip it over. Side B Response: After this side is flipped faceup in the victory display, choose a player. That player searches their hand and deck for up to 3 Oathbreaker allies, puts those allies into play, and shuffles their deck. While this quest is in the victory display, any player can play Oathbreaker allies in their discard pile as if they were in their hand by also raising their own threat by 1 as an additional cost. (Limit 3 times per round for each player.)

cards.name: Tower of Orthanc
cards.rulesText: Side A Setup: Each player may raise their threat by X to opt in. X is 3 minus the number of Isengard heroes the players control. Flip this card over. Side B Response: When you trigger the doomed X keyword on a player card (even if it is gained by a card effect), you can choose to make all other players and the cards they control immune to the effects of that card (including the doomed X keyword).
cards.flavor: One entrance only was there made in it, a great arch delved in the southern wall. —The Two Towers

cards.name: Thranduil
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Play a Silvan ally from your hand. You do not need a resource match for this ally. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"It is a crime to wander in my realm without leave."
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: The Elvenking
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Silvan hero. Action: Exhaust The Elvenking and return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
In a great hall with pillars hewn out of the living stone sat the Elvenking on a chair of carven wood.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Orcrist
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero destroys an enemy, add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.

cards.name: Forest Road Traveler
cards.rulesText: Forest Road Traveler gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] for each attachment on the active location.
cards.flavor:
Only on the Road would travellers be found...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Leather Boots
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] or Ranger character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After a location is revealed from the encounter deck, exhaust Leather Boots to ready attached character.
cards.flavor:
His legs were stretched out before him, showing high boots of supple leather that fitted him well...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Giant Bear
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Action: Ready Giant Bear. At the end of the phase in which you triggered this effect, shuffle Giant Bear back into your deck. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"As a bear he ranges far and wide."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Outmatched
cards.rulesText: Play into your play area unattached. If unattached, attach to the next eligible enemy that engages you. Response: After attached enemy resolves its attack, ready the defending character.

cards.name: Galion
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or defend. Response: After Galion enters play, he gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"Here am I waiting and waiting down here, while you fellows drink and make merry and forget your tasks. Small wonder if I fall asleep from weariness!"
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Quicker Than Sight
cards.rulesText: Response: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
"You would die before your stroke fell."
<cite>Legolas, Th Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Thalion
cards.rulesText:
While there is at least 1 side quest in the victory display, ready Thalion at the beginning of the combat phase. 
While there are at least 3 side quests in the victory display, Thalion loses the ally card type, gains the hero card type and the resource icons of each sphere on a side quest in the victory display.

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.rulesText: Forced: After Glorfindel exhausts to commit to a quest, raise your threat by 1.
cards.flavor:
Glorfindel was tall and straight; his hair was of shining gold, his face fair and young and fearless and full of joy; his eyes were bright and keen, and has voice like music; on his brow sat wisdom, and in his hand was strength.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Longbeard Elder
cards.rulesText: Response: After Longbeard Elder commits to a quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a location, place 1 progress token on the current quest. Otherwise, Longbeard Elder gets -1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Path of Need
cards.rulesText:
Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a location.
Heroes do not exhaust to attack, defend, or commit to a quest while attached location is the active location.
cards.flavor:
"However it may prove, one must tread the path that need chooses!"
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Trollshaw Scout
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Trollshaw Scout does not exhaust to attack. Forced: After Trollshaw Scout attacks, either discard it from play or discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Heavy Stroke
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Dwarf deals X damage to an enemy during combat, deal an additional X damage to that enemy. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Imladris Stargazer
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Imladris Stargazer to choose a player. That player looks at the top 5 cards of his deck and then returns them to the top of his deck in any order.

cards.name: Light of Valinor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attached hero does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
cards.flavor:
"... those who have dwelt in the blassed realm live at once in both worlds, and against both the Seen and Unseen they have great power."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Daeron's Runes
cards.rulesText: Action: Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor:
"These are Daeron's Runes, such as were used of old in Moria..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Healing Herbs
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] hero. Action: Discard Healing Herbs and exhaust attached hero to heal all damage on 1 character.

cards.name: Asfaloth
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Action: Exhaust Asfaloth to place 1 progress token on any location. (2 tokens instead if attached hero is Glorfindel.)
cards.flavor: Suddenly into view below came a white horse, gleaming in the shadows, running swiftly. In the dusk its headstall flickered and flashed as if it were studded with gems like living stars. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ho! Tom Bombadil!
cards.rulesText: Setup: The first player adds this card to his hand. Response: Add this card to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool to cancel the "when revealed" effects of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
By fire, sun and moon, harken now and hear us!
 Come, Tom Bombadil, for our need is near us!
 -Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Alagos
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After an Eagle ally enters a player’s play area, add 1 resource to the pool of a hero that player controls. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
“What is all this uproar in the forest tonight?”
—The Lord of the Eagles, The Hobbit

cards.name: Faunith
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Quest Action: Play an Eagle ally from your hand. Then, you may exhaust that ally to either commit it to the quest or deal 1 damage to an enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: Straight down upon the Nazgûl they bore, stooping suddenly out of the high airs… —The Return of the King

cards.name: Messenger of Manwë
cards.rulesText: Cannot defend or have restricted attachments. Response: After Messenger of Manwë enters your play area, give an Eagle or Noble hero you control +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Response: After Messenger of Manwë commits to the quest, give control of it to another player.

cards.name: Veteran Eagle
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Veteran Eagle enters your play area, each copy of Veteran Eagle you control gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: But eagles have keen eyes and can see small things at a great distance. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Chieftain of the Skies
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Chieftain of the Skies enters your play area, ready an ally you control.
cards.flavor: Behind them in long swift lines came all their vassals from the northern mountains. —The Return of the King

cards.name: Box of Earth
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Box of Earth to choose a location. Place 1 progress on that location and give it the Forest trait until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
“It will not keep you on your road, nor defend you against any peril; but if you keep it… it may reward you.”
—Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Roving Herbmaster
cards.rulesText: Response: After a player reduces their threat, heal 1 damage from a character you control. Then, you may give control of Roving Herbmaster to another player. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
“Crush one in the water, and wash the wound clean, and I will bind it. Now it is your turn.”
—Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Grip
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Grip enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Fang
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Fang enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Wolf
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Cannot have attachments. Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost. Response: After Wolf enters play, search your deck for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. Until the end of the phase, that ally does not require a resource match. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: …most ferocious of the three… —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Hidden Roosts
cards.rulesText: Response: When an Eagle ally leaves play, that ally’s controller reduces their threat by X, where X is the printed cost of the ally. If X is 2 or less, that player also draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: “May the wind under your wings bear you where the sun sails and moon walks.” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

cards.name: Breath of Arda
cards.rulesText: Encounter Action: Return X Eagle allies you own (under any player’s control) to your hand. Then, put each of those allies into play under any player’s control, one at a time. Remove Breath of Arda from the game.
cards.flavor: “For we have need of speed greater than any wind.” —Gandalf, The Return of the King

cards.name: Golden Crown
cards.rulesText: Attach to an Eagle hero. Attached hero gains the Noble trait. Action: Exhaust Golden Crown to choose an Eagle ally you own under any player’s control. Either give control of that ally to a different player, or discard that ally from play to add 1 resource to attached hero’s pool.

cards.name: Guided by Fate
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Response: When you would shuffle a set-aside card with the encounter keyword into the encounter deck, shuffle it into the top 5 cards instead. Action: If the encounter deck has 5 or more cards in it, exhaust Guided by Fate and raise your threat by 1 to shuffle the top card of the encounter discard pile into the top 5 cards of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Denethor
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add 2 resources to Denethor's resource pool. Action: Move 1 resource from Denethor's resource pool to another Gondor hero's resource pool. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "...why should I sit here in my tower and think, and watch, and wait, spending even my sons? For I can still wield a brand." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Rod of the Steward
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor hero. Action: Spend 2 resources from attached hero's resource pool to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"The last Steward of Gondor begs leave to surrender his office." And he held out a white rod.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: In Service of the Steward
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Gondor trait.
cards.flavor:
But be it known that I have now sworn him to my service...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Azain Silverbeard
cards.rulesText: Response: After Azain Silverbeard participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, spend 1 [tactics] resource to deal 2 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the destroyed enemy. Any player may trigger this response.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Warrior character is destroyed while defending against an enemy attack, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to that character's printed [attack].
cards.flavor:
In a grave alone under the shadow of the Hornburg lay Háma, captain of the King's guard. He fell before the Gate.
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.rulesText: Glorfindel can be played from your discard pile. Action: Discard a card from your hand to ready Glorfindel. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"He is an Elf-lord of a house of princes."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Tides of Fate
cards.rulesText: Response: When a shadow card increases an enemy's [attack] by any amount, increase the defending character's [defense] by 3 for that attack. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [tactics] resources to ready the defending character and give it +3 [attack] for its next attack this phase.
cards.flavor:
...the tides of fate hd turned against them and their doom was at hand.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Imladris Caregiver
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard a card from your hand to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit twice per round).
cards.flavor:
"You are in Rivendell, and you need not worry about anything for the present."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Heed the Dream
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. That player searches the top 5 cards of his deck for a card, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck. Then, the players as a group may spend 3 [leadership] resources to have that player search his deck for another card, add it to his hand, and shuffle his deck.

cards.name: Guardian of Rivendell
cards.rulesText: As an additional cost to play Guardian of Rivendell from your hand, you must discard 2 cards from your hand.
cards.flavor:
"Indeed there is a power in Rivendell to withstand the might of Mordor, for a while."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Vanish from Sight
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control 2 or fewer heroes. Action: Until the end of the phase, if your threat is higher than 20, treat your threat as if it is 20.
cards.flavor:
"I see now little hope, if we do not soon vanish from sight for a while, and cover our trail."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play,the players lose the game. While Aragorn has an Artifact attached, he gains sentinel and does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
"I have no help to send, therefore I must go myself..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Éowyn
cards.rulesText: Setup: Reduce your threat by 3. Action: Raise your threat by 3 to ready Éowyn. She gets +9 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per game for the group.)
cards.flavor:
"But no living man am I! You look upon a woman. Éowyn I am, Éomund's daughter."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Beregond
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Beregond defends an attack and takes no damage, reduce the defending player's threat by 1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"The Lord does not permit those who wear the black and silver to leave their post for any cause..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Grimbold
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Discard Grimbold to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor:
Grimbold's men turned aside and passed round to a great gap in the wall further eastward.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Prince Imrahil
cards.rulesText: While there is a hero in your discard pile, Prince Imrahil loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type.
cards.flavor:
"We must gather all of the strength that we can find."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Halbarad
cards.rulesText:
Reduce the cost to play Halbarad by 1 for each enemy engaged with you.
Each enemy engaged with you gets +10 engagement cost.
cards.flavor:
"Halbarad Dúnadan, Ranger of the North I am..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ghân-buri-Ghân
cards.rulesText: X is the [threat] of the active location. Travel Action: Discard Ghân-buri-Ghân to travel to a location without resolving its Travel effect.
cards.flavor:
"Ghân-buri-Ghân will not lead you into trap."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Sterner than Steel
cards.rulesText: Response: Exhaust a Weapon or Armor card attached to the defending character to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
cards.flavor:
"Do what you will; but I will hinder it, if I may."
<cite>Éowyn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Desperate Defense
cards.rulesText: Response: After a sentinel character is declared as a defender, it gets +2 [defense] for this attack. If this attack deals no damage, ready the defending character.
cards.flavor: ...but alone in the porch upon the topmost step stood Beregond, clad in the black and silver of the Guard; and he held the door against them. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Golden Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender, exhaust Golden Shield to add attached hero's [willpower] to it's [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor: His golden shield was uncovered, and lo! it shone like an image of the Sun... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Livery of the Tower
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor hero. Restricted. Response: Spend X resources from attached hero's pool to cancel X damage just dealt to attached hero.
cards.flavor:
This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Roheryn
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain hero. If the attached hero is Aragorn, he gains a [tactics] icon. Response: After you optionally engage an enemy, exhaust Roheryn and attached hero to declare attached hero as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against that enemy.
cards.flavor:
"Aragorn's own horse that they had brought from the North; Roheryn was his name."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Banner of Elendil
cards.rulesText:
Attach to Aragorn.
While Aragorn is commited to the quest, each other questing character you control gets +1 [willpower].
While Aragorn is attacking, each other attacking character you control gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor:
Seven stars were about it, and a high crown above it, the signs of Elendil that no lord had borne for years beyond count.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Esquire of Rohan
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Rohan trait. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] while attacking with another Rohan character.
cards.flavor: "Rise now, Meriadoc, esquire of Rohan of the household of Meduseld!" -Théoden, The Return of the King

cards.name: Esquire of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] while committed to the quest with another Gondor character.
cards.flavor: "Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor, and to the Lord and Steward of the realm..." -Pippin, The Return of the King

cards.name: Overcome by Fear
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to your threat dial. Limit 1 per threat dial. Your threat cannot be reduced. Forced: At the end of the round, raise your threat by 1. Then you may spend 1 [fellowship] resource to detach Overcome by Fear and set it aside, out of play.

cards.name: Wraith on Wings
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add Wraith on Wings to the staging area. Cannot have non-Morgul attachments. Wraith on Wings gets +1 [threat] and -1 enagement cost for each resource on it. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, place 1 resource on Wraith on Wings (Limit 5 resources.)

cards.name: Army of the Dead
cards.rulesText: Immune to player card effects. The first player gains control of Army of the Dead. Setup: The first player takes control of Army of the Dead. If Army of the Dead leaves play, remove it from the game.
cards.flavor: "Now come! By the Black Stone I call you!" -Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: The first player draws 1 additional card in the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"Well, my dear fellow," said Bilbo, "now you've heard the news, can't you spare me a moment? I want your help in something urgent."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Mark
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains +1 [attack] Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Mark to another hero.

cards.name: Campfire Tales
cards.rulesText: Action: Each player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: "It is a fair tale, though it is sad, as are all the tales of Middle-earth, and yet it may lift up your hearts." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Winged Guardian
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Winged Guardian cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After an attack in which Winged Guardian defends resolves, pay 1 [tactics] resource or discard Winged Guardian from play.

cards.name: The Eagles Are Coming!
cards.rulesText: Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Eagle cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "The Eagles! The Eagles!" <cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Westfold Horse-breaker
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Westfold Westfold Horse-breaker to choose and ready a hero.
cards.flavor: "Your own valour has done more, and the stout legs of the Westfold-men marching through the night." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Mustering the Rohirrim
cards.rulesText: Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for any 1 Rohan ally card and add it to your hand. Then, shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "More speed we cannot make, if the strength of Rohan is to be gathered." <cite>Éomer, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Rivendell Minstrel
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Rivendell Minstrel from your hand, search your deck for 1 Song card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: As Elrond entered and went towards the seat prepared for him, Elvish minstrels began to make sweet music. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Strider's Path
cards.rulesText: Response: After a location is revealed from the encounter deck, immediately travel to that location without resolving its Travel effect. If another location is currently active, return it to the staging area.
cards.flavor: "My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Song of Kings
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [leadership] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
From the ashes a fire shall be woken,
A light from the shadows shall spring:
Renewed shall be blade that was broken,
The crownless again shall be king.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Brand son of Bain
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Brand son of Bain attacks and defeats an enemy engaged with another player, choose and ready one of that player's characters.
cards.flavor:
"The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard."
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Keen-eyed Took
cards.rulesText: Response: After Keen-eyed Took enters play, reveal the top card of each player's deck. Action: Return Keen-eyed Took to your hand to discard the top card of each player's deck.
cards.flavor:
Then something Tookish woke up inside him...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Rear Guard
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Discard a [leadership] ally to give each hero committed to this quest +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
In the dark at the rear, grim and silent, walked Aragorn.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Descendant of Thorondor
cards.rulesText: Descendant of Thorondor cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Descendant of Thorondor enters or leaves play, deal 2 damage to any 1 enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Meneldor's Flight
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an Eagle ally. Return that character to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor:
Not event an eagle poised against the sun would have marked the hobbits sitting there, under the weight of doom...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: The Riddermark's Finest
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust and discard The Riddermark's Finest to place 2 progress tokens on any location.
cards.flavor:
"And there are no horses like the ones that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ride to Ruin
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard a Rohan ally to choose a location. Place 3 progress tokens on that location.
cards.flavor:
"Death! Ride, ride to ruin and the world's ending!"
<cite>Éomer, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gildor Inglorion
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Gildor Inglorion to look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Switch one of those cards with a card from your hand. Then, return the 3 cards to the top of your deck, in any order.
cards.flavor: "Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Gildor's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Play during the Quest phase, before characters are committed to the Quest. Action: Reveal 1 less card from the encounter deck this phase. (To a minimum of 1.)
cards.flavor:
"The wide world is all about you: you can fence yourselves in, but you cannot for ever fence it out."
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Song of Travel
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [spirit] resource icon.
cards.flavor:
The Road goes ever on and on
Down from the door where it began.
Now far ahead the road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Beregond
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Lower the cost to play Weapon and Armor attachments on Beregond by 2.
cards.flavor: "It is over-late to send for aid when you are already besiged." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Boromir
cards.rulesText: While Boromir has at least 1 resource in his resource pool, Gondor allies get +1 [attack].
cards.flavor: "By our valour the wild fold of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay..." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Errand-rider
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Errand-rider to move 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero you control to another hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: For the people of the City used horses very little and they were seldom seen in their streets, save only those ridden by the errand-riders of their lord. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Citadel Custodian
cards.rulesText: Lower the cost to play Citadel Custodian by 1 for each Gondor ally in play.

cards.name: Mutual Accord
cards.rulesText: Action: Until the end of the phase, each Gondor card in play gains the Rohan trait, and each Rohan card in play gains the Gondor trait.
cards.flavor: "These are the Rohirrim, as we name them, masters of horses... and have ever proved true to us, aiding us at need, and guarding our northern marches and the Gap of Rohan." <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Wealth of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Gondor hero. Add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: Kings made tombs more splendid than houses of the living, and counted old names in the rolls of their descent dearer than the names of sons. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Defender of Rammas
cards.flavor: "And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Behind Strong Walls
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready a defending Gondor character. That character gets +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: ...seven walls of stone so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded by carven by giants out of the bones of the earth. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Spear of the Citadel
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a [tactics] character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After attached character is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Damrod
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Damrod from play to lower your threat by 1 for each enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Light the Beacons
cards.rulesText: Action: All characters get +2 [defense] and do not exhaust to defend until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "The beacons of Gondor are alight, calling for aid." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: A Watchful Peace
cards.rulesText: Response: After a location worth no victory points leaves play as an explored location, return it to the top of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Blood of Númenor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor or Dúnedain hero. Action: Spend 1 resource from attached hero's resource pool to give attached hero +1 [defense] for each resource in its resource pool until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Numenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten." <cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hunter of Lamedon
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Hunter of Lamedon from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an Outlands card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, discard it.
cards.flavor: From Lamedon, a few grim hillmen without a captain. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ithilien Tracker
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Ithilien Tracker to lower the [threat] of the next enemy added to the staging area to 0 until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: Green gauntlets covered their hands, and their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes, which were very keen and bright. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Master of Lore
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Master of Lore to name a card type. Lower the cost for you to play the next [lore] card of that type by 1 until the end of the phase (to a minimum of 1).
cards.flavor: "If Cirith Ungol is named, old men and masters of lore will blanch and fall silent." <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ranger Spikes
cards.rulesText:
Play Ranger Spikes into the staging area unattached.
If unattached, attach Ranger Spikes to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area.
Players do not make engagement checks against attached enemy. Attached enemy gets -2 [threat].

cards.name: Envoy of Pelargir
cards.rulesText: Response: After Envoy of Pelargir enters play, add 1 resource to a Gondor or Noble hero's resource pool.

cards.name: Prince Imrahil
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character leaves play, ready Prince Imrahil. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: But beyond, in the great fief of Belfalas, dwelt Prince Imrahil in his castle of Dol Amroth by the sea, and he was of high blood, and his fold also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes. <cite>The Return of the King.</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Quest
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains +1 [willpower] Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Quest to another hero.

cards.name: Parting Gifts
cards.rulesText: Action: Move any number of resource tokens from a [leadership] hero's resource pool to any other hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: Inside the hall there was piled a large assortment of packages and parcels and small articles of furniture. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Landroval
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Landroval cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After a hero card is destroyed, return Landroval to his owner's hand to put that hero back into play, with 1 damage token on it. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: To the Eyrie
cards.rulesText: Response: After an ally is destroyed, exhaust 1 Eagle character to move that ally from the discard pile to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: The pale peaks of the mountains were coming nearer, moonlit spikes of rock sticking out of black shadows. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Escort from Edoras
cards.rulesText: While committed to a quest, Escort from Edoras gets +2 [willpower] Forced: After resolving a quest to which Escort from Edoras was committed, discard Escort from Edoras from play.

cards.name: Ancient Mathom
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Response: After attached location is explored, the first player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: The Mathom-house it was called; for anything that Hobbits had no immediate use for, but were unwilling to throw away, they called a mathom. Their dwellings were apt to become rather crowded with mathoms... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Haldir of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel.
cards.flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Infighting
cards.rulesText: Action: Move any number of damage from one enemy to another.
cards.flavor: That's cursed rebel-talk, and I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see? <cite>Orc Soldier, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Radagast
cards.rulesText: Radagast collects 1 resource each resource phase. These resources can be used to pay for Creature cards played from your hand. Action: Spend X resources from Radagast's pool to heal X wounds on any 1 Creature.
cards.flavor: "I have an urgent errand. My news is evil."

cards.name: Dwalin
cards.rulesText: Response: After Dwalin attacks and destroys an Orc enemy, lower your threat by 2.
cards.flavor:
It was a dwarf with a blue beard tucked into a golden belt, and very bright eyes under his dark-green hood.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Bifur
cards.rulesText: Action: Pay 1 resource from a hero's resource pool to add 1 resource to Bifur's resource pool. Any player may trigger this ability. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "And winter comes after autumn." <cite>Bifur, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Narvi's Belt
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust Narvi's Belt to give attached hero a [leadership], [lore], [tactics] or [spirit] icon until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Durin's Song
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Dwarf hero. That hero gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
A king he was on carven throne
In many-pillared halls of stone
With golden roof and silver floor,
