And runes of power upon the door.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ever Onward
cards.rulesText: Response: After players quest unsuccessfully, choose a player. That player does not raise his threat.

cards.name: Veteran of Nanduhirion
cards.rulesText: Veteran of Nanduhirion enters play with 1 damage on it.
cards.flavor: With cries of "Moria!" and "Dain, Dain!" the dwarves of the Iron Hills plunged in... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Dwarrowdelf Axe
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Dwarf character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] Response: After attached character attacks, deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
cards.flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." <cite>Gloin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Khazâd! Khazâd!
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Dwarf character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 [attack].

cards.name: Zigil Miner
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Zigil Miner and name a number to discard the top 2 cards of your deck. If at least one of those cards has cost equal to the named number, choose a hero you control. For each card that matches the named number, add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.

cards.name: Untroubled by Darkness
cards.rulesText: Action: Each Dwarf character gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (+2 [willpower] instead if the active location is an Underground or Dark location.)

cards.name: Erebor Record Keeper
cards.rulesText: Erebor Record Keeper cannot attack or defend. Action: Exhaust Erebor Record Keeper and pay 1 [lore] resource to choose and ready a Dwarf character.

cards.name: Ancestral Knowledge
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a Dwarf character to place 2 progress tokens on the active location. (4 progress tokens instead if it is an Underground or Mountain location.)

cards.name: Boots from Erebor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Limit 1 Boots from Erebor per character. Attached character gets +1 hit point.

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to give Frodo Baggins +2 [willpower] and +2 [attack] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "It's my doom, I think, to go to that Shadow yonder, so that a way will be found." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Faramir
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After you engage an enemy, ready an ally you control. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "That will be the Captain: he can master both beasts and men" <cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Damrod
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost of the first Trap card you play each round by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Response: After a Trap card you control is attached to an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "See! Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Anborn
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy is added to the staging area, exhaust Anborn to give that enemy +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, deal 1 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Now I have him at arrow-point." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Mablung
cards.rulesText: Response: After Mablung enters play, choose an enemy to get +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, you may engage that enemy, or return it to the staging area.
cards.flavor: "But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Skinbark
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. While Skinbark is attacking alone against an Orc enemy, that enemy does not count its [defense].
cards.flavor: "He was wounded by the Orcs, and many of his folk and his tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Gamling
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Rohan ally you control is discarded from play, exhaust Gamling to return that ally to your hand.
cards.flavor: "...we have a thousand fit to fight on foot," said Gamling, an old man, the leader of those that watched the Dike. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Staff of Lebethron
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor or Hobbit hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero exhausts to defend an attack from an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat, exhaust Staff of Lebethron to discard a shadow card from that enemy.
cards.flavor: "They are made of the fair tree lebethron, beloved of the woodwrights of Gondor..." <cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ambush
cards.rulesText: Play Ambush into the staging area unattached. If unattached, attach Ambush to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area. Combat Action: The engaged player discards Ambush to declare an attack against the attached enemy.
cards.flavor: "But we have a new errand on this journey: we come to ambush the Men of Harad." <cite>Mablung, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Snowmane
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. If attached hero is Theoden, Snowmane loses the restricted keyword. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: Suddenly the king cried to Snowmane and the horse sprang away. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Taste it Again!
cards.rulesText: Response: After a hero you control defends an attack made by an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat, ready that hero. Until the end of the phase, that hero gets +2 [attack] while attacking that enemy.
cards.flavor: "We're going on; but we'll settle with you first. Come on, and taste it again!" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: In the Shadows
cards.rulesText: Lower the cost to play In the Shadows by 1 for each Hobbit or Ranger hero you control. Combat Action: Each enemy engaged with you with engagement cost higher than your threat gets -1 [attack] and -1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: He could see them stealing up the slopes, singly or in long files, keeping always to the shade of grove or thicket... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Speak Your Promise!
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready the Ring-bearer to choose an enemy engaged with you. If the Ring-bearer's [willpower] is greater than that enemy’s [threat], lower that enemy's [attack] and [defense] by the difference until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: For a moment it appeared to Sam that his master had grown and Gollum had shrunk... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Brace of Coneys
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control the Ring-bearer. Planning Action: Add Brace of Coneys to the victory display to (choose 2): heal up to 2 damage from a hero, add 2 resources to a hero's pool, choose a player to draw 2 cards, or reduce a player's threat by 2.
cards.flavor: "'Sméagol always helps,' he said. 'He has brought rabbits, nice rabbits.'" -Gollum, The Two Towers

cards.name: The Searching Eye
cards.rulesText: The Searching Eye functions like a player card. Forced: After you draw this card, either exhaust each hero you control, or reveal the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: ...that horrible growing sense of a hostile will that strove with great power to pierce all shadows of cloud, and earth, and flesh... -The Two Towers

cards.name: A Heavy Burden
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Forced: At the end of the planning phase, either raise each player's threat by 1, or exhaust the Ring-bearer.
cards.flavor: "It's heavy on me, Sam lad, very heavy. I wonder how far I can carry it?" -Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers

cards.name: Kahliel
cards.rulesText: You may use resources from Kahliel's resource pool to pay for Harad ally cards of any sphere. Action: Discard a Harad ally card from your hand to ready a Harad character in play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
...the Southrons were bold men and grim...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Andrath Guardsman
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Andrath Guardsman from your hand, choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. That enemy cannot attack you this round.
cards.flavor:
They forgot or ignored what little they had known of the Guardians, and of the labours of those that made possible the long peace of the Shire.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Prepare for Battle
cards.rulesText:
Limit 1 copy of Prepare for Battle in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first player draws an additional card during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"Soon there will be battle on the fields. A sortie must be made ready."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Yazan
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Yazan is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy in play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Wait no Longer
cards.rulesText: Response: At the beginning of the quest phase, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for an enemy and put it into play engaged with you. Then, reveal one less encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0). Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait upon him for the move."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Jubayr
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Jubayr exhausts to defend an attack, discard 1 facedown shadow card from a non-unique enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Dwarf Pipe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After a card is discarded from your deck, exhaust Dwarf Pipe to place that card on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor:
He held up a small pipe with a wide flattened bowl...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Firyal
cards.rulesText: Response: After Firyal commits to the quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may discard the looked at card.

cards.name: Coney in a Trap
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Ranger trait and another unique character with the Warrior trait. Response: After you engage an enemy, that enemy cannot attack you until the end of the round.

cards.name: Kahliel's Headdress
cards.rulesText: Attach to Kahliel. Restricted. Each Harad character gets +1[willpower]. Refresh Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Headdress to shuffle the topmost Harad ally in your discard pile into your deck.

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bilbo Baggins commits to the quest, choose an enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, Bilbo Baggins gets +X [willpower] where X is that enemy’s [threat]. If the players quest successfully, deal 1 damage to that enemy (2 damage instead if it is guarding a card).

cards.name: Greenwood Defender
cards.rulesText: Response: After Greenwood Defender enters play, it does not exhaust to defend until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: ...after the coming of Men they took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Elf Guide
cards.rulesText: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a hero. Add 1 resource to that hero’s pool.
cards.flavor: ...soon Haldir turned aside into the trees and halted on the bank of the river under their shadows. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Gaffer Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Return Gaffer Gamgee to your hand to choose an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "Why? Why’s none of my business, or yours." —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Drinking Song
cards.rulesText: Action: Count the number of cards in your hand and shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw an equal number of cards. Draw 1 additional card if you control a unique Hobbit character.
cards.flavor:
Ho! Ho! Ho! to the bottle I go 
To heal my heart and drown my woe. 
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Sting
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy). Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy, deal 1 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Round Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Restricted. Response: After a shadow effect is triggered during combat, exhaust Round Shield to give attached character +2 [defense] for this attack.

cards.name: Erebor Toymaker
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Erebor Toymaker from your hand, reduce the cost of the next attachment played this phase by 2.
cards.flavor: There were toys the like of which they had never seen before, all beautiful and some obviously magical. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Armor of Erebor
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a Dale or Dwarf character. Restricted. 
Attached character gets +1 [defense] and gains sentinel.
cards.flavor: "We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came." —Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Shirefolk
cards.rulesText: Play only if each of your heroes is a Hobbit. Action: Reduce your threat by 4.
cards.flavor: "If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world." —Thorin Oakenshield, The Hobbit

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Exhaust The One Ring to add 1 resource to a hero's pool.
cards.flavor: "I must carry the burden to the end." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. The first player gains control of Aragorn. Action: Spend 1 resource from Aragorn's pool to ready him. (Limit once per phase.) If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor: "As I have begun, so I will go on.." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Éomer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Éomer commits to the quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to immediately declare him as an attacker (and resolve his attack) against an enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor: ...he was young, and he was king; the lord of a fell people. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Tom Cotton
cards.rulesText: While you are engaged with an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, the first Hobbit ally you play each round does not require a resource match. Response: After a Hobbit ally enters play, it gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round.

cards.name: Rosie Cotton
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Rosie Cotton to choose a Hobbit hero and an attribute ([willpower], [attack], [defense]). Add Rosie Cotton's [willpower] to that hero's chosen attribute until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "…take care of yourself, and come straight back as soon as you have settled the ruffians!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elfhelm
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 resource from a Rohan hero's resource pool to put Elfhelm into play from your hand under your control. At the end of the phase, discard Elfhelm if he is still in play.
cards.flavor: "...my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness; orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elladan
cards.rulesText: While Elrohir is in play, Elladan gets +2 [attack]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elladan.
cards.flavor: ...they rode often far afield with the Rangers of the North, forgetting never their mother's torment in the dens of the Orcs. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elrohir
cards.rulesText: While Elladan is in play, Elrohir gets +2 [defense]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elrohir.
cards.flavor: "From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Captains of the West
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Until the end of the phase, each Noble hero gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to commit to the quest.
cards.flavor: "...there are names among us that are worth more than a thousand mail-clad knights apiece." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Raise the Shire
cards.rulesText: Response: After you engage an enemy, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and put it into play (search you entire deck instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat). Shuffle your deck. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
cards.flavor: …come on now, lads! Bywater is up! We must be in it!" <cite>Tom Cotton, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gúthwinë
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Gúthwinë to give that hero +2 [attack] for this attack. If this attack destroys an enemy, return a Rohan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Gúthwinë!" cried Éomer. "Gúthwinë for the Mark!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Friend of Friends
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 2 copies of Friend of Friends in play. While another hero has Friend of Friends attached, attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "Come, Mr. Frodo!" he cried, "I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you and it as well." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Orc Disguise
cards.rulesText: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Limit one per hero. While an Orc is making an enagement check with you, it gets +5 engagement cost. Response: After an Orc engages you, discard Orc Disguise. . Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc…" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gwaihir
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel. When Revealed: The first player must choose: either take control of Gwaihir, or spend 1 [fellowship] resource and discard Gwaihir to discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Shadow: This attack deals no damage.

cards.name: (MotK) Ingold
cards.rulesText: Ingold gets +1 [willpower] for each hero you control with at least 1 resource in its resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"We wish for no strangers in the land at this time, unless they be mighty men of arms in whose faith and help we can trust."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Galadriel
cards.rulesText: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play. Response: After you play Galadriel from your hand, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment of cost 3 or less and put it into play. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

cards.name: (MotK) Merry
cards.rulesText: Response: After Merry enters play, each unique ally you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"Shire-folk have been so comfortable so long they don"t know what to do. They just want a match, though, and they"ll go up in fire."
-The Return of the King

cards.name: (MotK) Azain Silverbeard
cards.rulesText: Response: After Azain Silverbeard participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, spend 1 [tactics] resource to deal 2 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the destroyed enemy. Any player may trigger this response.

cards.name: (MotK) Boromir
cards.rulesText: Boromir gets +2 [defense] while defending against an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After Boromir takes any amount of damage, ready him.

cards.name: (MotK) Gimli
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
cards.flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Anborn
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy is added to the staging area, exhaust Anborn to give that enemy +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, deal 1 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Now I have him at arrow-point." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Grimbold
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Discard Grimbold to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor:
Grimbold's men turned aside and passed round to a great gap in the wall further eastward.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Yazan
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Yazan is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to a non-unique enemy in play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
...he and his knights still held themselves like lords in whom the race of Númenor ran true.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Pippin
cards.rulesText: Pippin gets +2 [attack] while attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, ready Pippin.
cards.flavor:
"Down on your knees in the road and ask pardon, or I will set this troll"s bane in you!"
-The Return of the King

cards.name: (MotK) Elrond
cards.rulesText: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play. Response: After Elrond enters play, choose one: heal all damage on a hero, discard a Condition attachment, or each player draws 1 card.

cards.name: (MotK) Legolas
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Mablung
cards.rulesText: Response: After Mablung enters play, choose an enemy to get +5 engagement cost until the end of the round. Then, you may engage that enemy, or return it to the staging area.
cards.flavor: "But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Prince Imrahil
cards.rulesText: While there is a hero in your discard pile, Prince Imrahil loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type.
cards.flavor:
"We must gather all of the strength that we can find."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Rosie Cotton
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Rosie Cotton to choose a Hobbit hero and an attribute ([willpower], [attack], [defense]). Add Rosie Cotton's [willpower] to that hero's chosen attribute until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "?take care of yourself, and come straight back as soon as you have settled the ruffians!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Faramir
cards.rulesText: Response: After Faramir enters play, choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Engage that enemy and deal 2 damage to it (4 damage instead if it has an attachment on it).
cards.flavor:
"There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full."
-The Two Towers

cards.name: (MotK) Bofur
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to put Bofur into play from your hand, exhausted and committed to a quest. If you quest successfully this phase and Bofur is still in play, return him to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Get up lazy-bones..." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Glorfindel
cards.rulesText: Glorfindel can be played from your discard pile. Action: Discard a card from your hand to ready Glorfindel. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"He is an Elf-lord of a house of princes."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Fili
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Fili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Kili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: (MotK) Glóin
cards.rulesText: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Glóin gains: "Response: After you play Glóin from your hand, choose a hero. Add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool."
cards.flavor: Glóin lit several more torches, and then they all crept out, one by one... <cite> The Hobbit </cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Bill the Pony
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Lower the cost to play Bill the Pony by 2 if you control Sam Gamgee. Each Hobbit character gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak it: if you don't let me go with you, Sam, I'll follow on my own" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bilbo Baggins enters play, search your deck for a Pipe attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Elves may thrive on speech alone, and Dwarves endure great weariness, but I am an old Hobbit, and I miss my meal at noon." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Quickbeam
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Quickbeam enters play, deal 1 damage to him to ready him.
cards.flavor: "I am Bregalad, that is Quickbeam in your language. But it is only a nickname, of course." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Skinbark
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. While Skinbark is attacking alone against an Orc enemy, that enemy does not count its [defense].
cards.flavor: "He was wounded by the Orcs, and many of his folk and his tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Halbarad
cards.rulesText:
Reduce the cost to play Halbarad by 1 for each enemy engaged with you.
Each enemy engaged with you gets +10 engagement cost.
cards.flavor:
"Halbarad Dúnadan, Ranger of the North I am..."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Elfhelm
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 resource from a Rohan hero's resource pool to put Elfhelm into play from your hand under your control. At the end of the phase, discard Elfhelm if he is still in play.
cards.flavor: "...my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness; orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Jubayr
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Jubayr exhausts to defend an attack, discard 1 facedown shadow card from a non-unique enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: (MotK) Derufin
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Ranged. Response: After Derufin participates in an attack which destroys an enemy engaged with a player, discard Derufin to reduce the engaged player's threat by X, where X is the destroyed enemy's printed [threat].

cards.name: (MotK) Kili
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Kili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Fili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: (MotK) Bifur
cards.rulesText: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Bifur gains: "Response: After you play Bifur from your hand, draw 2 cards."
cards.flavor: "My cousins! Bombur and Bofur <cite> we have forgotten them, they are down in the valley!" ?The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Barliman Butterbur
cards.rulesText: If each hero you control has the Hobbit trait, damage from undefended attacks against you may be assigned to Barliman Butterbur.
cards.flavor: "But spooks or no spooks, they won't get in The Prancing Pony so easy." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Háma
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Ready Háma. He gets +3 [defense] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Háma. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I am the Doorward of Théoden," he said. "Háma is my name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Gamling
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Rohan ally you control is discarded from play, exhaust Gamling to return that ally to your hand.
cards.flavor: "...we have a thousand fit to fight on foot," said Gamling, an old man, the leader of those that watched the Dike. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Ghân-buri-Ghân
cards.rulesText: X is the [threat] of the active location. Travel Action: Discard Ghân-buri-Ghân to travel to a location without resolving its Travel effect.
cards.flavor:
"Ghân-buri-Ghân will not lead you into trap."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Elladan
cards.rulesText: While Elrohir is in play, Elladan gets +2 [attack]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elladan.
cards.flavor: ...they rode often far afield with the Rangers of the North, forgetting never their mother's torment in the dens of the Orcs. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Bofur
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Bofur to search the top 5 cards of your deck for 1 Weapon attachment. Add that card to your hand and shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: (MotK) Dwalin
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, lower the cost to play Dwalin by 2.

cards.name: (MotK) Farmer Maggot
cards.rulesText: Response: After Farmer Maggot enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Deal 2 damage instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat.)
cards.flavor: "It is lucky for you that I know you. I was going out to set my dogs on any strangers." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Elrohir
cards.rulesText: While Elladan is in play, Elrohir gets +2 [defense]. After you optionally engage an Orc enemy, ready Elrohir.
cards.flavor: "From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Firyal
cards.rulesText: Response: After Firyal commits to the quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may discard the looked at card.

cards.name: (MotK) Dori
cards.rulesText: Response: After a hero is assigned any amount of damage, exhaust Dori to place that damage on Dori instead.

cards.name: (MotK) Damrod
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Damrod from play to lower your threat by 1 for each enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: (MotK) Faramir
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end."
<cite>Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Brok Ironfist
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Dwarf hero you control leaves play, put Brok Ironfist into play from your hand.
cards.flavor:
...there is no knowing what a Dwarf will not dare and do for revenge and the recovery of his own.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Wiglaf
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Wiglaf, play an Item attachment on him from your hand for no cost. Action: Exhaust an attachment on Wiglaf to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: (MotK) Rúmil
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After you play Rúmil from your hand, choose an enemy engaged with a player. Deal X damage to that enemy where X is the number of ranged characters you control.
cards.flavor: ...the Company set out again, guided now by Haldir and his brother Rúmil. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Angbor the Fearless
cards.rulesText: While your threat is 40 or higher, Angbor the Fearless gets +2 [attack] and does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
"Four thousands I sent marching from Pelargir through Lossarnach two days ago; and Angbor the fearless rides before them."
-Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: (MotK) Éomund
cards.rulesText: Response: After Éomund leaves play, ready all Rohan characters in play.
cards.flavor: "You I have not seen before, for you are young, but I have spoken with Eomund your father..." <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Beorn
cards.rulesText: Action: Beorn gains +5 [attack] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase in which you trigger this effect, shuffle Beorn back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I don't need your service, thank you...but I expect you need mine." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Eldahir
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to look at a facedown shadow card dealt to an engaged enemy. If that card has a shadow effect, Eldahir gets +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: (MotK) Meneldor
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Meneldor enters or leaves play, place 2 progress on a location.
cards.flavor: ...Meneldor young and swift. -The Return of the King

cards.name: (MotK) Forlong
cards.rulesText: While you control Outlands allies that belong to 4 different spheres, ready Forlong at the beginning of each phase.
cards.flavor: "Forlong!" men shouted. "True heart, true friend!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Bombur
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Bombur to choose a location. That location gets -1 [threat] until the end of the phase. (That location does not contribute its [threat] instead if it is an Underground location.)

cards.name: (MotK) Sam Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Sam Gamgee by 2 if you control Frodo Baggins. Response: After a player raises his threat, that player may spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: (MotK) Landroval
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Landroval cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After a hero card is destroyed, return Landroval to his owner's hand to put that hero back into play, with 1 damage token on it. (Limit once per game.)

cards.name: (MotK) Haldir of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel.
cards.flavor: "But there are some of us still who go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies, and they speak the languages of other lands." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Denethor
cards.rulesText:
Denethor gets -1 [willpower] for each damaged hero you control.
Discard Denethor if his [willpower] is 0 or less.
cards.flavor: "Denethor is of another sort, proud and subtile, a man of far greater lineage and power, though he is not called a king." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Arwen Undómiel
cards.rulesText: Response: After Arwen Undómiel exhausts, choose a character. That character gains sentinel and gets +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
...in whom it was said that the likeness of Lúthien had come on earth again...for she was the Evenstar of her people.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Ceorl
cards.rulesText: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Ceorl. Then, you may give control of Ceorl to another player. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase).
cards.flavor:
He drew himself up. Then he knelt, offering his notched sword to the king. "Command me, lord!" he cried. 
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Gwaihir
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Gwaihir enters play, search your discard pile for an Eagle ally and put it into play under your control. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: "The North Wind blows, but we shall outfly it." <cite>Gwaihir, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Nori
cards.rulesText: Response: After Nori participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, put the top card of your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor:
"You've left the burglar behind again!"
-Nori, The Hobbit

cards.name: (MotK) Henamarth Riversong
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
"And I reckon there's Elves and Elves. They're all elvish enough, but they're not all the same."
<cite>Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Déorwine
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Action: While Déorwine is defending, spend 1 [leadership] resource to cancel a shadow effect dealt to the attacking enemy. Any player may trigger this action.

cards.name: (MotK) Gléowine
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Gléowine to choose a player. That player draws 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Then the Riders of the King's House upon white horses rode round about the barrow and sang together a song of Théoden Thengel's son that Gléowine his minstrel made...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Galion
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or defend. Response: After Galion enters play, he gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"Here am I waiting and waiting down here, while you fellows drink and make merry and forget your tasks. Small wonder if I fall asleep from weariness!"
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Erestor
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand to draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
Beside Glorfindel there were several other counsellors of Elrond's household, of whom Erestor was the chief...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Gildor Inglorion
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Gildor Inglorion to look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Switch one of those cards with a card from your hand. Then, return the 3 cards to the top of your deck, in any order.
cards.flavor: "Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes." <cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Odo Proudfoot
cards.rulesText: Response: After Odo Proudfoot enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor:
"ProudFEET! shouted an elderly hobbit from the back of the pavilion.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Robin Smallburrow
cards.rulesText: Response: After you travel to a location, spend 1 [spirit] resource to raise the engagement cost of each enemy in play by X until the end of the round, where X is that location's quest points. Any player may trigger this response.
cards.flavor:
"Gave me a chance of walking round the country and seeing folk, and hearing the news, and knowing where the good beer was."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Galdor of the Havens
cards.rulesText: Response: After 1 or more cards are discarded from your hand, draw 1 card. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor:
"But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy, the coming of Sauron at the last, when all else is overthrown?"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Elfhelm
cards.rulesText: While Elfhelm is ready, he gains: "Response: After your threat is raised as the result of questing unsuccessfully, or by an encounter or quest card effect, reduce your threat by 1."
cards.flavor: "Buy my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness: orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Guthlaf
cards.rulesText: If there is at least 1 Rohan hero in play, lower the cost to play Guthlaf by 1. If there is at least 1 Gondor hero in play, Guthlaf gains sentinel.

cards.name: (MotK) Emery
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard the top 3 card of your deck to put Emery into play from your hand, under any player's control. Then, if any of the discarded cards have the [tactics], [lore] or [leadership] sphere, discard Emery.

cards.name: (MotK) Anborn
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Anborn to return 1 Trap card from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
"I sent my keenest huntsmen to seek him, but he slipped them, and they had no sight of him till now, save Anborn."
<cite>Faramir, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Orophin
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Orophin enters play, return a Silvan ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Orophin has now gone in haste back to our dwellings to warn our people." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Gaffer Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Return Gaffer Gamgee to your hand to choose an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "Why? Why?s none of my business, or yours." ?The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Leaflock
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Leaflock gets +1 [willpower] for each damaged Ent character you control. (Limit +4 [willpower].)
cards.flavor: "Leaflock has grown sleepy, almost tree-ish, you might say?" Treebeard, The Two Towers

cards.name: (MotK) Ioreth
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or defend. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource and exhaust Ioreth. Then, heal 3 points of damage on a character. Any player may trigger this action.
cards.flavor: Thus spake Ioreth, wise-woman of Gondor: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Beechbone
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Beechbone is declared as an attacker, deal 1 damage to him to deal X damage to the defending enemy. X is the amount of damage on Beechbone.

cards.name: (MotK) Lindir
cards.rulesText: Response: After Lindir enters play, if you have less than 3 cards in your hand, draw until you have 3 cards in your hand.
cards.flavor:
"To sheep other sheep no doubt appear different," laughed Lindir. "Or to shepherds. But Mortals have not been our study. We have other business."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Haleth
cards.rulesText: Response: After Haleth quests successfully, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: (MotK) Halfast Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Halfast Gamgee by 1 for each side quest in the victory display. Response: After Halfast Gamgee enters play, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "He works for Mr. Boffin at Overhill and goes up to the Northfarthing for the hunting." -Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: (MotK) Éothain
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Rohan ally is discarded from play by a card effect, ready Éothain.
cards.flavor:
"We must hasten south, lord. Let us leave these wild folk to their fancies. Or let us bind them and take them to our king."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: (MotK) Súlien
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to exhaust Súlien. Then, each location in the staging area gets ?1 [threat] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After you play an attachment on a location, add 1 resource to the pool of a hero you control. (Limit once per round.) Quest Action: Choose a player to take control of the first player token. Each player can only be chosen once per game.

cards.name: Osbera
cards.rulesText: Side A Reduce the total [threat] in the staging area by 1 for each damaged Beorning character you control (limit –5 [threat]). Response: After you engage an enemy, spend 1 resource from Osbera’s pool to flip her. Side B Cannot have restricted attachments. If you are not engaged with an enemy, flip Osbera. Response: Deal 1 damage to a Beorning character you control to cancel 2 points of damage just dealt to a character you control. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
“I don’t need your service, thank you. But I expect you need mine.” —Beorn, The Hobbit
“Not eaten up by Wargs or goblins or wicked bears yet I see.” —Beorn, The Hobbit

cards.name: Woodmen's Outpost
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location. Response: After attached location is explored, each character controlled by the first player gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: “…even the Wargs dared not attack them if there were many together, or in the bright day.” —The Hobbit

cards.name: Lie of the Land
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Action: Exhaust a Scout character to place 1 progress on attached location. If that location is not explored by this effect, you may attach Lie of the Land to another location.
cards.flavor:
“We shall have to scour the lands all round for many long leagues before any move is made.”
—Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Hunting Dogs
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Cannot have attachments. Response: After a location with an attachment is explored, ready Hunting Dogs.
cards.flavor:
“Hound is hungry, hare is fearful.”
—Treebeard, The Two Towers

cards.name: Beorning Pony
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Response: After Beorning Pony enters play, discard the top 5 cards of your deck. Then, you may spend 1 [tactics] resource to add one of the cards discarded by this effect to your hand.
cards.flavor: There was just room to get the ponies through with a squeeze, when they had been unpacked and unsaddled. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Birna
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Birna and spend 1 [tactics] resource to put a Beorning ally from your discard pile into play. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play or in your discard pile, shuffle it into your deck.
cards.flavor: In that last hour Beorn himself had appeared - no one knew how or from where. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Descendants of Beorn
cards.rulesText: Response: When a Beorning ally you control leaves play, add 1 resource to a Beorning hero’s pool for each damage token that was on that ally (up to that ally’s printed hit points).
cards.flavor: He tossed wolves and goblins from his path like straws and feathers. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Beorn's Welcome
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Beorning hero. Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After you spend any resources from attached hero’s pool for a purpose other than paying to play a card, exhaust Beorn’s Welcome to add 1 resource to attached hero’s pool.
cards.flavor: “I am Gandalf,” said the wizard. “Never heard of him,” growled the man. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Subdued
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a damaged enemy engaged with you. Limit 1 per enemy.
Attached enemy gets –4 [attack].
cards.flavor: His miserable enemy lay grovelling on the stones whimpering. —The Two Towers

cards.name: Without My Hat
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 copy of Without My Hat in the victory display. Action: Add Without My Hat to the victory display to search your collection for an attachment. If no copy of that attachment was in your deck during setup, add it to your hand.

cards.name: Mablung
cards.rulesText: Response: After you engage an enemy, add 1 resource to Mablung's resource pool. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
But the Captains of the West were well warned by their scouts, skilled men from Henneth Annûn led by Mablung...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Follow Me!
cards.rulesText: Action: Take control of the first player token and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
"Come! I will lead you now!"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Tighten Our Belts
cards.rulesText: Refresh Action: Choose a player. Each hero that player controls that did not spend any resources this round gains 1 resource. Only 1 copy of Tighten Our Belts can be played by the players each round.
cards.flavor: There was nothing now to be done but to tighten the belts round their empty stomachs, and hoist their empty sacks and packs... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Galadhon Archer
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Galadhon Archer enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy not engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "...they say that you breathe so loud that they could shoot you in the dark." <cite>Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Bow of the Galadhrim
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Silvan character with the ranged keyword. Attached character gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attacking an enemy not engaged with you.)
cards.flavor: ...longer and stronger than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elf-hair. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Celduin Traveler
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 2. Response: After Celduin Traveler enters play, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If it is a location, you may discard it.
cards.flavor: In two days going they rowed right up the Long Lake and passed out into the River Running... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Island Amid Perils
cards.rulesText: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to reduce your threat by X where X is the printed cost of the ally returned to your hand.
cards.flavor:
"...we dare not by our own trust endanger our land. We live now upon an island amid many perils..." 
<cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Mirkwood Pioneer
cards.rulesText: You may give Mirkwood Pioneer doomed 1 when you play it from your hand. If you do, it gains: "Response: After you play Mirkwood Pioneer, choose a card in the staging area. Until the end of the round, the chosen card does not contribute its [threat]."

cards.name: Wingfoot
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Ranger hero. Response: After attached hero commits to a quest. name enemy, location or treachery. If a card of the named type is revealed during this quest phase, exhaust Wingfoot to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor:
"Wingfoot I name you. This deed of the three friends should be sung in many a hall. Forty leagues and five you have measured ere the forth day is ended!"
<cite>Éomer, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Defender of the West
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a non-objective unique ally in play.
The first player gains control of attached ally.
Damage from undefended attacks against you may be assigned to attached ally.
cards.flavor:
"...if by life or death I can save you, I will."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Bilbo Baggins cannot gain resources from player card effects. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Thorin Oakenshield
cards.rulesText: If you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, add 1 additional resource to Thorin Oakenshield's pool when you collect resources during the resource phase.
cards.flavor: "I am Thorin son of Thrain son of Thror, King under the Mountain!" <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Nori
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play a Dwarf character from your hand, reduce your threat by 1.
cards.flavor: "Nori, at your service." <cite>Nori, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Ori
cards.rulesText: If you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, draw 1 additional card at the beginning of the resource phase.
cards.flavor: "He could write well and speedily, and often used the Elvish characters." <cite>Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Beorn
cards.rulesText:
Sentinel. Cannot have attachments.
Immune to player card effects.
Beorn does not exhaust to defend.
cards.flavor:
The roar of his voice was like drums and guns; and he tossed wolves and goblins from his path like straws and feathers.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Fili
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Fili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Kili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Fili is the youngest and still has the best sight" —Thorin, The Hobbit

cards.name: Kili
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Kili from your hand during the planning phase, search your deck for Fili and put him into play under your control. Then, shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Let us join the throng!" —Kili, The Hobbit

cards.name: Bofur
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Bofur to search the top 5 cards of your deck for 1 Weapon attachment. Add that card to your hand and shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Dori
cards.rulesText: Response: After a hero is assigned any amount of damage, exhaust Dori to place that damage on Dori instead.

cards.name: Gandalf
cards.rulesText: Gandalf does not exhaust to commit to a quest. Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, discard Gandalf from play. You may raise your threat by 2 to cancel this effect.

cards.name: Cram
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Cram to ready attached hero.

cards.name: Spare Hood and Cloak
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Action: Exhaust Spare Hood and Cloak and exhaust attached character to ready another character. Then, attach Spare Hood and Cloak to that character.
cards.flavor: "You will have to manage without pocket-handkerchiefs, and a good many other things, before you get to the journey's end. As for a hat, I have got a spare hood and cloak in my luggage." <cite>Dwalin, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thrór's Map
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Travel Action: Discard Thrór's Map to choose a location in the staging area. Make that location the active location. (If there is another active location, return it to the staging area.)
cards.flavor: 'This was made by Thrór, your grandfather, Thorin.' he said in answer to the dwarves' excited questions. 'It is a plan of the Mountain.' <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: A Very Good Tale
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust 2 allies you control to shuffle your deck and discard the top 5 cards. Put up to 2 allies discarded by this effect into play under your control. The total cost of the allies put into play cannot exceed the total cost of the allies exhausted to pay for this effect.

cards.name: Foe-hammer
cards.rulesText: Response: After a hero you control attacks and destroys an enemy, exhaust a Weapon card attached to that hero to draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Goblin-cleaver
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Exhaust a Weapon card attached to a hero you control to choose an enemy engaged with you. Deal 2 damage to that enemy. (Deal 3 damage instead if the enemy is an Orc.)
cards.flavor: At this point Gandalf fell behind, and Thorin with him. They turned a sharp corner. 'About turn!' he shouted. 'Draw your sword, Thorin!' <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Late Adventurer
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Exhaust a character you control that is not committed to the quest to commit that character to the quest.
cards.flavor: To the end of his days Bilbo could never remember how he found himself outside, without a hat, walking-stick or any money, or anything that he usually took when he went out. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Expecting Mischief
cards.rulesText: Play during the quest phase, before the staging step. Action: Deal 2 damage to the first enemy revealed from the encounter deck this phase.

cards.name: Burglar Baggins
cards.rulesText: Action: Bilbo Baggins gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. (You may spend a [baggins] resource from Bilbo Baggins' resource pool to play this card even if you do not control Bilbo Baggins.)

cards.name: Sting
cards.rulesText: Attach to Bilbo Baggins. Restricted. Bilbo Baggins gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After Bilbo Baggins exhausts to defend, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the discarded card's [threat].
cards.flavor: "I shall call you Sting." <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Orcrist
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero destroys an Orc enemy, add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "This, Thorin, the runes name Orcrist, the Goblin-cleaver in the ancient tongue of Gondolin; it was a famous blade." <cite>Elrond, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Glamdring
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached character destroys an Orc enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "This, Gandalf, was Glamdring, Foe-hammer that the king of Gondolin once wore." ―Elrond, The Hobbit

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Bilbo Baggins does not count against the hero limit and cannot gain resources from non-treasure cards. The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins. Action: Spend 1 [baggins] resource to search your deck for a treasure card and add it to your hand. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players have lost the game.

cards.name: Balin
cards.rulesText: Response: Pay 1 resource from Balin's resource pool to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack. Then, deal the attacking enemy another shadow card. (Limit once per attack.)
cards.flavor: "Well, it is the first time that even a mouse has crept along carefully and quietly under my very nose and not been spotted." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Bard the Bowman
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
When Bard the Bowman makes a ranged attack, the enemy he attacks gets -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: Now he shot with a great yew bow, till all his arrows but one were spent. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Óin
cards.rulesText: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Óin gets +1 [attack] and gains the [tactics] resource icon.
cards.flavor: Dwarves can make fire almost anywhere out of almost anything, wind or no wind... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Bombur
cards.rulesText: When counting the number of Dwarf characters you control, Bombur counts as two.
cards.flavor: "Bombur is fattest and will do for two, he had better come alone and last." <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Glóin
cards.rulesText: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Glóin gains: "Response: After you play Glóin from your hand, choose a hero. Add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool."
cards.flavor: Glóin lit several more torches, and then they all crept out, one by one... <cite> The Hobbit </cite>

cards.name: Bifur
cards.rulesText: While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, Bifur gains: "Response: After you play Bifur from your hand, draw 2 cards."
cards.flavor: "My cousins! Bombur and Bofur <cite> we have forgotten them, they are down in the valley!" –The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Dwalin
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. While you control at least 5 Dwarf characters, lower the cost to play Dwalin by 2.
cards.flavor: As soon as the door was opened, he pushed inside, just as if he had been expected. –The Hobbit

cards.name: Straight Shot
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a Weapon attachment to choose a non-unique enemy with 0 [defense]. Discard the chosen enemy.
cards.flavor: In it smote and vanished, barb, shaft and feather, so fierce was its flight. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Desperate Alliance
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a hero you control. Until the end of the phase, give control of that hero and all resources in that hero's resource pool to another player. (Limit 1 per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Come!" called Gandalf. "There is yet time for council." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Ravens of the Mountain
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a hero you control to shuffle the encounter deck and look at its top card. Place progress tokens on the current quest equal to the [threat] of the card you looked at. Then, put that card back on top of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: As they worked the ravens brought them constant tidings. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: To me! O my kinsfolk!
cards.rulesText: Action: If you control at least 1 Dwarf hero, put a Dwarf ally from your discard pile into play under your control. Put that ally on the bottom of your deck at the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: Out leapt the King under the Mountain, and his companions followed him. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: The Lucky Number
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a character in play (other than Bilbo Baggins). Add Bilbo Baggins' total [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to that character's [willpower], [attack], and [defense] respectively until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"I am the clue-finder, the web-cutter, the stinging fly. I was chosen for the lucky number."
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Great Yew Bow
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero with the printed Ranged keyword. Restricted. Combat Action: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Exhaust Great Yew Bow and attached hero to make a ranged attack against that enemy. Declare attached hero as the attacker. No other attackers can be declared for this attack.

cards.name: Black Arrow
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a hero with Ranged. Response: After attached hero declares an attack, add Black Arrow to the victory display to give attached hero +5 [attack] for this attack.
cards.flavor: "I have saved you to the last..." <cite>Bard, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thrór's Key
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Response: After a location is added to the staging area, attach Thrór's Key to that location. While attached to a location, Thrór's Key gains: "Treat attached location's printed text box as blank, except for traits."
cards.flavor: "The key that went with the map! Try it now while there is still time!" <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Expert Treasure-hunter
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, name a card type and discard the top card of your deck. If the discarded card is the named type, take it into your hand.
cards.flavor: "Now I am a burglar indeed!" –Bilbo, The Hobbit

cards.name: King Under the Mountain
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust King Under the Mountain to look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and discard the other.
cards.flavor: "Long ago in my grandfather Thrór's time our family was driven out of the far North, and came back with all their wealth and tools to this Mountain on the map." <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
cards.rulesText: Attach to Bilbo Baggins. Action: Exhaust Bilbo's Magic Ring and raise your threat by 1 to gain 1 [baggins] resource. (Limit once per round.) Response: After Bilbo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust Bilbo's Magic Ring and raise your threat by 3 to cancel all damage from this attack.

cards.name: The Arkenstone
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust The Arkenstone and raise your threat by X to lower by X the cost of the next ally you play this phase that matches the attached hero's sphere.
cards.flavor: "...the Heart of the Mountain; and it is also the heart of Thorin. He values it above a river of gold." <cite>Bilbo, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Mithril Shirt
cards.rulesText:
Attach to Bilbo Baggins.
Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "Mr. Baggins!" he cried. "Here is the first payment of your reward! Cast off your old coat and put on this!" <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thrór's Battle Axe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, deal 1 damage to another enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: Royal indeed did Thorin look, clad in a coat of gold-plated rings, with a silver hafted axe... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thrór's Hunting Bow
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains Ranged.
When making a ranged attack, attached hero gets +2 [attack].
cards.flavor: Thorin seized a bow of horn and shot an arrow at the speaker. <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thrór's Golden Cup
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Thrór's Golden Cup to the victory display to draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: ...the great golden cup of Thrór, two-handed, hammered and carven with birds and flowers whose eyes and petals were of jewels... <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Thurindir
cards.rulesText: Thurindir gets +1 [willpower] for each side quest in the victory display. Setup: Search your deck for a side quest and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: “He is one of the wandering folk - Rangers we call them.” -Barliman Butterbur, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Kahliel's Tribesman
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Kahliel's Tribesman to choose another Harad character. That character gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: But the Haradrim, being now driven to the brink, turned at bay, and they were fierce in despair... -The Return of the King

cards.name: Steed of the North
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dunedain or Ranger hero. Restricted. Response: After you engage an enemy, exhaust Steed of the North to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: Their horses were strong and of proud bearing, but rough-haired... -The Return of the King

cards.name: Mighty Warrior
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Warrior trait. Response: After you play Mighty Warrior from your hand, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Gimli hewed the legs from another that had sprung up on Balin’s tomb. -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Proud Hunters
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Ranger trait. Response: After a hero you control participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, add X resources to that hero’s pool. X is the just destroyed enemy’s printed [threat].

cards.name: Dunedain Pathfinder
cards.rulesText: Forced: After this ally enters play, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a non-unique location and add it to the staging area. If no location enters play by this effect, discard Dunedain Pathfinder. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Backtrack
cards.rulesText: Play only if the main quest has no keywords. Action: Remove X progress from the main quest to place X progress on a location in the staging area.
cards.flavor: “Well,” said Boromir, “when heads are at a loss bodies must serve...” -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Eryn Galen Settler
cards.rulesText: Response: When the active location leaves play as an explored location, discard Eryn Galen Settler to discard a location in the staging with the same title as the just explored location.

cards.name: Explore Secret Ways
cards.rulesText:
Limit 1 copy of Explore Secret Ways in the victory display.
While this side quest is in the victory display, each location in the staging area with the same title as the active location does not contribute its [threat] to the total [threat] of the staging area.
cards.flavor: “I myself dared to pass the doors of the Necromancer in Dol Guldur, and secretly explored his ways...” -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Steward of Orthanc
cards.rulesText: Response: When you play an event, give it Doomed 1 to draw a card. You cannot trigger this ability if you have already triggered the ability of a Steward of Orthanc this round.
cards.flavor: “...the power of Orthanc cannot be lightly thrown aside...” -Saruman, The Two Towers

cards.name: Haldan
cards.rulesText: While the active location has an attachment on it, Haldan does not exhaust to quest. Response: When the active location is explored, draw 1 card for each attachment on it.

cards.name: Wiglaf
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Wiglaf, play an Item attachment on him from your hand for no cost. Action: Exhaust an attachment on Wiglaf to ready him. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Ancestral Armor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] or Noble character. Restricted. Limit 1 per character Attached characters gets +2 [defense] and +2 hit points.
cards.flavor: "May it keep you well!" said Theoden. "It was made for me in Thengel's day, while still I was a boy." - The Two Towers

cards.name: Glamdring
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy or location) Attach to a hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack] Response: After attached character destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Woodmen's Path
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a location with no progress tokens on it.
While attached location is the active location, reduce its quest point value to 1.
cards.flavor:
It was a path made by strong arms and heavy feet.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Meneldor
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Meneldor enters or leaves play, place 2 progress on a location.
cards.flavor: ...Meneldor young and swift. -The Return of the King

cards.name: Flight of the Eagles
cards.rulesText: Action: Return an Eagle ally to your hand to shuffle a set-aside Eagle of the North into the encounter deck. Then, remove Flight of the Eagles from the game.
cards.flavor:
Behind them in long swift lines came all their vassals from the northern mountains, speeding on a gathering wind.
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Wild Stallion
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments Planning Action: Attach Wild Stallion to an ally you control. (Counts as a Mount attachment with the text: "Restricted. Limit 1 per ally. Attached ally gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit point.")

cards.name: South Away!
cards.rulesText: Travel Action: Choose a location in the staging area with a player card attachment and make it the active location, returning any previous active location to the staging area. Reduce each player's threat by X, where X is the number of attachments on the active location.
cards.flavor:
South away! and South away!
Seek the sunlight and the day
- The Hobbit

cards.name: Eagle of the North
cards.rulesText: Encounter. Surge. Cannot have restricted attachments. When Revealed: The first player chooses a player to take control of Eagle of the North. The chosen player may choose and discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Mendor's Support
cards.rulesText: Only one copy of Mendor's Support can be played each round. Action: Mendor gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the round.

cards.name: Valor
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Valor to heal 1 damage from attached hero and deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.

cards.name: Appointed by Fate
cards.rulesText: Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during each resource phase.
cards.flavor:
"Yet it is not our part to master all the tides of the world, but to do what is in us for the succour of those years wherein we are set..."
—Gandalf, The Return of the King

cards.name: Mendor
cards.rulesText: Ranged. The first player gains control of Mendor. Response: After a quest card is defeated, ready Mendor. Then, each player draws 1 card. If Mendor leaves play, remove him from the game.

cards.name: Ungoliant's Swarm
cards.rulesText: Forced: After Ungoliant's Swarm engages a player, that player must choose and exhaust 2 characters they control. Shadow: Put Ungoliant's Swarm into play engaged with you.

cards.name: Lingering Venom
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: Each player must choose: either exhaust each damaged character you control, or deal 2 damage to the hero you control with the most damage on it. Shadow: Exhaust each damaged character you control.

cards.name: Scarred
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Limit 1 per hero. Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, raise your threat by 1.

cards.name: Dáin Ironfoot
cards.rulesText: While Dáin Ironfoot is ready, Dwarf characters get +1 [attack] and +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: "You have not heard of Dáin and the dwarves of the Iron Hills?" <cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Signal
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains sentinel. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Signal to another hero.

cards.name: Dawn Take You All
cards.rulesText: Play after shadow cards have been dealt, before any attacks have resolved. Combat Action: Each player may choose and discard 1 facedown shadow card from an enemy with which he is engaged.
cards.flavor: "Dawn take you all, and be stone to you!" <cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Eagles of the Misty Mountains
cards.rulesText: Eagles of the Misty Mountains cannot have restricted attachments. Eagles of the Misty Mountains gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each facedown attachment it has. Response: After another Eagle character leaves play, you may attach that card facedown to Eagles of the Misty Mountains.

cards.name: Support of the Eagles
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] hero. Action: Exhaust Support of the Eagles to choose an Eagle ally. Until the end of the phase, attached hero adds that ally's [attack] or [defense] (choose 1) to its own.
cards.flavor: "I would bear you, whither you will, even were you made of stone." <cite>Gwaihir, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: West Road Traveller
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play West Road Traveller from your hand, switch the active location with any other location in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
The dark world was rushing by, and the wind sang loudly in his ears.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Astonishing Speed
cards.rulesText: Action: Until the end of the phase, all Rohan characters get +2 [willpower]
cards.flavor: With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Mirkwood Runner
cards.rulesText:
While Mirkwood Runner is attacking alone, the defending enemy does not count its [defense].
"...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf or over snow-an Elf."
–Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Rumour from the Earth
cards.rulesText: Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may pay 1 [lore] resource to return Rumour from the Earth to your hand.
cards.flavor: 'Where sight fails the earth may bring us rumour,' said Aragorn. 'The land must groan under their hated feet.' <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Shadow of the Past
cards.rulesText: Action: Move the top card of the encounter discard pile to the top of the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: The wizard's face remained grave and attentive, and only a flicker in his deep eyes showed that he was startled and indeed alarmed. 'It has been called that before,' he said, 'but not by you.' <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elladan
cards.rulesText: While Elrohir is in play, Elladan gets +2 [attack]. Response: After Elladan is declared as an attacker, pay 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
cards.flavor:
"Yes, the Dead ride behind."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Wanderer
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel. Secrecy 3.
cards.flavor:
They roamed at will southwards, and eastwards even as far as the Misty Mountains; but they were no few and rarely seen.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lure of Moria
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready all Dwarf characters.
cards.flavor:
'The road that I speak of leads to the Mines of Moria,' said Gandalf. Only Gimli lifted up his head; a smouldering fire was in his eyes.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rivendell Blade
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Restricted. When attached character attacks an enemy, that enemy gets -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Hail of Stones
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust X characters to deal X damage to an enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Rider of the Mark
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to give control of Rider of the Mark to another player. (Limit once per round.) Response: After Rider of the Mark changes control, discard a shadow card dealt to an enemy you are engaged with.

cards.name: Song of Eärendil
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [spirit] hero. Response: After Song of Eärendil enters play, draw 1 card. Response: After another player raises his threat, raise your threat by 1 to reduce that player's threat by 1.

cards.name: Bombur
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Bombur to choose a location. That location gets -1 [threat] until the end of the phase. (That location does not contribute its [threat] instead if it is an Underground location.)

cards.name: Out of the Wild
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 2. Action: Search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for any 1 non-objective card worth no victory points and add it to your victory display. Shuffle the encounter deck. Add Out of the Wild to the victory display.

cards.name: The End Comes
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Dwarf character leaves play, shuffle the encounter discard pile back into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor:
'He is dead then,', said Frodo. 'I feared it was so.'
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Alatar
cards.rulesText: While you control exactly 2 heroes, Alatar gains a [tactics] icon and: “Response: At the end of setup, search your collection for a copy of Blue Staff and attach it to Alatar.” Action: Exhaust an Istari hero to place 2 progress on a player side quest (bypassing any active location). (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Pallando
cards.rulesText: While you control exactly 2 heroes, Pallando gains a [lore] icon and: “Response: At the end of setup, search your collection for a copy of Blue Staff and attach it to Pallando.” Response: After you play a Spell event, ready an Istari hero. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Luin Cultist
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Luin Cultist to reduce the cost of the next Spell card played from your hand this round by 1. Action: Exhaust Luin Cultist to shuffle a Spell card from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: “I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Elves or Men or Orcs, that was ever used for such a purpose.” —Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Variag Recluse
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Variag Recluse to place 1 progress on the main quest (you may bypass any active location). You cannot trigger this ability if the main quest has only 1 quest point remaining.
cards.flavor: “…what it is that makes him look to these distant and desolate parts, I cannot guess.” —Radagast, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Chariot Racer
cards.rulesText: Chariot Racer cannot have more than 2 of the same attribute token. Action: Exhaust Chariot Racer to place 1 attribute token on it ([willpower], [attack], or [defense]).
cards.flavor: They journeyed in great wains, and their chieftains fought in chariots. —The Return of the King

cards.name: East-helper
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust an Istari hero to (choose 1): heal 5 damage among Easterling characters in play, ready up to 3 Easterling allies, or reduce the cost of the next Easterling ally you play this phase by 3.
cards.flavor: They would have been willing to follow a leader over the River and into the shadow of Mordor… —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Blue Staff
cards.rulesText: Attach to Alatar or Pallando. Restricted. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Blue Staff to (choose 1): search the top 10 cards of your deck for a side quest or Spell card and add it to your hand (shuffle your deck), reduce each player’s threat increase for questing unsuccessfully this round by 3, or add 1 resource to attached hero’s pool.

cards.name: Emissary of the East
