cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Reduce each player’s threat increase for questing unsuccessfully by 1 for each Easterling or Harad character you control that is not committed to the quest. Response: After an Easterling or Harad character exhausts as part of a player card effect, place 1 progress on the current quest.

cards.name: You Cannot Pass!
cards.rulesText: Action: Spend 1 resource to give an Istari character you control +3 [defense] until the end of the phase. Then, you may place You Cannot Pass! on top of your deck. Response: After You Cannot Pass! is discarded from your deck, give an Istari character you control +6 [attack] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Word of Persuasion
cards.rulesText: Attached card gains turncoat. Limit 1 copy in play per Istari character in play. Planning Action: Exhaust an Istari character to attach Word of Persuasion to a printed enemy engaged with you. X is that enemy’s highest printed attribute ([threat], [attack], [defense], or hit points).

cards.name: Rods of the Five
cards.rulesText: Side A Setup: Each player may raise their threat by X to opt in. X is 5 minus the number of Istari heroes the players control. Flip this card over. Side B Action: Exhaust a Staff attachment on an Istari character to ready that character. Action: Exhaust an Istari character and its attached Staff attachment to choose and resolve 2 different options from the Staff attachment’s action.
cards.flavor:
…he held up his glimmering staff, the light of which just showed the ground before his feet; —The Fellowship of the Ring
“The staff in the hand of a wizard may be more than a prop for age…” —Háma, The Two Towers

cards.name: Elrond
cards.rulesText: You may spend resources from Elrond's resource pool to pay for [spirit], [leadership], and [tactics] allies. Response: After a character is healed by another card effect, heal 1 damage on it.
cards.flavor:
"But you do not stand alone."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: We Are Not Idle
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust X Dwarf heroes to add X resources to a hero's resource pool and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "You should see the stone-paved roads of many colours! And the halls and cavernous streets under the earth with arches carved like trees; and the terraces and towers upon the Mountain's sides! Then you would see that we have not been idle." <cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hardy Leadership
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] hero. Each Dwarf gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor:
"We will seek the hidden door together. And we will come through. In the ruins of of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hands Upon the Bow
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a character you control with ranged to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against an enemy in the staging area. It gets +1 [attack] during this attack.
cards.flavor:
"We live now upon an island amid perils, and our hands are more often upon thr bowstring than upon the harp."
<cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: A Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 4. Response: After a non-unique enemy attacks you, put that enemy on the bottom of the encounter deck. If your threat is lower than that enemy's engagement cost, set your threat equal to the engagement cost of that enemy.

cards.name: Miruvor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Miruvor to (choose two): ready attached hero, add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool, attached hero gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round, or put Miruvor on the top of your deck.

cards.name: Master of the Forge
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Master of the Forge to search the top 5 cards of your deck for any 1 attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Peace, and Thought
cards.rulesText: Refresh Action: Exhaust 2 heroes to draw 5 cards.
cards.flavor:
"Here you will hear many songs and tales-if you can keep awake. But except on high days it usually stands empty and quiet. and people come here who wish for peace, and thought. There is always a fire here, all the year round, but there is little other light."
<cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Risk Some Light
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 3. Action: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. You may select 1 card and move it to the bottom of the encounter deck. Return any unselected cards to the top of the encounter deck, in any order.

cards.name: Vilya
cards.rulesText: Attach to Elrond. He gains a [spirit] resource icon. Action: Exhaust Elrond and Vilya to reveal the top card of your deck. You can immediately play or put into play the revealed card for no cost, if able. Otherwise, move the revealed card to the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor: ...mightiest of the Three. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Na'asiyah
cards.rulesText: Resources in Na'asiyah's resource pool cannot be used to pay for allies. Action: While Na'asiyah is attacking or defending, pay 1 resource from her resource pool to give her +2 [attack] or +2 [defense] for this attack.

cards.name: Rune-master
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Ranger or [leadership] hero. Response: After a Signal attachment is attached to a hero, exhaust Rune-master to add 1 resource to that hero's resource pool.

cards.name: Terrible to Behold
cards.rulesText: Response: After you declare a Noble character as a defender against an attack made by an engaged enemy, return that enemy to the staging area. Then, cancel the attack.
cards.flavor: So great a power and royalty was revealed in Aragorn...that many of the wild men paused, and looked back over their shoulders to the valley, and some looked up doubtfully at the sky. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Veteran Sword-elf
cards.rulesText: Veteran Sword-elf gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each copy of Veteran Sword-elf in your discard pile.
cards.flavor:
The elves were the first to charge. Their hatred for the goblins is cold and bitter.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Vigilant Guard
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points. Response: When another character would be assigned any amount of damage, place 1 of that damage on attached character instead.

cards.name: Knife-work
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. Each enemy engaged with that player gets -1 [defense] until the end of the phase. Then, the players as a group may spend 2 [lore] resources to have the chosen player draw 1 card each time he attacks and destroys an enemy this phase.
cards.flavor:
"Good!" said Legolas. "But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Linhir Sea-captain
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Linhir Sea-captain from your hand, if you paid all of its resouce cost from a single hero's resource pool, both that hero and Linhir Sea-captain do not exhaust to quest this round.

cards.name: Windfola
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [spirit] hero, or to Éowyn. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After attached character is removed from the quest, exhaust Windfola to commit that character to the quest.
cards.flavor: ...the great grey steed Windfola made little of the burden; for Dernhelm was less in weight than many men, though lithe and well-knit in frame. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ioreth
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or defend. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource and exhaust Ioreth. Then, heal 3 points of damage on a character. Any player may trigger this action.
cards.flavor: Thus spake Ioreth, wise-woman of Gondor: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the rightful king be known. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: The Houses of Healing
cards.rulesText: You may exhaust any number of Healer characters you control as part of this card's cost. Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each Healer character you exhaust in this way. Refresh Action: Choose a hero in any player's discard pile. Put that hero into play under its owner's control, with 1 damage token on it.

cards.name: Justice Shall Be Done
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Planning Action: Add Justice Shall Be Done to the victory display to draw 3 cards and add 3 resources to the resource pool of each hero you control. At the end of the round, you are eliminated from the game.
cards.flavor:
"...it is the last move in a great jeopardy, and for one side or the other it will bring the end of the game."
<cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Thorin Stonehelm
cards.rulesText: Response: After Thorin Stonehelm is declared as an attacker, discard the top card of your deck to deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
Thorin III Stonehelm, Dain"s son, became King under the mountain.
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Gildor Inglorion
cards.rulesText: Action: Pay 1 resource from Gildor Inglorion's resource pool to choose a player to draw 1 card (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
"Gildor Inglorion of the House of Finrod. We are Exiles, and most of our kindred have long ago departed..."
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Erkenbrand
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. While Erkenbrand is defending, he gains: "Response: Deal 1 damage to Erkenbrand to cancel a shadow effect just triggered."
cards.flavor: Down from the hills leaped Erkenbrand, lord of Westfold. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Warden of Helm's Deep
cards.rulesText: Sentinel.
cards.flavor: They now learned to their joy that Erkenbrand had left many men to hold Helm's Gate, and more had since escaped thither. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: The Day's Rising
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero with sentinel. Response: After attached hero defends against an attack and takes no damage while defending that attack, exhaust The Day's Rising to add 1 resource to the attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
Out of doubt, out of dark to the day's rising
I came singing in the sun, sword unsheathing.
<cite>Éomer, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Captain of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Warrior hero. Response: After you optionally engage an enemy, exhaust Captain of Gondor to give attached hero +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "Boromir it was that drove the enemy at last back from this western shore..." <cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Booming Ent
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Booming Ent gets +1 [attack] for each damaged Ent character you control.
cards.flavor: "...a man that hacks once at an Ent never gets a chance of a second blow." <cite>Merry, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ride Them Down
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, progress that would be placed on the quest from questing successfully is instead assigned as damage to the chosen enemy. (Progress must still be placed on any active location first.)
cards.flavor: Like thunder they broke upon the enemy... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Shadows Give Way
cards.rulesText: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card. Action: Discard each shadow card from each enemy in play.
cards.flavor: At that moment he caught a flash of white and silver coming from the North, like a small star down on the dusky fields. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Don't Be Hasty!
cards.rulesText: Response: When an encounter card is revealed but before resolving any of that card's keywords or "when revealed" effects, choose a character committed to the quest. Ready that character and remove it from the quest.
cards.flavor: "Don't be hasty, that is my motto." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Waters of Nimrodel
cards.rulesText: Doomed 3. Action: Heal all damage on each character in play.
cards.flavor: For a moment Frodo stood near the brink and let the water flow over his tired feet. It was cold but its touch was clean, and as he went on and it mounted to his knees, he felt that the strain of travel and all weariness was washed from his limbs. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Treebeard
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Treebeard enters play exhausted and collects 1 resource each resource phase. These resources can be used to pay for Ent cards played from your hand. Action: Pay 2 resources from Treebeard's pool to ready an Ent character.

cards.name: Fatty Bolger
cards.rulesText: Setup: Reduce your threat by 2. Response: Raise your threat by 4 and exhaust Fatty Bolger to cancel a non-unique enemy card just revealed from the encounter deck and add it to the victory display. (Limit once per game for the group.)
cards.flavor: Fatty Bolger had not been idle. As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden, he knew that he must run for it, or perish. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Widfast
cards.rulesText: Setup: Search your collection for a Creature ally and add it to your hand. For the first round, reduce its cost by 2. Travel Action: If there is 1 active location, spend 1 resource from Widfast’s pool to travel to another location, resolving its Travel effect. (There are now 2 active locations.)

cards.name: Lily Cotton
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Lily Cotton to ready a different Hobbit ally and add Lily Cotton’s [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to that ally’s [willpower], [attack], and [defense] respectively until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to its owner’s hand. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
There is little or no magic about them, except the ordinary everyday sort which helps them disappear quietly and quickly…
—The Hobbit

cards.name: A Lesson in Caution
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 1. Action: Draw 1 card. Then, either reduce your threat by 2, or the next card you play this phase gains secrecy 1.
cards.flavor: Hobbits go light, and their footprints are not easy even for a Ranger to read… —The Two Towers

cards.name: There and Back Again
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 1. Response: After a Hobbit ally leaves play, search your hand and discard pile for a copy of that ally and put it into play, under any player’s control.
cards.flavor: The legal bother, indeed, lasted for years. It was quite a long time before Mr. Baggins was in fact admitted to be alive again. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Buckland Shirriff
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Ranged. Response: After an enemy that shares a Trait with an enemy in the victory display is added to the staging area, spend 1 [lore] resource to put Buckland Shirriff into play from your hand, under your control.

cards.name: Weep No More!
cards.rulesText: Limit 3 copies of Weep No More! in the victory display. Response: After a “when revealed” effect or a shadow effect on a treachery card resolves, add Weep No More! to the victory display to add that treachery card to the victory display.
cards.flavor:
“At least we may yet be avenged. Let us gird ourselves and weep no more!”
—Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Fear! Fire! Foes!
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 1. Play only if you do not control a Warrior hero. Action: Choose a non-unique enemy and an attribute ([threat], [attack], or [defense]). Until the end of the phase, reduce the chosen attribute of that enemy to 0.
cards.flavor: Far away answering horns were heard. The alarm was spreading. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Horn-call of Buckland
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] or Hobbit hero. Response: After you engage an enemy that shares a Trait with an enemy in the victory display, exhaust Horn-call of Buckland to ready attached hero. Then, that enemy gets −1 [attack] and −1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
At that moment, among the trees nearby, a horn rang out. It rent the night like fire on a hill-top.
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Young Tom
cards.rulesText: During the round that Young Tom enters play, enemies get +5 engagement cost.
cards.flavor: “Not all is well there,” said Frodo, “but certainly gardeners are honoured.” —The Two Towers

cards.name: Gavin
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Response: After an encounter card without surge is revealed, exhaust Gavin to give that card surge and add 1 resource to the pool of a Scout hero you control. If the next encounter card revealed is not a location, discard it without resolving its effects.

cards.name: Ghân-buri-Ghân
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Search the top 10 cards of the encounter deck for a location, reveal it, and shuffle the encounter deck. Then, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a [lore] attachment, play it for no cost, and shuffle your deck. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Ose-bori-Ose
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play a [lore] attachment, if it is not attached to a character, your threat is considered to be 20 until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
“Road is forgotten, but not by Wild Men.”
—Ghȃn-buri-Ghȃn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Sharp-eyed Drû
cards.rulesText: Sharp-eyed Drû gets +1 [defense] while your threat is 20 or less, and +1 [defense] while the active location has at least 4 [threat]. If both are true, Sharp-eyed Drû also gains sentinel.
cards.flavor: “Wild Men have long ears and long eyes; know all paths.” —Ghȃn-buri-Ghȃn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Mushroom Gatherer
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 1. Refresh Action: Exhaust Mushroom Gatherer to either deal 1 damage to any 1 enemy in play, or heal 1 damage from any 1 character in play.
cards.flavor: “…they are woodcrafty beyond compare.” —Elfhelm, The Return of the King

cards.name: Drû-buri-Drû
cards.rulesText: Response: At the end of any phase, exhaust Drû-buri-Drû to move a [lore] card attached to an encounter card to another eligible encounter card.
cards.flavor: “Remnants of an older time they be, living few and secretly, wild and wary as the beasts.” —Elfhelm, The Return of the King

cards.name: Drúedain Seer
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 1. Response: After Drúedain Seer commits to the quest, place 1 [threat] token on any 1 location in the staging area to ready any 1 Wose or Scout character.
cards.flavor: “I count many things: stars in sky, leaves on trees, men in the dark.” —Ghȃn-buri-Ghȃn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Gorgûn-hunter
cards.rulesText: Gorgûn-hunter gets +1 [attack] while your threat is 20 or less, and +1 [attack] while the active location has at least 4 [threat]. If both are true, Gorgûn-hunter also gains ranged.
cards.flavor: “Kill gorgûn in woods, hate orc-folk.” —Ghȃn-buri-Ghȃn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Poisoned Darts
cards.rulesText: Play Poisoned Darts into the staging area unattached. If unattached, attach Poisoned Darts to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area. Response: When the attached enemy would take any amount of damage, increase that amount by 1.

cards.name: Púkel-man
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location or enemy. Attached card gets +1 [threat]. Response: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on attached location or deal 1 damage to attached enemy.
cards.flavor: …only the old Púkel-men were left, still sitting at the turnings of the road. —The Return of the King

cards.name: Chieftain's Staff
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Wose hero. While the active location has at least 4 [threat], Wose characters you control get +1 [willpower]. Planning Action: Exhaust Chieftain’s Staff and place 1 [threat] token on any 1 location in the staging area to reduce the cost of the next [lore] card you play this phase by 1.

cards.name: Masters of the Forest
cards.rulesText: Side A Setup: Each player that controls at least 1 hero with the Woodman, Ranger, or Wose traits may opt in by raising their threat by 2 plus an additional 2 for each hero they control that does not have one of those traits. Each player that opted in draws 1 card for each other player that opted in. Flip this card over. Side B Players who opted in to this objective and cards they control ignore the following text on non-unique locations and enemies: • “immune to player card effects” • “cannot have attachments” • “cannot have player card attachments” • “cannot have non-X attachments” (where X is a Trait or card type).
cards.flavor: He could see them stealing up the slopes, singly or in long files, keeping always to the shade of the grove or thicket, or crawling… —The Two Towers

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
cards.flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Sam Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Response: After you engage an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat, ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower] +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "I'm going with him...and if any of those Black Riders try to stop him, they'll have Sam Gamgee to reckon with" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Merry
cards.rulesText: Merry gets +1 [attack] for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After Merry participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, ready another character that participated in that attack.
cards.flavor: "You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin to the bitter end" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Pippin
cards.rulesText: Each enemy in play gets +1 engagement cost for each Hobbit hero you control. Response: After you engage an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat, draw a card.
cards.flavor:
"We Hobbits ought to stick together, and we will"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Fatty Bolger
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Fatty Bolger to choose an enemy in the staging area and raise your threat by that enemy's [threat]. Until the end of the phase, that enemy does not contribute its [threat]. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I only hope that you do not need rescuing before the day is out" <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Bill the Pony
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Lower the cost to play Bill the Pony by 2 if you control Sam Gamgee. Each Hobbit character gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak it: if you don't let me go with you, Sam, I'll follow on my own" <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Barliman Butterbur
cards.rulesText: If each hero you control has the Hobbit trait, damage from undefended attacks against you may be assigned to Barliman Butterbur.
cards.flavor: "But spooks or no spooks, they won't get in The Prancing Pony so easy." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Farmer Maggot
cards.rulesText: Response: After Farmer Maggot enters play, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Deal 2 damage instead if that enemy's engagement cost is higher than your threat.)
cards.flavor: "It is lucky for you that I know you. I was going out to set my dogs on any strangers." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Halfling Determination
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a Hobbit character. That character gets +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "I have something to do before the end, and it lies ahead, not in the Shire. I must see it through, sir, if you understand me." <cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Smoke Rings
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce your threat by 1 for each Pipe you control. Each hero with a Pipe attachment gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: ...he smoked and blew smoke-rings with the same vigour and delight...<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Take No Notice
cards.rulesText: Lower the cost play Take No Notice by 1 for each Hobbit or Ranger hero you control. Action: Add 5 to each enemy's engagement cost until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: ...they made no noise that even hobbits would hear. Event the wild things in the fields and woods hardly noticed their passing. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Frodo's Intuition
cards.rulesText: Action: Each hero you control gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Draw 1 card for each Hobbit hero you control.
cards.flavor: "I wonder if that is Gandalf coming after us" said Frodo, but even as he said it, he had a feeling that it was not so... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hobbit Cloak
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +2 [defense] while defending against an attack by an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat.
cards.flavor: In their dark cloaks they were invisible as if they all had magic rings. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dagger of Westernesse
cards.rulesText:
Restricted.
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attacking an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat).
cards.flavor:
...these blades were forged many long years ago by Men of Westernesse: they were foes of the Dark Lord...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hobbit Pipe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After your threat is reduced by an event card effect, exhaust Hobbit Pipe to draw a card.
cards.flavor: But even the Dúnedain of Gondor allow us this credit: Hobbits first put it into pipes. Not even the Wizards first thought of that before we did. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elf-stone
cards.rulesText: Attach to the active location. Attached location gets +1 quest point. Response: After attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.
cards.flavor:
"It is a beryl, an elf-stone. Whether it was set there, or let fall by chance, I cannot say, but it brings hope to me"
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Mr. Underhill
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Action: Add Mr. Underhill to the victory display to choose an enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
cards.flavor: "I will give you a travelling name now. When you go, go as Mr. Underhill." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Tireless Ranger
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and gains the Ranger trait.
cards.flavor: "What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?" -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Skilled Healer
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 hit points and gains the Healer trait.
cards.flavor: "Few now have the skill in healing to match such evil weapons. But I will do what I can." -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Valiant Warrior
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] and gains the Warrior trait.
cards.flavor: "Three of the servants of Sauron were upon the Bridge, but they withdrew and I pursued them westward." -Glorfindel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Noble Hero
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] and gains the Noble trait.
cards.flavor: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior in the fullness of his strength. -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Gildor Inglorion
cards.rulesText: The first player gains control of Gildor Inglorion. Forced: At the end of the round, discard Gildor Inglorion. The first player may spend 1 [fellowship] resource to cancel this effect.
cards.flavor: "We think you had best come now with us." -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Gandalf's Delay
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add Gandalf's Delay to the staging area. Skip the draw cards step during the first round of the game.
cards.flavor:
The next day Frodo became really anxious, and kept a constant look–out for Gandalf. Thursday, his birthday morning, dawned as fair and clear as it had long ago for Bilbo's great party. Still Gandalf did not appear.
–The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Ring Draws Them
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: At the end of the phase, each enemy in the staging area engages the first player. If The One Ring is exhausted, this effect cannot be canceled.
cards.flavor: "Also," he added, and his voice sank to a whisper, "the Ring draws them" –The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Weight of the Ring
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: Attach to the Ring-bearer. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: At the beginning of each quest phase, either exhaust The One Ring or reveal an additional encounter card this phase.")
cards.flavor: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo... –The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Fear of Discovery
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must either exhaust the Ring-bearer or reveal an additional encounter card. Shadow: Defending player raises his threat by 3.

cards.name: Eaten Alive!
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must deal X damage divided among heroes he controls where X is the number of players in the game. Shadow: Deal 1 damage to defending character.

cards.name: Panicked
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: The first player raises his threat by 3 and passes the first player token to the next player. Shadow: Defending player exhausts a character he controls.

cards.name: Overcome by Terror
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: The first player must exhaust The One Ring. If The One Ring is already exhausted, the first player must discard 2 cards at random from his hand. Shadow: Defending player discards 1 card at random from his hand.

cards.name: Fastred
cards.rulesText: Response: After Fastred defends an enemy attack, return that enemy to the staging area to reduce your threat by 2. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Song of Hope
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Spend 1 resource from attached hero’s pool to give attached hero +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit 3 times per phase.)

cards.name: Burst into Song
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready each hero with a Song attachment.

cards.name: Defender of Cair Andros
cards.rulesText: Defender of Cair Andros gets +X [Defense], where X is the tens digit of your threat. (Limit +4 [Defense].) Valour Response: After Defender of Cair Andros is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Oath of Eorl
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Rohan trait and another unique character with the Gondor trait. Response: At the beginning of the combat phase, you resolve the step in which you attack enemies before resolving enemy attacks this phase. (Each other player resolves the combat phase as normal after you resolve your attacks.)

cards.name: Fearless Scout
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains the Scout trait. Response: After you play Fearless Scout from your hand, draw a card.

cards.name: Rally the West
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 copy of Rally the West in the victory display. While this side quest is in the victory display, each hero gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: “Foes and fire are before you, and your homes far behind. Yet, though you fight upon an alien field, the glory that you reap there shall be your own forever.” -Theoden, The Return of the King

cards.name: Dúnedain Pipe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain character. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Dúnedain Pipe and place a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to draw a card.

cards.name: Old Toby
cards.rulesText: Action: Draw 1 card for each Pipe you control. Heal 1 damage from each hero with a Pipe attachment.

cards.name: Southron Refugee
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Southron Refugee to reduce the cost of the next Harad ally you play this phase by 1.

cards.name: Lothíriel
cards.rulesText: If Éomer is in play, Lothíriel gains the Rohan trait. Response: After Lothíriel commits to a quest, choose an ally in your hand. If that ally shares a Trait with her, put that ally into play exhausted and committed to the quest. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Angbor the Fearless
cards.rulesText: While your threat is 40 or higher, Angbor the Fearless gets +2 [attack] and does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
"Four thousands I sent marching from Pelargir through Lossarnach two days ago; and Angbor the fearless rides before them."
-Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Need Drives Them
cards.rulesText: Action: Each player whose threat is 40 or higher readies all characters he controls.
cards.flavor:
"But I do not go gladly; only need drives me. Therefore, only of your free will would I have you come..."
-Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Woodland Sentry
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Woodland Sentry from your hand, choose an enemy or location in play. If there is a copy of that card in the victory display, discard the chosen card.
cards.flavor:
In the Wide World the Wood-elves lingered in the twilight of our Sun and Moon but loved best the stars...
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Keen Longbow
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gains ranged. Response: After attached hero is declared an as attacker against an enemy, discard up to 3 cards from your hand to deal 1 damage to that enemy for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: War Axe
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a [tactics] character. Limit 1 per character. 
Restricted. 
Attached characters gets +1 [attack] for each attachment it has with the restricted keyword.
cards.flavor:
"Gimli Glóin"s son, have you your axe ready?"
-Éomer, The Return of the King

cards.name: Strength and Courage
cards.rulesText: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to double attached hero's printed [attack] for this attack.

cards.name: Knight of Belfalas
cards.rulesText: Response: After Knight of Belfalas enters play, return a Gondor ally from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor:
The mounted knights returned, and at their rear the banner of Dol Amroth...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Horn of the Mark
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero or Merry. Restricted. Response: When a character leaves play, if that character shares at least one trait with the attached hero, exhaust Horn of the Mark to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Then Éowyn gave to Merry an ancient horn, small but cunningly wrought all of fair silver with a baldric of green...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Host of Galadhrim
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Return each Silvan ally you control to your hand. Then, play each of those allies from your hand one at a time at no cost.
cards.flavor:
Celeborn came forth and led the host of Lórien...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Forth, The Three Hunters!
cards.rulesText: Side A Your deck cannot include ally cards. Each of your heroes can have 1 additional restricted attachment. Reduce the cost of the first restricted attachment you play on each of your heroes each round by 1. Refresh Action: If each of your heroes has at least 2 restricted attachments, flip this card over. Side B Each of your heroes can have 1 additional restricted attachment and gets +1 [willpower] for each restricted attachment on it. Action: Exhaust this card to heal 1 damage from each of your heroes.
cards.flavor:
"...we that remain cannot forsake our companions while we have strength left."
-Aragorn, The Two Towers
"With hope or without hope we will follow the trail of our enemies. And woe to them, if we prove the swifter!"
-Aragorn, The Two Towers

cards.name: Mirlonde
cards.rulesText: Each hero you control with a printed [lore] resource icon gets -1 threat cost.
cards.flavor:
"...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside..."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Forlong
cards.rulesText: While you control Outlands allies that belong to 4 different spheres, ready Forlong at the beginning of each phase.
cards.flavor: "Forlong!" men shouted. "True heart, true friend!" <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Strength of Arms
cards.rulesText: Play only if each hero you control has a printed [leadership] resource icon. Action: Ready each ally in play.
cards.flavor: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Mighty Prowess
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] hero hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, deal 1 damage to another enemy that shares a Trait with the enemy just destroyed.
cards.flavor: He slew many of them and the rest fled. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Trained for War
cards.rulesText: Play only if each hero you control has the printed [tactics] resource icon. Action: Until the end of the phase, if the current quest does not have Siege, it gains Battle.

cards.name: Silvan Refugee
cards.rulesText: Forced: After a character leaves play, discard Silvan Refugee from play.
cards.flavor:
"The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows..."
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Against the Shadow
cards.rulesText: Play only if each hero you control has the printed [spirit] resource icon. Action: Until the end of the phase, [spirit] characters use their [willpower] instead of [defense].
cards.flavor: "Courage will now be your best defense against the storm that is at hand..." <cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Harbor Master
cards.rulesText: Response: After a card effect adds any number of resources to the resource pool of a hero you control, Harbor Master gains +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: For the Elves of the High Kindred had not yet forsaken Middle-earth, and they dwelt still at that time at the Grey Havens...<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Advance Warning
cards.rulesText: Play only if each hero you control has a printed [lore] resource icon. Action: Until the end of the phase, enemies do not make engagement checks.
cards.flavor: Suddenly he halted and listened. Had he heard a whistle or not? Or was it the call of some strange bird? <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: White Tower Watchman
cards.rulesText: If each hero you control belongs to the same sphere of influence, you may assign damage from undefended enemy attacks to White Tower Watchman instead of a hero you control.
cards.flavor: The watchmen cried aloud, and all men in the City stood to arms. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Boromir
cards.rulesText: Action: Raise your threat by 1 to ready Boromir. (Limit once per phase.) Action: Discard Boromir to deal 2 damage to each enemy engaged with a single player.
cards.flavor: "...in Gondor we must trust to such weapons as we have." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Watcher
cards.rulesText: Response: Discard Dúnedain Watcher from play to cancel the shadow effects of a card just triggered.
cards.flavor: "If simple folk are free from care and fear, simple they will be, and we must be secret to keep them so. That has been the task of my kindred, while the years have lengthened and the grass has grown." <cite>Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Cache
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains ranged. Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero's pool to attach Dúnedain Cache to another hero.

cards.name: Vassal of the Windlord
cards.rulesText: Ranged.Vassal of the Windlord cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After an attack in which Vassal of the Windlord attacked resolves, discard Vassal of the Windlord from play.

cards.name: Song of Mocking
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Song of Mocking to choose another hero. Until the end of the phase, attached hero takes all damage assigned to the chosen hero.
cards.flavor:
Old fat spider spinning in a tree!
Old fat spider can't see me!
Attercop! Attercop!
Won't you stop. Stop your spinning and look for me!
<cite>Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Elfhelm
cards.rulesText: While Elfhelm is ready, he gains: "Response: After your threat is raised as the result of questing unsuccessfully, or by an encounter or quest card effect, reduce your threat by 1."
cards.flavor: "Buy my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness: orders may come for a sudden move." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: We Do Not Sleep
cards.rulesText: Action: Until the end of the phase, Rohan characters do not exhaust to commit to quests.
cards.flavor: "But we must ride more warily; for war is abroad, and the Rohirrim, the Horse-lords, do not sleep, even if it seems so from afar." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Silvan Tracker
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Silvan character readies during the refresh phase, heal 1 damage from that character.
cards.flavor: "The Wood-elves tracked him first, an easy task for them, for his trail was still fresh then." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Rings</cite>

cards.name: Fast Hitch
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit character. Action: Exhaust Fast Hitch to ready attached character.
cards.flavor: 'And I put as fast a hitch over the stump as any one could have done, in the Shire or out of it.' <cite>Sam, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Song of Battle
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [tactics] resource icon.
cards.flavor: We go, we go, we go to war, to hew the stone and break the door. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Arwen Undómiel
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard a card from your hand to add 1 resource to a Noldor's resource pool, or to Aragorn's resource pool. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
...the light of stars was in her bright eyes, grey as a cloudless night; yet queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Éothain
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Rohan ally is discarded from play by a card effect, ready Éothain.
cards.flavor:
"We must hasten south, lord. Let us leave these wild folk to their fancies. Or let us bind them and take them to our king."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Sword of Númenor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain or Gondor hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack]. Response: After attached hero participates in an attack that destroys an enemy with 5 or more printed hit points, exhaust Sword of Númenor to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
...the flowing characters of Númenor glinted like fire upon the blade.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Fornost Bowman
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
Fornost Bowman gets +1 [attack] for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
To the last battle at Fornost with the Witch-lord of Angmar they sent some bowmen to the aid of the king...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hour of Wrath
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a hero. Until the end of the phase, the chosen hero does not exhaust to attack or defend. Valour Action: Choose a player. Until the end of the phase, each of that player's heroes do not exhaust to attack or defend.
cards.flavor:
These three were unscathed, for such was their fortune and the skill and might of their arms...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elven-light
cards.rulesText: Elven-light can only be played from your discard pile. Action: Return Elven-light to your hand from your discard pile. Then, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
Then Aragorn was abashed, for he saw the elven-light in her eyes and the wisdom of many days...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Tale of Tinúviel
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust a Noldor character to ready a Dúnedain character, or vice-versa. Until the end of the phase, add the exhausted character's printed [willpower] to the other character's [willpower], [attack] and [defense].
cards.flavor:
Long was the way that fate them bore,
O'er stony mountains cold and grey,
Through halls of iron and darkling door,
And woods of nightshade morrowless.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Galadhrim Healer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Galadhrim Healer enters play, choose a player. Heal 1 damage from each hero controlled by that player.
cards.flavor:
"Even if your Quest did not concern us closely, you should have refuge in this City, until you were healed and refreshed."
<cite>Celeborn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Weather-stained Cloak
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Ranger character. Limit 1 per character. While attached character is commited to the quest, Weather-stained Cloak gains: "Response: Exhaust Weather-stained Cloak to cancel 1 point of damage just dealt to attached character."
cards.flavor:
They were clad in warm raiment and heavy cloaks...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Sword-thain
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a unique ally belonging to any sphere of influence.
Attached character loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type.
cards.flavor:
"But why, lord, did you receive me as sword-thain, if not to stay by your side?"
<cite>Merry, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Celeborn
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Silvan ally enters play, that ally gets +1 [willpower] +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "...the lord of the Galadhrim is accounted wisest of the Elves of Middle-earth, and a giver of gifts beyond the power of kings." <cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Naith Guide
cards.rulesText: Response: After Naith Guide enters play, choose a hero. That hero does not exhaust to quest this round.
cards.flavor: "...I shall lead you well..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Swift and Silent
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready a hero you control. Then, if your threat is 20 or less and this is the first time you played a copy of Swift and Silent this round, return this card to your hand instead of discarding it.
cards.flavor: A marching host of Elves had come up silently... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Firefoot
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] or Rohan hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attached hero is Éomer). Response: After attached hero attacks alone, exhaust Firefoot to choose a non-unique enemy engaged with you. Excess damage dealt by this attack is assigned to the chosen enemy.

cards.name: Close Call
cards.rulesText: Doomed X. Response: Cancel X damage just dealt to a hero.
cards.flavor: "That spear-thrust would have skewered a wild boar!" <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Blue Mountain Trader
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose another player. That player gains control of Blue Mountain Trader. Then, that player moves 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero he controls to the resource pool of a hero you control, or Blue Mountain Trader is discarded. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: The Fall of Gil-Galad
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a hero. Response: When attached hero is destroyed, add The Fall of Gil-Galad to the victory display to reduce your threat by X, where X is the attached hero's threat cost.
cards.flavor:
...for into darkness fell his star
in Mordor where the shadows are.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ithilien Lookout
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 2. Response: After Ithilien Lookout enters play, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If it is an enemy, you may discard it.
cards.flavor: All had swords at their sides... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: The Tree People
cards.rulesText: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Silvan ally. Put that ally into play and shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You can only play 1 copy of The Tree People each phase.
cards.flavor: No folk could they see, nor hear any feet upon the paths; but there were many voices, about them, and in the air above. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The White Council
cards.rulesText: X is the number of players in the game. Action: Starting with the first player, each player chooses 1 different option: ready a hero he controls, add 1 resource to the resource pool of a hero he controls, draw 1 card, or shuffle 1 card from his discard pile into his deck.
cards.flavor:
"I it was who first summoned the White Council."
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Stalking Goblin
cards.rulesText: Forced: After Stalking Goblin engages you, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and your collection (in that order) for a Goblin Sniper and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Shadow: Add Stalking Goblin to the staging area.

cards.name: Shiny Distraction
cards.rulesText: Surge. Doomed 1. When Revealed: Each player may add 1 resource to each of their heroes' pools. Each player that does raises their threat by 5.

cards.name: Guilty Conscience
cards.rulesText: Surge. When Revealed: Attach to the hero with the highest threat cost. (Counts as an Adaptation attachment with the text: "Forced: Raise your threat by 2 at the end of each round. Action: Spend 2 resources from attached hero's pool to discard this card.")

cards.name: The Fervor of Lore
cards.rulesText: Setup. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the [lore] resource icon. Action: Choose and discard 3 cards from your hand to heal all damage from a hero. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

cards.name: The Might of Tactics
cards.rulesText: Setup. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the [tactics] resource icon. Action: Deal 1 damage to the attached hero to deal 3 damage to an enemy engaged with you. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

cards.name: The Power of Spirit
cards.rulesText: Setup. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the [spirit] resource icon. Action: Exhaust the attached hero to place 3 progress on a location. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

cards.name: The Secret of Leadership
cards.rulesText: Setup. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the [leadership] resource icon. Action: Spend 1 resource from the attached hero's resource pool to ready a hero. (Limit once per campaign. Record in Campaign Log when used.)

cards.name: "No Time to Waste!"
cards.rulesText: When playing this card, choose one: Quest Action: Remove "No Time to Waste!" from the game and from the Campaign Pool to reduce each player's threat by 3. Reveal the top card of the encounter deck. Quest Action: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Ranger Sense
cards.rulesText: When playing this card, choose one: Action: Remove Ranger Sense from the game and from the Campaign Pooll to look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and put the rest back in any order. Action: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Action: Exhaust Aragorn to choose a location in the staging area. Until the end of the phase, that location gets -X [threat], where X is Aragorn's [willpower]. If this effect reduces the location's [threat] to 0, place 1 progress on it. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Shining Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if your threat is 40 or higher).
cards.flavor:
...his shinning shield was scored with runs...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Knowledge of the Enemy
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Choose a hero you control. Add 1 resource to its resource pool for each enemy engaged with you. You can only play 1 Knowledge of the Enemy each round.
cards.flavor:
"If a man must needs walk in sight of the Black Gate, or tread the deadly flowers of Morgul Vale, then perils he will have."
-Aragorm, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Haleth
cards.rulesText: Response: After Haleth quests successfully, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Woodman Lore
cards.rulesText: Action: Ready up to X Woodman characters you control, where X is the number of locations with player card attachments.
cards.flavor:
The Woodman said that there was some new terror abroad...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Westfold Lancer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Westfold Lancer quests successfully, discard it to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. Deal 2 damage to the chosen enemy.
cards.flavor:
...the white fury of the Northmen burned the hotter, and more skilled was their knighthood with long spears...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Tireless Thoroughbred
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Warrior character. Restricted. Attached character gains ranged and sentinel.
cards.flavor:
Then he leapt forward, spurring the earth, and was gone like the north wine from the mountains.
-The Two Towers.

cards.name: Misty Mountain Journeyman
cards.rulesText: You cannot play Misty Mountain Journeyman from your hand unless you are engaged with an enemy.
cards.flavor:
Rangers passed at times beyond the hills, but they were few and did not stay.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: A Desperate Path
cards.rulesText: Response: At the end of the staging step, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until you discard a treachery. Resolve its 'when revealed' effects to ready each of your questing characters. Each of your questing characters gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Thorongil
cards.rulesText: Attach to a non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] hero you control. Response: After you attach Thorongil to a hero, search your collection for a different non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] version of that hero and attach it to Thorongil. While Thorongil is in play, attached hero gains the game text and resource icon of the attached hero card. If Thorongil leaves play, remove the hero card attached to it from the game.

cards.name: Bond of Friendship
cards.rulesText:
Your deck must be exactly 50 players cards and include exactly 10 cards from each of these four spheres: [leadership], [lore], [spirit], and [tactics]. You cannot include more than 2 copies of any card by title in your deck.

When choosing your starting heroes, you may choose 4 heroes instead of 3. Each of your heroes must belong to a different sphere.
cards.flavor:
"You can trust us to stick to you through think and thin - to the bitter end."
-Merry, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Radagast
cards.rulesText: While playing a Creature ally, Radagast gains the printed [leadership], [spirit], and [tactics] icons. Response: After you play a Creature card, Radagast does not exhaust to quest this round.
cards.flavor:
"..he has much lore of herbs and beasts, and birds are especially his friends."
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Messenger Raven
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack, defend, of have attachments. Refresh Action: Return Messenger Raven to it's owner's hand and name a card type. Choose a player to look at the top card of his deck. If that card is the named type, add it to its owner's hand. If it is not, discard it.

cards.name: The King's Return
cards.rulesText: Action: Search your deck for a Guarded attachment and put it into play. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
His crown shall be upholden,
His harp shall be restrung,
His halls shall echo golden
To songs of yore re-sung
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Loyal Hound
cards.rulesText: Cannot have attachments. Response: Discard Loyal Hound to cancel up to 2 damage just dealt to a hero you control.

cards.name: The Great Hunt
cards.rulesText: You must use resources from 3 different heroes' pools to pay for this card. Combat Action: Choose and discard a non-unique enemy in the staging area.
cards.flavor:
...it seemed they could hear the noise of a great hunt going by to the north of the path...
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Bywater Shirriff
cards.rulesText: Bywater Shirriff gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] while you are engaged with an enemy with engagement cost higher than your threat.
cards.flavor:
The Shirriffs was the name that the Hobbits gave to their police, or the nearest equivalent that they possessed.
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Gwaihir's Debt
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Istari trait and another unique character with the Eagle trait. Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for an Eagle or Istari ally and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Mithril Shirt
cards.rulesText: Guarded (location). Guarded (location). Attach to a hero. Response: When attached hero is dealt any amount of damage, reduce that amount by 1.
cards.flavor:
It was of silver-steel which the Elves call mithril, and with it went a belt of pearls and crystals.
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Reforged
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an Item attachment with a printed cost of X in any player's discard pile and play that attachment for no cost. (The chosen attachment can belong to any sphere of influence.)
cards.flavor: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Radagast's Staff
cards.rulesText: Attach to Radagast. Action: Exhaust Radagast's Staff to choose one: Reduce the cost of the next Creature ally you play this phase by 2, ready a Creature ally, or return a non-unique Creature enemy engaged with you to the staging area.

cards.name: Gaeronel
cards.flavor: “I will dwell by the grey shores, guarding the Havens until the last ship sails.” —Círdan, The Silmarillion

cards.name: Glorfindel
cards.rulesText:
Glorfindel gets +2 [attack] while attacking alone.
Glorfindel gets +2 [attack] while attacking a unique enemy.
cards.flavor:
Then Glorfindel leapt forward upon him and his golden armour gleamed strangely in the moon…
—The Fall of Gondolin

cards.name: Harlond Lookout
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: After Harlond Lookout is destroyed, ready a character you control.
cards.flavor: The fleets passed out of the sight of the watchers in the havens, and their lights faded. —The Silmarillion

cards.name: Balin
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: After a card is discarded from the top of your deck, ready Balin. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: The others made no pretense of offering – except old Balin. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Salvaged Supplies
cards.rulesText: Response: At the end of the refresh phase, if none of your heroes gained any resources from player card effects this round, add 1 resource to the pool of a hero you control. Action: Exhaust a character you control to return Salvaged Supplies from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Lay of the Nauglamír
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Action: Discard the top 10 cards of your deck. Choose up to 2 different Noldor or Dwarf allies discarded by this effect and put them into play. Each chosen ally must have a printed cost of 2 or less. You may shuffle any number of the other cards discarded by this effect back into your deck. Remove Lay of the Nauglamír from the game.

cards.name: Wandering Spirit
cards.rulesText: Cannot enter play. Action: If Wandering Spirit is in your discard pile, move it up or down by 1 or 2 cards. Then, if it is next to a Noldor ally with a printed cost of 2 or less, you may spend 1 [spirit] resource and remove Wandering Spirit from the game to put that ally into play. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Relic of Nargothrond
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Dwarf character. Restricted. Limit 1 per character. Relic of Nargothrond can be played from your discard pile once per round. Attached character gets +1 [defense]. Action: Discard Relic of Nargothrond to give attached character +2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: In that labour Finrod was aided by the Dwarves of the Blue Mountains. —The Silmarillion

cards.name: Onward Into Battle
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Warrior hero. Encounter Action: Exhaust Onward Into Battle to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: “…and though we still hold that a warrior should have more skills and knowledge than only the craft of weapons and slaying, we esteem a warrior, nonetheless, above men of other crafts. Such is the need of our days.” —Faramir, The Two Towers

cards.name: Legacy of Gondolin
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor hero you control. Limit 1 per hero. You cannot play allies or attachments from your hand unless you have 2 or fewer cards in your hand. Action: Exhaust Legacy of Gondolin to either draw 1 card or discard Legacy of Gondolin.

cards.name: Círdan the Shipwright
cards.rulesText: Draw 1 additional card at the beginning of the resource phase. Forced: After drawing cards at the beginning of the resource phase, choose and discard 1 of those cards.
cards.flavor:
Very tall he was, and his beard was long, and he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Galdor of the Havens
cards.rulesText: Response: After drawing your setup hand, instead of taking a mulligan, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. Then, draw that many cards. Action: If you have no cards in your hand, draw 6 cards. (Limit once per game.)
cards.flavor:
"What power still remains lies with us..."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Mithlond Sea-watcher
cards.rulesText: While the top card of your discard pile is an ally, Mithlond Sea-watcher gets +2 [attack] and gains ranged.
cards.flavor:
But it was an old tradition that away over there stood the Grey Havens, from which at times elven-ships set sail, never to return.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Skyward Volley
cards.rulesText: As an additional cost to play Skyward Volley, exhaust a ranged character you control. Combat Action: Deal 2 damage to an enemy engaged with a player. Resolve that effect again for each copy of Skyward Volley currently in your discard pile (you may choose different targets).

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Quest Action: Discard Grappling Hook and exhaust attached character to commit attached character to the quest, using its [attack] instead of its [willpower] (or instead of its [defense] if the current quest has the siege keyword).

cards.name: Warden of the Havens
cards.rulesText: While the top card of your discard pile is an attachment, Warden of the Havens gets +2 [defense] and gains sentinel.
cards.flavor:
"...and if he comes, assailing the White Towers and the Havens, hereafter the Elves may have no escape from the lengthening shadows of Middle-earth."
<cite>Galdor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Anchor Watch
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy is declared as an attacker against you, declare an exhausted character you control as the defender. Resolve that effect again for each copy of Anchor Watch currently in your discard pile (all chosen characters are defending against this attack).

cards.name: Mariner's Compass
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] or a Scout character. Response: At the beginning of the travel phase, exhaust Mariner's Compass and attached character to search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a location. Switch that location with a location in the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Lindon Navigator
cards.rulesText: Lindon Navigator does not exhaust to commit to a quest, and can commit to quests while exhausted. Forced: After resolving a quest to which Lindon Navigator was committed, either discard it from play or discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: The Evening Star
cards.rulesText: Action: Place 2 progress on any location. Resolve that effect again for each copy of The Evening Star currently in your discard pile (you may choose new targets).
cards.flavor:
...for ever still a herald on
an errand that should never rest
to bear his shining lamp afar,
the Flammifer of Westernesse.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Explorer's Almanac
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a location in the staging area.
Progress from questing successfully may be placed on the attached location before it is placed on the current quest.

cards.name: Sailor of Lune
cards.rulesText: While the top card of your discard pile is an event, Sailor of Lune gets +1 [willpower] and gains: "Cannot be damaged while committed to the quest."
cards.flavor:
"They are sailing, sailing, sailing over the Sea, they are going into the West and leaving us," said Sam, half chanting the words, shaking his head sadly and solemnly.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elwing's Flight
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Ready a questing character and give that character +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase. Resolve that effect again for each copy of Elwing's Flight currently in your discard pile (you may choose different targets).
cards.flavor:
There flying Elwing came to him
and flame was in the darkness lit;
more bright than light of diamond
the fire upon her carcanet.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: To the Sea, to the Sea!
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor character. Action: Exhaust To the Sea, to the Sea! and discard X cards from your hand to reduce the cost of the next Noldor ally played this phase by X (to a minimum of 1).
cards.flavor:
To the Sea, to the Sea! The white gulls are crying,
The wind is blowing, and the white foam is flying.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Narya
cards.rulesText: Attach to Círdan the Shipwright or Gandalf. Attached character gains a [leadership] resource icon. Action: Exhaust Narya and attached character to choose and ready up to 2 allies. Each of those allies gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"For this is the Ring of Fire, and with it you may rekindle hearts in a world that grows chill."
<cite>Círdan, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Dáin Ironfoot
cards.rulesText: While Dáin Ironfoot is defending, he gains, 'Action: Discard the top card of your deck to give Dáin Ironfoot +1 [defense] for this attack. (Limit 3 times per phase.)'

cards.name: Soldier of Erebor
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck to ready Soldier of Erebor. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Man the Walls
cards.rulesText: Play only if no other copies of Man the Walls have been played this round. Planning Action: Reduce the cost of the next ally played by each player this phase by 1. Those allies cannot quest this round.

cards.name: Mirkwood Hunter
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
Reduce the cost to play Mirkwood Hunter by 1 for each attachment on the active location.

cards.name: Familiar Lands
cards.rulesText: Action: Each location with an attachment gets -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Warrior Sword
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a [tactics] or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] for each enemy engaged with you. (Limit +3 [attack].)

cards.name: Swift and Strong
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character you control attacks and destroys an enemy, exhaust a Weapon attached to that character to ready that character and give it +2 [attack] for its next attack this phase.

cards.name: Descendant of Girion
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Item attachments on Descendant of Girion by 1.

cards.name: Valiant Determination
cards.rulesText: Attach to an ally. Attached ally does not exhaust to quest.

cards.name: Ring of Thrór
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a Dwarf hero. Action: Exhaust Thrór's Ring and discard the top card of your deck to ready attached hero. If the discarded card is an attachment, put it into play.

cards.name: Barliman Butterbur
cards.rulesText: Response: After Barliman Butterbur takes damage from an undefended attack, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: “I’m run off my feet; but I’ll see what I can do for you.” —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Nob
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost of the first Item attachment you play on another Bree or Hobbit character each round by 1. Action: Exhaust Nob to draw a card. If that card is an Item attachment, ready a Bree character. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
“Where are you, you woolly-footed slow-coach?”
—Barliman Butterbur, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Harry Goatleaf
cards.rulesText: Response: Cancel 1 point of combat damage just dealt to a hero you control. (Limit once per round per hero.)
cards.flavor:
“Your business is your own, no doubt, but it’s my business to ask questions after nightfall.”
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bob
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bob enters play, search your deck for a Mount or Pony card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
“A poor old half-starved creature it is, but he won’t part with it for less than thrice its worth.”
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bree Pony
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Bree or Hobbit character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 hit point. Response: When attached character takes damage from an undefended attack, exhaust Bree Pony to reduce that damage by 1.
cards.flavor:
No horse or pony was to be got for love or money in the neighbourhood – except one.
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Half-pint
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Refresh Action: Discard Half-pint to heal up to 2 damage from attached character. Then, put an Item attachment in your discard pile on the top of your deck.
cards.flavor:
“I’ve a drop of good ale on tap, if you and your friends are willing.”
—Farmer Maggot, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Seasoned Forager
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero you control. Limit 1 per player. Your heroes cannot gain resources from player card effects. Action: Exhaust Seasoned Forager to reduce the cost of the next card you play this phase that matches the attached hero’s sphere by 1.

cards.name: Pint
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique Bree character. Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Pint to heal 1 damage from attached hero. Action: Discard Pint to heal 5 damage from attached hero.
cards.flavor: “Well, my merry folk, will you drink another draught with me before you go?” —Treebeard, The Return of the King

cards.name: Scheming Staddler
cards.rulesText: Response: After an undefended attack damages a hero you control, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: “He would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.” —Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bree-land Protector
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: Exhaust Bree-land Protector to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack and deal the attacking enemy another shadow card. If this attack deals no damage, return Bree-land Protector to its owner’s hand after the attack.

cards.name: A Stout Heart
cards.rulesText: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an undefended attack. After this attack damages a single hero, the controller of that hero may spend 1 resource from its pool to reduce their threat by 3.
cards.flavor:
“We come now to the very brink, where hope and despair are akin. To waver is to fall.”
—Aragorn, The Return of the King

cards.name: Gift of Foresight
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero with at least 2 printed [willpower]. Limit 1 per hero.
Attached hero gets +2 [defense] if it has not committed to the quest this round.
cards.flavor:
“Do not think that only by singing amid the trees, nor even by the slender arrows of elven-bows, is this land of Lothlórien maintained and defended.”
–Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Archet Alekeeper
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Response: After an undefended attack damages a hero you control, ready Archet Alekeeper and give it +1 [attack] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: “Gave me a chance of walking round the country and seeing folk, and hearing the news, and knowing where the good beer was.” —Robin Smallburrow, The Return of the King

cards.name: A Perilous Voyage
cards.rulesText: Side A Your minimum deck size is 100 cards. Your threat cannot be reduced by player card effects. Action: Exhaust this card and raise your threat by 1 to look at the top 2 cards of your deck, draw 1, and place the other on the bottom of your deck. Forced: When you would be eliminated by reaching your threat elimination level, flip this card over instead. Side B Your threat cannot be reduced by non-contract player card effects. Heroes you control do not exhaust to quest. Forced: When this card is flipped to this side, reduce your threat by 10. Search your deck for a card and either add it to your hand or play it, reducing its cost by 3. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
Thus came Aragorn... borne upon a wind from the Sea to the kingdom of Gondor...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Cannot gain resources from player card effects. The first player gains control of Bilbo Baggins and can trigger Action and Response effects on cards in the boons area. Action: Spend 1 [baggins] resource. Then, each player may draw 1 card. If Bilbo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Lucky Number
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Lucky Number to the victory display to choose a character controlled by each player. Give those characters +2 [willpower], +2 [attack], and +2 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: “Just let any one say I chose the wrong man or the wrong house, and you can stop at thirteen and have all the bad luck you like, or go back to digging coal.” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

cards.name: No Bag Went Over Me
cards.rulesText: Action: Add No Bag Went Over Me to the victory display to reduce each player’s threat by 3.
cards.flavor: Bilbo had just enough wits left, when Bert dropped him on the ground, to scramble out of the way of their feet… —The Hobbit

cards.name: Sting
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Sting to the victory display. Each player may choose an enemy in play and deal 2 damage to it.
cards.flavor: “These look like good blades… They were not made by any troll, nor by any smith among men in these parts and days…” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

cards.name: Bilbo's Magic Ring
cards.rulesText: Bilbo’s Magic Ring enters play with 1[pp] resources on it. Response: Discard 1 resource token from Bilbo’s Magic Ring to cancel up to 3 damage just dealt to Bilbo Baggins.
cards.flavor: …suddenly his hand met what felt like a tiny ring of cold metal lying on the floor of the tunnel. —The Hobbit

cards.name: He that Walks Unseen
cards.rulesText: Action: Add He that Walks Unseen to the victory display to choose a non-unique enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase. If there are 3 or more players, choose up to 2 non-unique enemies instead (they can be engaged with different players).
cards.flavor: And there was the ring still, in his left pocket, and it slipped on his finger. The goblins stopped short. They could not see a sign of him. He had vanished. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Guest of Eagles
cards.rulesText: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Guest of Eagles to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Great Eagles. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: Eagles are not kindly birds… But the ancient race of the northern mountains were the greatest of all birds; they were proud and strong and noble-hearted. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Friend of Bears
cards.rulesText: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Friend of Bears to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Beorn or Giant-sized Wrath. If there are 3 or more players, you may reveal both.
cards.flavor: “Mr. Baggins’ eyes are sharper than yours, if you have not seen each night after dark a great bear going along with us or sitting far off in the moon watching our camps.” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

cards.name: The Stinging Fly
cards.rulesText: Action: Add The Stinging Fly to the victory display. Each player may ready a character they control.
cards.flavor: He felt a different person, and much fiercer and bolder in spite of an empty stomach, as he wiped his sword on the grass and put it back into its sheath. —The Hobbit

cards.name: The Web-cutter
cards.rulesText: Action: Add The Web-cutter to the victory display. Each player may return up to 5 cards from their discard pile to their deck. Each player may search their deck for a card, add it to their hand, and shuffle their deck.
cards.flavor: He darted backwards and forwards, slashing at spider-threads, hacking at their legs, and stabbing at their fat bodies if they came too near. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Drowner of Friends
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Drowner of Friends to the victory display. Each player may put an ally from their discard pile into play.
cards.flavor: “I do hope I put the lids on tight enough!” —Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

cards.name: Barrel-rider
cards.rulesText: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add Barrel-rider to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Men of the Lake.
cards.flavor: …it was like trying to ride, without bridle or stirrups, a round-bellied pony that was always thinking of rolling on the grass. —The Hobbit

cards.name: Thror's Golden Cup
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Thror’s Golden Cup to the victory display. Each player adds 2 resources to the pool of a hero they control.
cards.flavor: “I suppose you got a fair price for that cup last night?” —Smaug, The Hobbit

cards.name: The Arkenstone
cards.rulesText: Action: If the main quest is The Battle of the Five Armies, add The Arkenstone to the victory display to reveal the set-aside Dwarves of Dáin or Elves of Mirkwood. If there are 3 or more players, you may reveal both.
cards.flavor: “…it shone like silver in the firelight, like water in the sun, like snow under the stars, like rain upon the Moon!” —Thorin Oakenshield, The Hobbit

cards.name: Without a Hat
cards.rulesText: Players cannot play attachments. Forced: At the end of the first round, remove Without a Hat from the game.
cards.flavor: “I’m awfully sorry,” said Bilbo, “but I have come without my hat, and I have left my pocket-handkerchief behind, and I haven’t got any money.” —The Hobbit

cards.name: Two by Two
cards.rulesText: Each player cannot play or put into play more than 2 cards during each planning phase.
