cards.flavor: “I was coming over the mountains with a friend or two…” —Gandalf, The Hobbit

cards.name: Longing for Home
cards.rulesText: Forced: After Longing for Home enters your hand or discard pile, attach it to the hero you control with the highest [willpower]. While attached to a hero, counts as a Condition attachment with the text: “Attached hero gets –2 [willpower]. Forced: After a Title boon is earned, shuffle Longing for Home into your deck.”

cards.name: Beyond the Original Bargain
cards.rulesText:
If you choose Beyond the Original Bargain as your contract, you can choose 2 additional contracts for this game. Each contract you choose must be different.
Your starting threat is increased by 4.
cards.flavor: “I have got you out of two messes already…” —Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

cards.name: Thorin's Company
cards.rulesText: This contract cannot be chosen unless you are playing a scenario featuring [baggins] Bilbo Baggins. Setup: Search the top 13 cards of your deck, choose 2 allies among those cards and put them into play under your control. The total printed cost of cards you put into play in this way cannot exceed 6. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

cards.name: Master Burglar
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Attach to Bilbo Baggins. He gets +2 [willpower] and –1 threat cost. If you have won The Hobbit ALeP community scenario with 10 or more boons in play, you may attach this card from your collection to an eligible printed hero when you put your starting heroes into play.

cards.name: Háma
cards.rulesText: Response: After Háma is declared as an attacker, return a [tactics] event from your discard pile to your hand. Then, choose and discard 1 card from your hand. (Limit 3 times per game for the group.)
cards.flavor: "Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Erestor
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand to draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor:
Beside Glorfindel there were several other counsellors of Elrond's household, of whom Erestor was the chief...
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Fresh Tracks
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy is added to the staging area, deal 1 damage to that enemy. Players ignore that enemy while making engagement checks this round.

cards.name: Erebor Battle Master
cards.rulesText: Erebor Battle Master gets +1 [attack] for each other Dwarf ally you control. (Limit +4 [attack].)

cards.name: Ring Mail
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Restricted. Attached character gets +1 hit point and +1 [defense].
cards.flavor:
"And all the arrows of all the hunters in the world would be in vain..."
<cite>Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Out of Sight
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 3. Action: Enemies engaged with you cannot attack you this phase.

cards.name: Ever My Heart Rises
cards.rulesText: Attach a Dwarf character. Response: After you travel to a Mountain or Underground location, ready attached character and reduce your threat by 1.
cards.flavor:
'This is more to my liking,' said the dwarf, stomping on the stones. 'Ever my heart rises as we draw near the mountains.'
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Warden of Healing
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Warden of Healing to heal 1 damage on up to 2 different characters. Then, you may pay 2 [lore] resources to ready Warden of Healing.
cards.flavor: "But for long years we healers have only sought to patch the rents made by the men of swords." <cite>Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Word of Command
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust an Istari character to search your deck for 1 card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Picking up a faggot he held it aloft for a moment, and then with a word of command, naur an edraith ammen! he thrust the end of his staff into the midst of it. At once a great spout of green and blue flame sprang out, and the wood flared and sputtered." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Love of Tales
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After a Song card is played, exhaust Love of Tales to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"I listened because I couldn't help myself, if you know what I mean. Lor bless me, sir, but I do love tales of that sort."
<cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Each enemy engaged with you gets -1 [defense]. Response: After Aragorn participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, choose an enemy not engaged with you and engage that enemy.
cards.flavor: "I serve no man," said Aragorn; "but the servants of Sauron I pursue into whatever land they may go." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Halbarad
cards.rulesText:
While you are engaged with any enemy, Halbarad does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
You may optionally engage 1 additional enemy during the encounter phase.
cards.flavor: "Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not." <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Weather Hills Watchman
cards.rulesText: Response: After Weather Hills Watchman enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Signal card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Rangers use runes, and they come here sometimes." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Dúnedain Hunter
cards.rulesText: Forced: After Dúnedain Hunter enters play, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a non-unique enemy and put it into play engaged with you. If no enemy enters play by this effect, discard Dúnedain Hunter. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Sarn Ford Sentry
cards.rulesText: Response: After Sarn Ford Sentry enters play, draw 1 card for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Warden of Annúminas
cards.rulesText: Warden of Annúminas gets +1 [willpower] for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: Rangers passed at times beyond the hills, but they were few and did not stay. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ranger Summons
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Dúnedain hero. Planning Action: Shuffle 1 of your set aside Ranger of the North allies with the encounter keyword into the encounter deck. Then, remove Ranger Summons from the game.
cards.flavor: "We rode as swiftly as we might when your summons came." <cite>Halbarad, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Tireless Hunters
cards.rulesText: Play only before the resolving enemy attacks step. Combat Action: Choose an enemy not engaged with you. Engage that enemy. Then, discard a shadow card from that enemy, if able.
cards.flavor: "Many evil things there are that your strong walls and bright swords do not stay." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Expert Trackers
cards.rulesText: Response: After you engage an enemy, exhaust a Scout or Ranger character to place X progress tokens on a location. X is the engaged enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor: "At last!" said Aragorn. "Here are the tracks that we seek!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Heir of Valandil
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain hero. Planning Action: Exhaust Heir of Valandil to reduce the cost of the next Dúnedain ally you play this phase by 1 for each enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "But my home, such as I have, is in the North. For here the heirs of Valandil have ever dwelt in long line unbroken from father unto son for many generations." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Athelas
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain or Healer character. Action: Discard Athelas and exhaust attached character to heal all damage on a character. You may discard a Condition attachment from that character.
cards.flavor: "...it is a healing plant that the Men of the West brought to Middle-earth. Athelas they named it..." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Secret Vigil
cards.rulesText: Attach to an enemy. Limit 1 per enemy. Attached enemy gets -1 [threat]. Response: When attached enemy is destroyed, reduce each player's threat by the attached enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor: "If simple folk are free from care and fear, simple they will be, and we must be secret to keep them so." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Star Brooch
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dúnedain or Noldor hero. Limit 1 per hero. While you are engaged with an enemy, attached hero gets +1 [willpower] and cannot have its [willpower] reduced.
cards.flavor: ...each cloak was pinned upon the left shoulder by a brooch of silver shaped like a rayed star. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gather Information
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Response: After this stage is defeated, each player may search his deck for 1 card and add it to his hand. Each player shuffles his deck.
cards.flavor: Aragorn halted and examined the tracks closely. <cite>The Tower Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ranger of the North
cards.rulesText: Encounter. Surge. Ranged. Sentinel. When Revealed: The first player chooses a player to take control of Ranger of the North. Then, either deal 2 damage to an enemy or place 2 progress tokens on a location.

cards.name: Gwaihir
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel. Cannot have restricted attachments. Gwaihir does not ready during the refresh phase. Response: After an Eagle ally enters or leaves play, ready Gwaihir. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Hobbit Archer
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
Hobbit Archer gets +1 [attack] while attacking an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat.
cards.flavor:
"If you lay a finger on this farmer, or on anyone else, you will be shot at once."
-Merry, The Return of the King

cards.name: Red Book of Westmarch
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. While attached hero is committed to the quest, each Hobbit character gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you quest successfully, exhaust Red Book of Westmarch to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.

cards.name: Dale Messenger
cards.rulesText: Response: After Dale Messenger enters play, choose a player. That player heals 1 damage from each character he controls with a player card attachment.
cards.flavor:
"We discover that messengers have come also to King Brand in Dale..."
-Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Song of Healing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to heal 1 damage from attached hero. Any player may trigger this effect.
cards.flavor:
...behind him stood Galadriel, tall and white: a circlet of golden flowers was in her hair, and in her hand she held a hard, and she sang.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Eagle Emissary
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: After Eagle Emissary quests successfully, pay 1 [tactics] resource or discard it from play.
cards.flavor:
...and out of the East there came a great Eagle flying, and he bore tidings beyond hope from The Lords of the West...
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Bilbo's Plan
cards.rulesText: Response: After you attack and destroy an enemy, shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until an enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the staging area to discard a non-unique location with [threat] equal to or less that that enemy's [threat].

cards.name: Spare Pipe
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gets +1 hit point. Response: After you play Spare Pipe, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an event and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor:
"I have carried it a long way, though I don"t know why."
-Pippin, The Two Towers

cards.name: Smoke and Think
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce the cost of the next card you play by 1 for each Pipe you control.
cards.flavor:
Merry smiled. "Well then," he said, "if Strider will provide what is needed, I will smoke and think."
-The Return of the King

cards.name: Wilyador
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Sentinel. Cannot have restricted attachments. Forced: At the end of the round, discard Wilyador unless the players as a group spend 1 resource.

cards.name: Messenger of the King
cards.rulesText: Side A You cannot choose more than 2 heroes during setup. Setup: Choose a non-neutral unique ally from your deck and put it into play. Add the sum of that ally's printed [willpower], [attack], [defense], and hit points to your starting threat. Then, flip this card over and attach it to that ally. Side B Attached ally loses the ally card type and gains the hero card type Attached character cannot be readied more than once per phase Messenger of the King is immune to card effects while attached character is in play. If attached character leaves play, remove Messenger of the King from the game.
cards.flavor:
"I am a messenger of the King" he said. "You are speaking to the King's friend, and one of the most renowned in all the lands of the West."
-Pippin, The Return of the King

cards.name: Théoden
cards.rulesText:
Sentinel.
Each [tactics] hero with a printed [tactics] resource icon gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: 'To me! To me!' cried Théoden. 'Up Eorlingas! Fear no darkness!' <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Pelargir Ship Captain
cards.rulesText: Response: After Pelargir Ship Captain enters play, move 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero you control to another hero's resource pool.

cards.name: Visionary Leadership
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor hero. While attached hero has at least 1 resource in its resource pool, Gondor characters get +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor: "...still the lords of Gondor have keener sight than lesser men..." <cite>Denethor, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Spear of the Mark
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Rohan character. Attached character gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if attacking an enemy in the staging area).
cards.flavor: Right through the press drove Théoden Thengel's son, and his spear was shivered as he threw down thier chieftan. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Forth Eorlingas!
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Each Rohan hero can be declared as an attacker against enemies in the staging area this phase.
cards.flavor: "Oaths ye have taken: now fulfill them all, to lord and land and league of friendship!" <cite>Théoden, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Steed of the Mark
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Gondor or Rohan hero. Response: after attached hero commits to a quest, spend 1 resource from attached hero's resource pool to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: ...fresh horses were always in readiness to bear his errand-riders to Rohan in the Noth... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Lay of Nimrodel
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a [spirit] hero. Until the end of the phase, that hero gets +1 [willpower] for each resource in its resource pool.
cards.flavor:
An Elven-maid there was of old.
A shining star by day:
Her mantle white was hemmed with hold,
Her shoes of silver-grey.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ered Nimrais Prospector
cards.rulesText: Response: After Ered Nimrais Prospector enters play, discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Then, choose and shuffle 1 card from your discard pile back into your deck.

cards.name: Scroll of Isildur
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] hero. Reduce the cost to play Scroll of Isildur by 1 for each hero you control with a printed [lore] resource icon. Action: Discard Scroll of Isildur to play any [lore] event card in your discard pile as if it were in your hand. Then, place that event on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Hidden Cache
cards.rulesText: Response: After Hidden Cache is discarded from your deck, add 2 resources to the resource pool of a hero you control. Action: Spend 1 resource to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor:
...there was a good deal of food jumbled carlessly on shelves and on the ground, among an untidy litter of plunder...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Silver Belt
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Silvan or Hobbit hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After a character you control leaves play, exhaust Silver Belt to give attached hero +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: …small silver belts, each with a clasp wrought like a golden flower. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Phial of Galadriel
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Response: Discard Phial of Galadriel to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack made by an enemy engaged with you. Give the attached hero +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: “May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out.” —Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Golden Hair
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Limit 3 copies of Golden Hair in the victory display. Action: Add Golden Hair to the victory display to reduce your threat by 3.
cards.flavor: “…a single strand of your hair, which surpasses the gold of the earth as the stars surpass the gems of the mine.” —Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Sword-sheath
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Response: After attached hero destroys an enemy engaged with you, exhaust Sword-sheath and a Weapon attachment on the attached hero to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: “The blade that is drawn from this sheath shall not be stained or broken even in defeat.” —Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Ring-bound Soldiers
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: When you would trigger retreat X, the Ring-lord player may exhaust The One Ring to reduce the X value by 2.
cards.flavor: “Not used, I say, unless at the uttermost end of need…” —Denethor, The Return of the King

cards.name: Chance Meeting
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Add Chance Meeting to the victory display to search your deck for a card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If you have earned at least 5 boons, you may play or put into play that card for no cost.
cards.flavor: A large knob-knuckled hand was laid on each of their shoulders, and they were twisted round, gently but irresistibly… —The Two Towers

cards.name: Drop of Miruvor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Drop of Miruvor to the victory display to (choose 1): ready attached hero, add 1 resource to the attached hero’s pool, draw 2 cards, or reduce your threat by 3.
cards.flavor: “Just a mouthful each–for all of us. It is very precious. It is miruvor, the cordial of Imladris.” —Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Mallorn Bow
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Restricted. Limit 1 per hero.
Attached hero gains ranged and gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if you are the only player).
cards.flavor: …a bow such as the Galadhrim used, longer and stouter than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elf-hair. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Lady's Favor
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] (+2 to each attribute instead if you have earned at least 5 boons).
cards.flavor: “It is enough for me to have seen the Lady of the Galadhrim, and to have heard her gentle words.” —Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: A New Alliance
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per player.
Each character you control gets +1 [defense]. If you have earned at least 5 boons, each character you control gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor: “Come! Let us make this bargain–if we both return safe out of the perils that await us, we will journey for a while together.” —Legolas, The Two Towers

cards.name: Flask of Miruvor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Flask of Miruvor to the victory display to choose up to 3 copies of Drop of Miruvor in the victory display and attach them to heroes you control.
cards.flavor: …he felt a new strength of heart, and the heavy drowsiness left his limbs. The others also revived and found fresh hope and vigour. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Eagles are Coming!
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per player. Action: If it is the 6th round, add Eagles are Coming! to the victory display to search your collection for an Eagle ally and put it into play under any player’s control. Repeat this effect an additional time for each hero in your discard pile.
cards.flavor: The hosts of Mordor looked up and wondered what this sign might mean. —The Return of the King

cards.name: The Will of Ilúvatar
cards.rulesText: Attach to your play area. Limit 1 per player. Response: When you declare an attack against a Villain enemy, it gets –X [defense] for that attack. X is the number of boons you have earned. Villain enemies cannot be immune to this effect.
cards.flavor: …for to none but himself has Ilúvatar revealed all that he has in store, and in every age there come forth things that are new and have no foretelling, for they do not proceed from the past. —The Silmarillion

cards.name: Word of Healing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Add Word of Healing to the victory display to choose a hero in any player’s discard pile and put it into play, under its owner’s control (without turncoat if it had it when it left play). That hero’s owner may attach up to 2 attachments from their discard pile to it.

cards.name: The Gifts of Galadriel
cards.rulesText: Side A Your deck must be exactly half allies and half attachments. Setup: Flip this card over. Side B Action: Play ally Galadriel from your hand for no cost. You do not need a resource match. Response: When you play or put into play an attachment, exhaust either Galadriel or The Gifts of Galadriel to attach it to a character that would be ineligible due to its Traits or resource icons. Then, either draw 1 card or add 1 resource to the pool of a hero you control. If another player now controls that attachment, do both instead. (Limit twice per round.)
cards.flavor: “We have drunk the cup of parting,” she said, “and the shadows fall between us. But before you go, I have brought in my ship gifts which the Lord and Lady of the Galadhrim now offer you in memory of Lothlórien.” —Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: At the End of All Things
cards.rulesText: Side A You can only choose 2 starting heroes. They each get +4 threat cost, +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], +1 hit point, and they each gain a resource icon matching the other hero’s printed sphere. They cannot gain resources from attachment card effects, and they cannot be healed. Action: Exhaust At the End of All Things to deal 1 damage to one of your starting heroes and ready your other starting hero. Action: Flip this card over. You cannot trigger this effect during the first 3 rounds. Side B Your starting heroes each get +4 threat cost, +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], +1 hit point, and they each gain a resource icon matching the other hero’s printed sphere. They cannot gain resources from attachment card effects. Forced: When this card flips to this side, add 3 resources to each of your starting heroes’ pools. Search your deck for 2 cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Old Bogey-stories
cards.rulesText: Setup: The first player attaches Old Bogey-stories to a hero in play. Action: Add Old Bogey-stories to the victory display to shuffle your hand of at least 6 cards into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.
cards.flavor: "If you mean the old bogey-stories Fatty's nurses used to tell him, about goblins and wolves and things of that sort, I should say no." -Merry, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Frodo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust The One Ring and spend 1 [fellowship] resource to target the attacking enemy. Then, this attack deals no damage and each player raises his threat by 2.
cards.flavor: "But there is more about you now than appears on the surface." <cite>Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Gandalf
cards.rulesText: Play with the top card of your deck faceup. Once per phase, you may play the top card of your deck as if it was in your hand. When playing a card this way, Gandalf is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], [tactics], and [spirit] icons.
cards.flavor: "I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Galadriel
cards.rulesText: At the end of the round, discard Galadriel from play. Response: After you play Galadriel from your hand, search the top 5 cards of your deck for an attachment of cost 3 or less and put it into play. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

cards.name: Boromir
cards.rulesText: Boromir gets +2 [defense] while defending against an enemy with an engagement cost higher than your threat. Response: After Boromir takes any amount of damage, ready him.

cards.name: Elrond
cards.rulesText: At the end of the round, discard Elrond from play. Response: After Elrond enters play, choose one: heal all damage on a hero, discard a Condition attachment, or each player draws 1 card.

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bilbo Baggins enters play, search your deck for a Pipe attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "Elves may thrive on speech alone, and Dwarves endure great weariness, but I am an old Hobbit, and I miss my meal at noon." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Flame of Anor
cards.rulesText: Action: Add Flame of Anor to the victory display and discard the top card of your deck to ready an Istari character you control. That character gets +X [attack] until the end of the phase where X is the discarded card's cost.
cards.flavor: "You cannot pass!" <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Gandalf's Staff
cards.rulesText: Attach to Gandalf. Restricted. Action: Exhaust Gandalf's Staff to (choose one): choose a player to draw 1 card, add 1 resource to a hero's resource pool, or discard a shadow card from a non-unique enemy.
cards.flavor: ...he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a feint radiance. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Wizard Pipe
cards.rulesText: Attach to an Istari character. Limit 1 per character. Action: Exhaust Wizard Pipe to exchange a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.
cards.flavor: ...there was a long silence, broken only by the soft puffs of Gandalf's pipe, as he blew white smoke-rings out of the window. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Fellowship of the Ring
cards.rulesText: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Each hero gets +1 [willpower]. Forced: After a character is destroyed, discard Fellowship of the Ring.
cards.flavor:
"The Company of the Ring shall be Nine: and the Nine Walkers shall be set against the Nine Riders that are evil."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Sting
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After attached hero exhausts to defend an attack, discard the top card of the encounter deck. Deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the discarded card's [threat].

cards.name: Mithril Shirt
cards.rulesText: Attach to the Ring-bearer. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "I should feel happier if I knew you were wearing it. I have a fancy it would turn even the knives of the Black Riders..." -Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Glamdring
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Warrior hero or Gandalf. Restricted. Attached character gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attached character destroys an Orc enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "...at his side was the elven-sword Glamdring, the mate of Orcrist that lay now upon the breast of Thorin under the Lonely Mountain." -The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Andúril
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noble hero or Aragorn. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense]. Response: After an attack in which the attached hero defended resolves, exhaust Andúril to target the enemy that just attacked. Declare attached hero as an attacker against that enemy (and resolve the attack).

cards.name: Phial of Galadriel
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Phial of Galadriel to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to give each enemy engaged with you -4 [attack] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out." -Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Three Golden Hairs
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Three Golden Hairs to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to lower each player's threat by 3. Then, each player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "...your hands shall flow with gold, and yet over you gold shall have no dominion." -Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Lórien Rope
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Lórien Rope to the victory display, and remove it from the campaign pool to give each location in the staging area -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "What a piece of luck you had that rope!" -Frodo, The Two Towers

cards.name: Leaf-wrapped Lembas
cards.rulesText: Setup: Attach to a hero in play. Action: Add Leaf-wrapped Lembas to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool, to ready all heroes in play.
cards.flavor: Often in their hearts they thanked the lady of Lórien for the gift of lembas, for they could eat of it and find new strength even as they ran. -The Two Towers

cards.name: Lust for the Ring
cards.rulesText: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Attach to a non-[fellowship] hero in play. Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After The One Ring exhausts, raise each player's threat by 1 and reduce attached hero's [willpower] to 0 until the end of the round."

cards.name: Shadow of Fear
cards.rulesText: Doomed 1. Surge. When Revealed: Treat the printed text box of each character in play as blank (except for Traits) until the end of the round. Shadow: Defending character does not count its [defense].

cards.name: Pursued by the Enemy
cards.rulesText: Doomed 1. Surge. When Revealed: Each enemy engaged with a player, and not in the staging area, makes an immediate attack. Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Overcome by Grief
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add Overcome by Grief to the staging area. Forced: After a character is destroyed, if Overcome by Grief is unattached, attach to a hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, exhaust attached hero. Until the end of the round, attached hero cannot ready.")

cards.name: Grievous Wound
cards.rulesText: Setup: Add Grievous Wound to the staging area. Forced: After a hero takes damage, if Grievous Wound is unattached, attach to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After attached hero exhausts, deal 1 damage to it.")

cards.name: Followed by Night
cards.rulesText: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Put the topmost enemy of the encounter deck discard pile into play engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "Quite apart from murder by night on his own account, he may put any enemy that is about on our track." –Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Ill Fate
cards.rulesText: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Attach to a hero you control. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After a character you control is destroyed, raise your threat by 2.")
cards.flavor: "Alas! An ill fate is on me this day, and all that I do goes amiss." –Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Elrohir
cards.rulesText: While Elladan is in play, Elrohir gets +2 [defense]. Response: After Elrohir is declared as a defender, pay 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
cards.flavor:
"We will not turn back."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Taking Initiative
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard the top card of your deck. If the discarded card's printed cost is equal to or higher than the number of characters you control, draw 2 cards and deal 2 damage to any enemy.

cards.name: Timely Aid
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 3. Action: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck and put 1 revealed ally into play, if able. Shuffle all other revealed cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Unseen Strike
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a character you control. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 [attack] while attacking an enemy with a higher engagement cost than your threat.

cards.name: Keeping Count
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] for each resource token on another copy of Keeping Count that is above the current number of resource tokens on this card. Forced: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 resource token on this card.

cards.name: Bofur
cards.rulesText: Quest Action: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to put Bofur into play from your hand, exhausted and committed to a quest. If you quest successfully this phase and Bofur is still in play, return him to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Get up lazy-bones..." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Renewed Friendship
cards.rulesText: Response: After another player plays an attachment on a hero you control, you may (choose 1): ready 1 of that player's heroes, have that player draw 1 card, or lower that player's threat by 2.

cards.name: Ravenhill Scout
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Ravenhill Scout to move up to 2 progress tokens from 1 location to another location.
cards.flavor: "They made their first camp on the western side of the great southern spur, which ended in a height called Ravenhill." <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Needful to Know
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 2. Action: Raise your threat by 1 to look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, reduce your threat by X, where X is the threat of that card.

cards.name: Good Meal
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Action: Discard Good Meal to lower the cost of the next event you play this round that matches attached hero's sphere by 2.

cards.name: Hirluin the Fair
cards.rulesText: Ranged. You may use resources from Hirluin the Fair's resource pool to pay for Outlands ally cards of any sphere.
cards.flavor: Hirluin the Fair of the Green Hills from Pinnath Gelin... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Warrior of Lossarnach
cards.rulesText: Each Outlands character you control gets +1 [defense].
cards.flavor: ... grim-faced they were, and shorter and somewhat swarthier than any men that Pippin had yet seen in Gondor. <cite> The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gaining Strength
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard 2 resources from your hero's resource pool to add 3 resources to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "Nay, my friends, I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it..." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Knights of the Swan
cards.rulesText: Each Outlands character you control gets +1 [attack].
cards.flavor: ...foremost on the field rode the swan-knights of Dol Amroth with their Prince and his blue banner at their head. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Gondorian Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Restricted. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gains +1 [defense]. (+2 [defense] instead if attached hero has the Gondor trait.)
cards.flavor:
There flowered a White Tree, and that was for Gondor...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ethir Swordsman
cards.rulesText: Each Outlands character you control gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
We heard of the horns in the hills ringing,
the swords shining in the South-kingdom.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ring of Barahir
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 hit point for each Artifact attachment attached to it. If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a [lore] resource icon.

cards.name: Anfalas Herdsman
cards.rulesText: Each Outlands character you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: From the Anfalas, the Langstrand far away, a long line of men of many sorts, hunters and herdsmen and men of little villages... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Mithrandir's Advice
cards.rulesText: Action: Draw 1 card for each hero you control with a printed [lore] resource icon.
cards.flavor: "Let none now reject the counsels of Gandalf, whose long labours against Sauron come at last to their test." <cite>Aragorn, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: A Good Harvest
cards.rulesText: Action: Name a sphere. Until the end of the phase, you can spend resources of any sphere when paying for cards that belong to the named sphere.
cards.flavor: The townlands were rich, with wide tilth and many orchards, and homesteads there were with oast and garner, fold and byre, and many rills rippling through the green from the highlands down to the Anduin. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elena
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost of each Instrument attachment you play by 1. Setup: Search your deck for an Instrument attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Tom Bombadil
cards.rulesText: X is the number of Song cards attached to Tom Bombadil. Response: After you play a Song card, either deal 2 damage to an enemy engaged with a player or heal 2 damage from a character. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Goldberry
cards.rulesText: Minstrel characters with at least 1 Song attachment do not exhaust to quest. Response: After you play a Song event, attach it to a Minstrel character. It counts as a Song attachment with a blank text box. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Lobelia Sackville-Baggins
cards.rulesText: You may look at other players’ hands at any time. Action: Choose an Item attachment in play or in a player’s hand. Pay X resources to attach it to Lobelia Sackville-Baggins, even if she is ineligible for it. X is its printed cost. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: An Unexpected Party
cards.rulesText: Action: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for up to 2 cards with the Song, Instrument, or Minstrel trait and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor:
Chip the glasses and crack the plates!
Blunt the knives and bend the forks!
That’s what Bilbo Baggins hates
Smash the bottles and burn the corks!
—The Hobbit

cards.name: Song of Slumber
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Minstrel hero. Combat Action: Choose up to 2 enemies engaged with you. Those enemies cannot attack you this phase.
cards.flavor: All his court were cast down in slumber, and all the fires faded and were quenched… —The Silmarillion

cards.name: Songs of Slaying
cards.rulesText: Action: Each Minstrel character gets +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. Each character with a Song attachment gets +1 [attack] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
Spear shall be shaken, shield be splintered,
A sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!
—The Return of the King

cards.name: Wooden Lyre
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] or Minstrel hero. Restricted. Action: Exhaust an Instrument attachment to give a character defending an attack +1 [defense] for that attack.
cards.flavor: …for ever blending its innumerable notes in an endless changeful music. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bilbo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Response: After Bilbo Baggins commits to the quest, look at the top card of your deck. If that card has flavor text, you may (choose 1): leave it there, discard it, or spend 1 [lore] resource to add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: There he wandered long in a dream of music that turned into running water, and then suddenly into a voice. It seemed to be the voice of Bilbo chanting verses. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Hey Dol! Merry Dol!
cards.rulesText: Action: Reduce your threat by 1. Then, if this is the first time you played a copy of Hey Dol! Merry Dol! this round, you may exhaust a Minstrel hero to return it to your hand.
cards.flavor:
Hey dol! merry dol! ring a dong dillo!
Ring a dong! hop along! fal lal the willow!
Tom Bom, jolly Tom, Tom Bombadillo!
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Fatty Lumpkin
cards.rulesText: Attach to Tom Bombadil or a Hobbit character. Action: Exhaust Fatty Lumpkin to ready a character you control with a Mount attachment.
cards.flavor:
“But now, my jolly Lumpkin, old Tom’s going to ride.”
—Tom Bombadil, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bronze Bell
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [lore] or Minstrel hero. Restricted. Action: Exhaust an Instrument attachment to choose a player. Each enemy engaged with that player gets –1 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: Three strokes it rang, like silver in the air, and ceased: the third hour from the rising of the sun. —The Return of the King

cards.name: Daughter of Withywindle
cards.rulesText: Response: After Daughter of Withywindle enters play, choose a hero with a Song attachment. Until the end of the round, that hero gains the [leadership], [lore], [spirit], and [tactics] icons.
cards.flavor:
O spring-time and summer-time, and spring again after!
O wind on the waterfall, and the leaves’ laughter!
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Frodo Baggins to return a card from your discard pile to your hand. (Limit once per game.) If Frodo Baggins is destroyed, or if he is discarded from play by a card effect, the players lose the game.
cards.flavor:
“I wish it need not have happened in my time.”
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Bilbo's Walking Song
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit or Minstrel character. Action: Exhaust attached character to place 1 progress on a location.
cards.flavor:
Still round the corner there may wait
A new road or a secret gate,
And though we pass them by today,
Tomorrow we may come this way
And take the hidden paths that run
Towards the Moon or to the Sun.
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Let Us Sing Together
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a hero with the printed Minstrel trait. Attach to a character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [willpower] and gains the Minstrel trait.
cards.flavor:
Reeds by the shady pool, lilies on the water:
Old Tom Bombadil and the River-daughter!
—The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Lamenter of the Lost
cards.rulesText: Devoted. Enters play exhausted. Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Lamenter of the Lost enters play, discard an Ent or Song card from your hand to ready it.
cards.flavor: Come back to me! Come back to me… —The Two Towers

cards.name: Bilbo's Spoons
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique Hobbit character. Attach to a hero. Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during the resource phase. Forced: At the beginning of the planning phase, either discard Bilbo’s Spoons from play or attach it to a hero with a higher threat cost than the attached hero.

cards.name: A Burglar Indeed!
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero. Action: Exhaust A Burglar Indeed! to choose a card with a guarded attachment. Deal 1 damage to that card if it is an enemy, or place 1 progress on that card if it is a location (deal 2 damage or place 2 progress instead if attached hero is Bilbo Baggins).
cards.flavor: …he lifted it, shut his eyes, and put it in his deepest pocket. “Now I am a burglar indeed!” thought he. —Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

cards.name: Golden Horn
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] or Minstrel hero. Restricted. Action: Exhaust an Instrument attachment to give an enemy in the staging area –1 [threat] until the end of the phase. If this effect reduces the enemy’s [threat] to 0, deal 1 damage to it.
cards.flavor: At that moment, among the trees nearby, a horn rang out. —The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Keep It Secret
cards.rulesText: Side A Setup: Each player may place 1 [threat] token on Keep It Secret to opt in. Flip this card over. Side B Action: Raise your secrecy level by 1 for the remainder of the game and reduce your threat elimination level by 2 for the remainder of the game. Response: At the beginning of the planning phase, if there are at least 3 players in the game and each player is in secrecy, the next card you play this round gains secrecy 1.
cards.flavor: “…and keep it safe! Now I am going to bed.” —Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: The Riddle-game
cards.rulesText: Side A Setup: Choose a hero you control to be “the Thief”. If the Thief has the Hobbit trait, place 1 progress token here. Choose an attachment in your collection with the guarded (X) keyword to be “the Birthday-present”. Attach it to the Thief, ignoring the guarded (X) keyword. Search your collection for Hungry Creature and put it into play engaged with you. Flip this card over. Side B The Thief cannot be discarded from play or ready more than once per phase. Forced: After you place a third progress token here, remove Hungry Creature and The Riddle-game from the game. Forced: After you place a third damage token here, remove Hungry Creature, the Thief, the Birthday-present, and The Riddle-game from the game.

cards.name: Hungry Creature
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or be attacked. Immune to other card effects (except for The Riddle-game). Forced: When Hungry Creature is dealt a shadow card, look at it and note its . The engaged player may discard a card from their hand with a matching printed cost to place 1 progress token on The Riddle-game. Otherwise, place 1 damage token on The Riddle-game.

cards.name: Brand son of Bain
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Brand son of Bain attacks and destroys an enemy engaged with a player, ready one of that player’s characters. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Gimli
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Gimli is declared as a defender, spend 1 resource from his pool to ready another hero. If that hero is Legolas, he gets +1[attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens…"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Legolas
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Legolas commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready another hero. If that hero is Gimli, he gets +1[willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"I go to find the Sun!"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Greenwood Archer
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Greenwood Archer enters play, ready a hero.
cards.flavor:
They dwelt most often by the edges of the woods, from which they could escape at times to hunt...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Erebor Guard
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: When you play Erebor Guard from you hand, discard the top 2 cards of your deck to reduce its cost by 2.
cards.flavor:
...the fortress of the dwarves could not be taken by surprise.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Halfling Bounder
cards.rulesText: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Halfling Bounder gains: "Response: Discard Halfling Bounder to cancel the 'when revealed' effects of an encounter card that was just revealed from the encounter deck."
cards.flavor:
"The Bounders have never been so busy before."
<cite>Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Vigilant Dúnadan
cards.rulesText: While there is a side quest in the victory display, Vigilant Dúnadan does not exhaust to defend.
cards.flavor:
"I don't think we've rightly understood till now what they did for us."
<cite>Barliman Butterbur, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Unlikely Friendship
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Silvan trait and another unique character with the Dwarf trait. Action: Draw 1 card and add 1 resource to the resource pool of a hero you control.
cards.flavor:
...folk that saw them pass marvelled to see such companions…
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Well Warned
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a unique character with the Noble trait and another unique character with the Scout trait. Response: After a player engages an enemy, reduce his threat by X, where X is that enemy's printed [threat].
cards.flavor:
...the Captains of the West were well warned by their scouts...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Dour Handed
cards.rulesText: Action: Deal X damage to an enemy engaged with you. X is the number of side quests in the victory display.
cards.flavor:
...the tides of fate had turned against them and their doom was at hand.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Dwarven Shield
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[defense]. Response: After attached hero takes damage from an enemy attack, exhaust Dwarven Shield to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor:
...each of them had also a short broad sword at his side and a round shield slung at his back.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Mirkwood Long-knife
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Silvan hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1[willpower] and +1[attack].
cards.flavor:
Legolas had a bow and a quiver, and at his belt a long white knife.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: The Road Goes Ever On
cards.rulesText: Attach to a quest card in play. Response: When attached quest is defeated, the first player chooses a player. That player searches his deck for a side quest, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck.
cards.flavor:
"Now far ahead the Road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can..."
<cite>Frodo Baggins, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Storm Comes
cards.rulesText:
Limit 1 copy of The Storm Comes in the victory display.
While this quest is in the victory display, the first ally played by each player each round does not require a resource match.
cards.flavor:
"For behold! The storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed."
<cite>Gandalf, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.rulesText: The first player gains control of Frodo Baggins. Response: After Frodo Baggins is declared as a defender, spend 1 [fellowship] resource to reduce your threat by the attacking enemy’s [threat]. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot take damage. If Frodo Baggins leaves play, the players lose the game.
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Star-like Gem
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower]. If attached hero is a Hobbit, it does not exhaust to quest.
cards.flavor:
“When the memory of the fear and the darkness troubles you, this will bring you aid.”
—Arwen, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Bright Mail
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense] (+2 [defense] instead if attached hero is a Hobbit).
cards.flavor: “They wouldn’t go for armed folk, with swords and helmets and shields and all. Make them think twice, that would.” —Barliman Butterbur, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Scatha's Horn
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust Scatha’s Horn to choose an attacking enemy. Until the end of the phase, that enemy gets –1 [attack] (–2 [attack] instead if the defending character is a Hobbit hero).
cards.flavor: “He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies.” —Éowyn, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Heightened Stature
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 hit points (+3 hit points instead if attached hero is a Hobbit). Action: Exhaust Heightened Stature to heal 1 damage from attached hero.
cards.flavor:
“Mortals cannot go drinking ent-draughts and expect no more to come of them than of a pot of beer.”
—Gimli, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Into the West
cards.rulesText: Side A You cannot use this contract unless you have destroyed The One Ring and won The Scouring of the Shire in campaign mode. Your deck must contain an equal number of cards with a printed cost of 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. Setup: Search the top 10 cards of your deck for an ally with a printed cost of 3 or less and put it into play. Shuffle your deck and flip this card over. Side B Into the West is immune to the effects of other cards and cannot leave your control or leave play. Allies you play from your hand cannot have their cost reduced by more than 2. Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, attach Into the West to an ally you control, if able. Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, distribute X resources among heroes you control, where X is the attached card’s printed cost. Remove the attached card from the game and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: “I tried to save the Shire, and it has been saved, but not for me.” —Frodo Baggins, The Return of the King
cards.packName: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

printings.name: ALeP - The Scouring of the Shire

cards.name: Idraen
cards.rulesText: Response: After a location is explored, ready Idraen.
cards.flavor: "Where now are the Dúnedain, Elessar, Elessar? Why do thy kinsfolk wander afar?" <cite>Galadriel, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Rivendell Scout
cards.rulesText: Secrecy 2.
cards.flavor: "Elrond is sending Elves, and they will get in touch with the Rangers, and maybe with Thranduil's folk in Mirkwood." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Feigned Voices
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
cards.flavor: "The three of us could not challenge a hundred, so we went ahead and spoke with feigned voices, leading them on into the wood." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rúmil
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After you play Rúmil from your hand, choose an enemy engaged with a player. Deal X damage to that enemy where X is the number of ranged characters you control.
cards.flavor: ...the Company set out again, guided now by Haldir and his brother Rúmil. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elven Mail
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character. Attached character gets +2 hit points and gains sentinel.
cards.flavor: ...they were tall and and clad in grey mail, and from their shoulders hung long white cloaks. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Greyflood Wanderer
cards.rulesText: You may give Greyflood Wanderer doomed 2 when you play from your hand. If you do, it gains: "Response: After you play Greyflood Wanderer, place 1 progress token on each location in play."
cards.flavor: ...others had gone west, and with the help of Aragorn and the Rangers had searched the lands far down the Greyflood... <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Warden of Arnor
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Scout hero. While attached character is committed to the quest, place 1 progress on the first location revealed by the encounter deck each round.
cards.flavor: "I have had a hard life and a long: and the leagues that lie between here and Gondor are a small part in the count of my journeys." <cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Message from Elrond
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a player. That player may choose 1 card from his hand and add it to another player's hand. At the end of the round, if the chosen card is in that player's hand or in play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.
cards.flavor: "But we have heard rumours of your coming, for the messengers of Elrond passed by Lórien on the way home up the Dimrill Stair. <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Noiseless Movement
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an enemy in the staging area. That enemy does not make engagement checks this round. Then, if your threat is 20 or less and this is the first time you played a copy of Noiseless Movement this round, return this card to your hand instead of discarding it.
cards.flavor: ...the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Leaf Brooch
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero. Limit 1 per hero.
The first event card you play each round that matches attached hero's printed sphere gains secrecy 1.
cards.flavor: Each cloak was fastened about the neck with a brooch like a green leaf veined with silver. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Grimbeorn the Old
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After Grimbeorn the Old defends an attack, spend 1 resource from his pool to declare him as an attacker against that enemy (and resolve his attack). The defending enemy gets -2 [defense] for this attack.

cards.name: Guardian of Esgaroth
cards.rulesText: Guardian of Esgaroth gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense], and +1 hit point for each different player card attachment it has. (Limit +3 to each.)
cards.flavor: The men of the lake-town Esgaroth were mostly indoors, for the breeze was from the black East and chill, but a few were walking on the quays, and watching… <cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Squire's Helm
cards.rulesText:
Attach to an ally. Restricted.
Limit 1 per ally. 
Attached ally gets +2 hit points.
cards.flavor:
“There are no great weapon-hoards here, lord,” answered Éomer. “Maybe a light helm might be found to fit him...”
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Woodmen's Clearing
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Limit 1 per location. Response: When attached location leaves play as an explored location, the first player reduces his threat by 3.
cards.flavor:
In spite of the dangers of this far land bold men had of late been making their way back into it from the South, cutting down trees, and building themselves places to live...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: The Hidden Way
cards.rulesText: Response: At the beginning of the quest phase, search the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a location and make it the active location, returning any previous active location to the staging area. Then, reveal 1 less encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0). Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Beorning Skin-changer
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Choose a Beorning ally with printed cost 3 or more in your hand or discard pile. Discard Beorning Skin-changer to put that ally into play.
cards.flavor:
"...sometimes he is a huge black bear, sometimes he is a great strong black-haired man with huge arms and a great beard."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Beorn's Rage
cards.rulesText: Response: After a Beorning character is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy, that enemy gets -2 [attack] and -2 [defense] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
Swiftly he returned and his wrath was redoubled, so that nothing could withstand him, and no weapon seemed to bite upon him. 
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Long Lake Fisherman
cards.rulesText: Response: After Long Lake Fisherman enters play, name a number. Then, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a card whose printed cost is equal to that number and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Grey Cloak
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [spirit] or Scout character. Limit 1 per character. Encounter Action: Exhaust attached character and discard Grey Cloak to choose a non-unique enemy in the staging area. That enemy does not make engagement checks against you this phase.

cards.name: The Arkenstone
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy or location). Attach to a hero. Each unique character you control gains +1 [willpower]. Action: Reduce your threat by 2 to attach The Arkenstone to a hero controlled by another player and raise that player's threat by 2. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Brand son of Bain
cards.rulesText: Each Dale character you control with a player attachment gets +1 [willpower]. Response: After you play an attachment on a Dale character without an attachment, draw a card.
cards.flavor:
"He is a strong king, and his realm now reaches south and east of Esgaroth."
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Bard son of Brand
cards.rulesText: While playing an Item attachment, Bard son of Brand is considered to have the printed [leadership], [lore], and [tactics] icons. Response: When a character leaves play, return each attachment attached to that character to its owner's hand. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Redwater Sentry
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Armor attachments on Redwater Sentry by 1. Redwater Sentry gets +1 [defense] and gains Sentinel while it has an Armor attachment.

cards.name: North Realm Lookout
cards.rulesText: North Realm Lookout gets +1 [willpower] and does not exhaust to quest while it has an Item attachment
cards.flavor:
There were people on the look-out on the banks.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Warrior of Dale
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Weapon attachments on Warrior of Dale by 1. Warrior of Dale gets +1 [attack] and gains ranged while it has a Weapon attachment.

cards.name: Long Lake Trader
cards.rulesText: Action: Exhaust Long Lake Trader to move an Item attachment from a character you control to another eligible character.
cards.flavor:
"Nowhere are there any men so friendly to us as the Men of Dale"
<cite>Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Hauberk of Mail
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +1 [defense] (and +1 hit point if attached character has the sentinel keyword).
cards.flavor:
Each one of his folk was clad in a hauberk of steel mail that hung to his knees…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: King of Dale
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dale or Esgaroth hero. Planning Action: Exhaust King of Dale to reduce the cost of the next Dale ally you play this phase by 1 for each different player attachment on attached hero. That ally does not require a resource match.
cards.flavor:
Then Bard II, Brand's son, became King in Dale...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Bow of Yew
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dale or Warrior character. Restricted. Response: After attached character is declared as an attacker, exhaust Bow of Yew to deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
cards.flavor:
"They would shoot at us with their great bows of yew…"
<cite>The Lord of the Eagles, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Map of Rhovanion
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dale or Scout character. Limit 1 per character. Response: After attached character commits to the quest, place 1 progress on the active location.
cards.flavor:
"You are come to the very edge of the Wild..."
<cite>Gandalf, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Necklace of Girion
cards.rulesText:
Guarded (enemy or location).
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +2 [willpower] and collects an additional resource during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
...the necklace of Girion, Lord of Dale, made of five hundred emeralds green as grass, which he gave for the arming of his eldest son…
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Traffic from Dale
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Choose a Dale hero you control. Add 1 resource to its pool for each character you control with a player attachment. You can only play 1 copy of Traffic from Dale each round.
cards.flavor:
The talk was all of the trade that came and went on the waterways and the growth of the traffic on the river...
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: To Arms!
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose an ally with a player attachment. Ready that ally.
cards.flavor:
...the grim-voiced fellow ran hotfoot to the Master. “The dragon is coming or I am a fool!” he cried. “Cut the bridges! To arms! To arms!”
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Valour of the North
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character is declared as an attacker or defender against an enemy with an attachment, that character gets +3 [attack] and +3 [defense] until the end of this attack.
cards.flavor: "Dwarf-mail may be good, but they will soon be hard put to it." <cite>Bard the Bowman, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Bartering
cards.rulesText: Planning Action: Choose a ready player attachment on a character you control. Return that attachment to its owner’s hand to reduce the cost of the next attachment played this phase by X, where is the chosen attachment’s cost.

cards.name: Haldir of Lórien
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Combat Action: If you have not engaged an enemy this round, exhaust Haldir of Lórien to declare him as an attacker (and resolve his attack) against an enemy not engaged with you. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor: "We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith..." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Herald of Anórien
cards.rulesText: You may give Herald of Anórien doomed 2 when you play it from your hand. If you do, it gains: "Response: After you play Herald of Anórien, choose a player. That player may put into play 1 ally from his hand with a printed cost 2 or lower."
cards.flavor: "Send the heralds forth! Let them summon all who dwell nigh!" <cite>Théoden, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: O Lórien!
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Action: Exhaust O Lórien! to lower the cost of the next Silvan ally played this phase by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
cards.flavor:
"I sang of leaves, of leaves of gold, and
leaves of gold there grew:
Of wind I sang, a wind there came and in the
branches blew." <cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Gwaihir
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Response: After Gwaihir enters play, search your discard pile for an Eagle ally and put it into play under your control. At the end of the round, if that ally is still in play, add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: "The North Wind blows, but we shall outfly it." <cite>Gwaihir, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Pursuing the Enemy
cards.rulesText: Action: Return a Silvan ally you control to your hand to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
cards.flavor: The marauding orcs had been waylaid and almost all destroyed; the remnant had fled westward towards the mountains, and were being pursued. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Courage Awakened
cards.rulesText: Action: Choose a hero. That hero gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase. Then, if your threat is 20 or less and this is the first time you played a copy of Courage Awakened this round, return this card to your hand instead of discarding it.
cards.flavor: But the courage that had been awakened in him was now too strong: he could not leave his friends so easily. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Free to Choose
cards.rulesText: Response: After your threat is raised by an encounter card effect, reduce your threat by an equal amount.
cards.flavor: Suddenly he was aware of himself again. Frodo, neither the Voice nor the Eye; free to choose, and with one remaining instant in which to do so. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Galadhrim Minstrel
cards.rulesText: Response: After Galadhrim Minstrel enters play, search the top five cards of your deck for an event card and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: ...the language was that of Elven-song and spoke of things little known on Middle-earth. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lembas
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Noldor or Silvan hero. Attach to a hero. Action: Discard Lembas to ready attached hero and heal 3 damage from it.
cards.flavor: "...it is more strengthing than any food made by Men, and it is more pleasant than cram, by all accounts. <cite>Lórien Elf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Defender of the Naith
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After a Silvan ally you control leaves play, ready Defender of the Naith.
cards.flavor: "We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going North toward Moria..." <cite>Haldir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lanwyn
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After an encounter card with surge is revealed, either ready Lanwyn or give her +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase. (Limit twice per phase.)
cards.flavor: "The Men of Dale used to have the trick of understanding their language, and used them for messengers to fly to the Men of the Lake..." <cite>Thorin, The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Eldahir
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Action: Spend 1 [lore] resource to look at a facedown shadow card dealt to an engaged enemy. If that card has a shadow effect, Eldahir gets +2 [defense] until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Captain's Wisdom
cards.rulesText: Resource Action: Exhaust a Noble hero you control to add 2 resources to that hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor:
...in these days men are slow to believe that a captain can be wise and learned in the scrolls of lore and song, as he is, and yet man of hardihood and swift judgement in the field.
<cite>Beregond, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Master Ironsmith
cards.rulesText: Response: After you play Master Ironsmith from your hand, if you paid all of its resource cost from a single hero's resource pool, attach a Weapon or Armor attachment from your hand or discard pile to that hero without paying its resource cost.

cards.name: Raiment of War
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Warrior character. Raiment of War counts as 2 Restricted attachments. Attached character gets +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and +2 hit points.
cards.flavor:
Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard...
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Sam Gamgee
cards.rulesText: Reduce the cost to play Sam Gamgee by 2 if you control Frodo Baggins. Response: After a player raises his threat, that player may spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Sam Gamgee. He gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Elevenses
cards.rulesText: Play only after the staging step. Quest Action: Choose X questing Hobbit characters you control. Ready each chosen character and remove them from the quest. Then, reduce your threat by X.
cards.flavor:
"The road goes on for ever," said Pippin; "but I can't without a rest. It is high time for lunch."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Mirkwood Explorer
cards.rulesText: Response: After Mirkwood Explorer quests successfully, place 1 progress on it. Action: Exhaust Mirkwood Explorer to move all progress from it to a location in play.

cards.name: Guarded Ceaselessly
cards.rulesText: Attach to a location. Action: Exhaust a Ranger or Scout character to give attached location -2 [threat] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
"In this high play you may see the two powers that are opposed to one another; and ever they strive now in thought..."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Erestor
cards.rulesText:
Draw 3 additional cards at the beginning of the resource phase.
At the end of the round, discard all cards in your hand.
cards.flavor:
"That is the path of despair. Of folly, I would say, if the long wisdom of Elrond did not forbid me."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.rulesText: You must spend resources from 3 different heroes' resource pools to play this card. Action: The players, as a group, can put up to 2 allies into play from their hands. Each of these allies may enter play under any player's control. At the end of the phase, return each of those allies that are still in play to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Send for Aid
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, each player may search the top 10 cards of his deck for an ally and put it into play under his control. Each player who did shuffles his deck.
cards.flavor:
"Often the Rohirrim have aided us, but now the Lord Denethor asks for all your strength and all your speed..."
<cite>Hirgon, The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Elven Spear
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero. Restricted. Action: Discard a card from your hand to give attached hero +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. Limit 3 times per phase.
cards.flavor:
Their spears and swords shone in the gloom with a gleam of chill flame, so deadly was the wrath of the hands that held them.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Horn's Cry
cards.rulesText: Action: All enemies get -1 [attack] until the end of the phase. Valour Action: Choose a player. Each enemy engaged with that player gets -3 [attack] until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor:
Loud the challenge rang and bellowed, like the shout of many throats under the cavernous roof.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Galadhrim Weaver
cards.rulesText: Cannot attack or defend. Response: After Galadhrim Weaver enters play, shuffle the top card of your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "You are indeed high in the favour of the Lady! For she herself and her maidens wove this..." <cite>Lórien Elf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Silver Harp
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a [spirit] hero. Response: After a card is discarded from your hand, exhaust Silver Harp to return that card to your hand.
cards.flavor: Elrond wore a mantle of grey and had a star upon his forehead, and a silver harp was in his hand... <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Galdor of the Havens
cards.rulesText: Response: After 1 or more cards are discarded from your hand, draw 1 card. Limit once per round.
cards.flavor:
"But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy, the coming of Sauron at the last, when all else is overthrown?"
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Door is Closed!
cards.rulesText: Response: After an encounter card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its effects and discard it if there is a card with the same title in the victory display.
cards.flavor:
"...I perceive the Dark Lord and know his mind, or all of his mind that concerns the Elves. And he gropes ever to see me and my thought. But still the door is closed!"
<cite>Galadriel, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elf-friend
cards.rulesText: Attach to a character. Attached character gains the Noldor and Silvan traits.
cards.flavor:
"I name you Elf-friend; and may the stars shine upon the end of your road!"
<cite>Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: The first player gains control of Aragorn. If Aragorn leaves play, the players lose the game. Action: Spend 2 resources from Aragorn's resource pool to ready a hero.
cards.flavor:
"I am Aragorn son of Arathorn and am called Elessar, the Elfstone, Dunadan, the heir of Isildur Elendil’s son of Gondor."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Théoden
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Reduce the cost of the first Rohan ally you play from your hand each round by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
cards.flavor: "Arise now, arise, Riders of Théoden!" <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Treebeard
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Action: Deal 1 damage to Treebeard to give him +1 [willpower] and +1 [attack] until the end of the phase. (Limit 5 times per phase.)
cards.flavor:
"I am not altogether on anybody's side, because nobody is altogether on my side..."
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Gimli
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Response: After an enemy is revealed from the encounter deck, ready Gimli.
cards.flavor:
"Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!"
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Legolas
cards.rulesText: Ranged. Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "He stands not alone," said Legolas, bending his bow and fitting an arrow with hands that moved quicker than sight. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Quickbeam
cards.rulesText: Cannot have restricted attachments. Enters play exhausted. Response: After Quickbeam enters play, deal 1 damage to him to ready him.
cards.flavor: "I am Bregalad, that is Quickbeam in your language. But it is only a nickname, of course." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Háma
cards.rulesText: Combat Action: Ready Háma. He gets +3 [defense] until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase, discard Háma. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I am the Doorward of Théoden," he said. "Háma is my name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Arod
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero or Legolas. Response: After attached character participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, exhaust Arod to place 1 progress token on any location.
cards.flavor: "A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery, was brought to Legolas. Arod was his name." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Ent Draught
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Attach to a character. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gets +2 hit points.
cards.flavor: The effect of the draught began at the toes, and rose steadily through every limb, bringing refreshment and vigour as it coursed upwards, right to the tips of the hair. <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Herugrim
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Rohan hero. Restricted. Reduce the cost to play Herugrim on Théoden by 1. Response: After attached hero is declared as an attacker, exhaust Herugrim to add attached hero's [willpower] to its [attack] for this attack.
cards.flavor: "Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade." <cite>Háma, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Entmoot
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control at least 1 Ent character. Action: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for any number of Ent cards and add them to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor: "...it is a gathering of Ents - which does not often happen nowadays." <cite>Treebeard, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Helm! Helm!
cards.rulesText: Play only after the resolving enemy attacks step is complete. Combat Action: Exhaust and discard a Rohan ally you control to choose and discard a non-unique enemy engaged with you.
cards.flavor: "Helm is arisen and comes back to war. Helm for Théoden King!" <cite>Riders of Rohan, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: The Three Hunters
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control [fellowship] Aragorn. Quest Action: Choose 3 heroes committed to the quest. Ready those heroes. Until the end of the round, each of the chosen heroes gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense].
