cards.flavor: "We shall makes such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men. Forth the Three Hunters!" <cite>Aragorn, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Shadowfax
cards.rulesText: Attach to Gandalf. Gandalf gains ranged and sentinel. Action: Exhaust Shadowfax to ready Gandalf.
cards.flavor: "He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses, and not even Théoden, King of Rohan, has ever looked on a better." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Intimidation
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Warrior hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as the only attacker against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Intimidation to give that enemy -2 [defense] for this attack.
cards.flavor: "None knows what the new day shall bring him," said Aragorn. "Get you gone, ere it turn to your evil!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

cards.name: Hands of a Healer
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Healer hero. Action: Exhaust attached hero and Hands of a Healer to heal up to 3 damage from a hero.
cards.flavor:
"Life to the dying
  In the king"s hand lying!"
  -Herb-master, The Return of the King

cards.name: Forewarned
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Ranger hero. Response: After attached hero is declared as a defender against a non-unique enemy, exhaust Forewarned to discard 1 shadow card from that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Faint and far are the feet of our enemies." -Aragorn, The Two Towers

cards.name: Leader of Men
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a Noble hero. Response: After attached hero quests successfully, exhaust Leader of Men to add 1 resource to attached hero's pool.
cards.flavor: "Take this, dear lord!" said a clear voice. "It was ever at your service." -The Two Towers

cards.name: Beyond All Hope
cards.rulesText: Permanent. Setup: Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +1 [willpower], +1 [attack], +1 [defense] and cannot have treachery card attachments.
cards.flavor: "Beyond all hope you return to us in our need!" -Aragorn, The Two Towers

cards.name: Palantír of Orthanc
cards.rulesText: Attach to [fellowship] Aragorn. Quest Action: Exhaust Aragorn and Palantír of Orthanc to discard the top card of the encounter deck. If Aragorn's [willpower] is greater than the discarded card's [threat], you may add Palantír of Orthanc to the victory display and remove it from the campaign pool to choose a player. That player reveals 1 fewer encounter card this phase (to a minimum of 0).

cards.name: Poisoned Counsels
cards.rulesText: Poisoned Counsels functions like a player card. Forced: After you draw this card, discard all other cards in your hand.
cards.flavor: "And ever Wormtongue's whispering was in your ears, poisoning your thought, chilling your heart, weakening your limbs..." –Gandalf, The Two Towers

cards.name: Saruman's Voice
cards.rulesText: Peril. Doomed 2. When Revealed: Remove a hero from the quest and attach Saruman's Voice to that hero. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: When attached hero commits to the quest, is declared as an attacker or defender, or triggers its ability, its controller must discard 1 card from his hand.")

cards.name: Elfhelm
cards.rulesText: Each [spirit] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [willpower]. Each [tactics] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [attack]. Each [leadership] hero with an attached Mount gets +1 [defense].
cards.flavor: Ahead nearer the walls Elfhelm's men were among the siege-engines, hewing, slaying, driving their foes into the fire-pits. <cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Ceorl
cards.rulesText: Spend 1 [spirit] resource to ready Ceorl. Then, you may give control of Ceorl to another player. Any player may trigger this action. (Limit once per phase).
cards.flavor:
He drew himself up. Then he knelt, offering his notched sword to the king. "Command me, lord!" he cried. 
<cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Armored Destrier
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [leadership] or sentinel hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero defends against an attack, exhaust Armored Destrier to ready attached hero. Then, discard a shadow card from another enemy engaged with the defending player.

cards.name: Déorwine
cards.rulesText:
Sentinel.
While Déorwine is defending, he gains: “Response: Spend 1 [leadership] resource to cancel a shadow effect just triggered. Any player may trigger this response.”

cards.name: Revealed in Wrath
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Noldor hero. Action: Choose a non-unique enemy. Until the end of the phase, treat the chosen enemy's printed text box as if it were blank (except for Traits).
cards.flavor: "…seeing an Elf-lord revealed in his wrath, they were dismayed, and their horses were stricken with madness." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rhovanion Outrider
cards.rulesText: Response: After Rhovanion Outrider commits to the quest, place 1 progress on a location in the staging area. If that location is not explored by this effect, give Rhovanion Outrider +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Scouting Party
cards.rulesText: Response: After you commit characters to the quest, if each character you have committed to the quest is a Scout, each of those characters gets +2 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Entangling Nets
cards.rulesText:
Play Entangling Nets into the staging area unattached.
If unattached, attach Entangling Nets to the next eligible enemy that enters the staging area.
Attached enemy gets –2 [attack] and –2 [defense].

cards.name: Arrows from the Trees
cards.rulesText: Play only after making engagement checks. Encounter Action: If no enemies were engaged this phase, deal 1 damage to each enemy in the staging area. Then, the players as a group may spend 3 [tactics] resources to deal 2 additional damage to each enemy in the staging area.

cards.name: Ered Luin Miner
cards.rulesText: Response: After Ered Luin Miner is discarded from your deck, put it into play under your control.
cards.flavor:
Tools were to be found in plenty that the miners and quarriers and builders of old had used; and at such work the dwarves were still very skilled.
<cite>The Hobbit</cite>

cards.name: Wandering Exile
cards.rulesText: Response: After Wandering Exile commits to a quest, discard a card from your hand to ready Wandering Exile.
cards.flavor:
"The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows...
-Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Valiant Sword
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a Noble hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] if your threat is 40 or higher).
cards.flavor:
...his sword of steel was valiant...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Stone of Elostirion
cards.rulesText:
Guarded (location). Restricted.
Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 [willpower]. You draw 1 additional card during the resource phase.
cards.flavor:
Looking up he saw before him a tall white tower, standing alone on a high ridge. A great desire came over him to climb the tower and see the Sea.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Well Preserved
cards.rulesText: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets + 1 hit point. Response: At the beginning of the round, exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to heal all damage from attached hero.

cards.name: Northern Bowmaster
cards.rulesText:
Ranged.
You cannot play Northern Bowmaster from your hand unless you are engaged with an enemy.

cards.name: Reckless Attack
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Action: Each player deals 2 damage to an enemy engaged with him.
cards.flavor:
Down, heedless of order, rushed all the dwarves of Dain to his help.
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Odo Proudfoot
cards.rulesText: Response: After Odo Proudfoot enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Hobbit ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
cards.flavor:
"ProudFEET! shouted an elderly hobbit from the back of the pavilion.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Defiant Challenge
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may ready a character he controls.
cards.flavor:
"Go back to the Shadow!"
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Helm of Secrecy
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Action: Choose a hero you control and discard all tokens from it. Select a different non-[fellowship], non-[baggins] hero from your collection with a threat cost less than or equal to the chosen hero. Swap those heroes, moving all eligible attachments to the hero from your collection.

cards.name: Council of the Wise
cards.rulesText: You cannot include more than 1 copy of a card, by title, in your deck. Response: After you play an event from your hand, choose one: reduce your threat by 1, draw 1 card, or add 1 resource to your hero's resource pool. You can only choose each option once per round.
cards.flavor:
"I must go to this lords" council and learn what I can."
-Gandalf, The Return of the King

cards.name: Éomer
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character leaves play, Éomer gets +2 [attack] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I am named Éomer son of Éomund, and am called the Third Marshal of Riddermark." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Gríma
cards.rulesText: Action: Lower the cost of the next card you play from your hand this round by 1. That card gains Doomed 1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things till your return – and I pray that we may see it, though no wise man will deem it hopeful." <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Saruman
cards.rulesText: Doomed 3. At the end of the round, discard Saruman from play. Response: After Saruman enters play, choose a non-unique enemy or location in the staging area. While Saruman is in play, the chosen enemy or location is considered to be out of play.

cards.name: Orthanc Guard
cards.rulesText: Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, ready Orthanc Guard.
cards.flavor: "...the keepers of the gate were on the watch for me and told me that Saruman awaited me." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Isengard Messenger
cards.rulesText: Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, Isengard Messenger gets +1 [willpower] until the end of the round. (Limit twice per round.)
cards.flavor: "I have an urgent errand," he said. "My news is evil." <cite>Radagast, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Westfold Outrider
cards.rulesText: Action: Discard Westfold Outrider to choose an enemy not engaged with you. Engage the chosen enemy.
cards.flavor: "Erkenbrand of Westfold has drawn off those men he could gather towards his fastness at Helm's Deep. The rest are scattered." <cite>Rider of Rohan, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Westfold Horse-breeder
cards.rulesText: Response: After Westfold Horse-breeder enters play, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a Mount attachment and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "They love their horses next to their kin." <cite>Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Rohan Warhorse
cards.rulesText: Attach to a [tactics] or Rohan hero. Restricted. Response: After attached hero participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, exhaust Rohan Warhorse to ready attached hero.
cards.flavor: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Silver Lamp
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a [spirit] hero.
While attached hero is ready, shadow cards dealt to enemies engaged with you are dealt face up. (Shadow card effects are still resolved when resolving enemy attacks.)
cards.flavor: ...one of them uncovered a small lamp that gave out a slender silver beam. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Keys of Orthanc
cards.rulesText: Attach to a hero. Response: After you raise your threat from the Doomed keyword, exhaust Keys of Orthanc to add 1 resource to attached hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "He has the Key of Orthanc" <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Legacy of Númenor
cards.rulesText: Doomed 4. Action: Add 1 resource to each hero's resource pool.
cards.flavor: "...in the midst of that valley is a tower of stone called Orthanc. It was not made by Saruman, but by the Men of Númenor long ago: and it is very tall and has many secrets..." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Deep Knowledge
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Action: Each player draws 2 cards.
cards.flavor: "His knowledge is deep, but his pride has grown with it..." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Wizards's Voice
cards.rulesText: Doomed 3. Action: Each player chooses 1 enemy engaged with him. Until the end of the phase, each chosen enemy cannot attack the player that chose it.
cards.flavor: ...it was a delight to hear the voice speaking, all that it said seemed wise and reasonable... <cite>The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Power of Orthanc
cards.rulesText: Doomed 2. Action: Each player may choose and discard a Condition attachment from play.
cards.flavor: "But Saruman has long studied the arts of the Enemy himself, and thus we have often been able to forestall him." <cite>Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: The Seeing-stone
cards.rulesText: Doomed 1. Action: Search your deck for a card with the Doomed keyword and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "...alone it could do nothing but see small images of things far off and days remote." <cite>Gandalf, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Soldier of Gondor
cards.rulesText: Response: After Soldier of Gondor enters play, search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Gondor ally and add it to your hand (any number of Gondor allies instead if your threat is 40 or higher). Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Pillars of the Kings
cards.rulesText: While your threat is less than 40, reduce the cost to play Pillars of the Kings by 4. Action: Set your threat to 40. If this effect raised your threat, draw a card (draw 4 cards instead if it raised your threat by 10 or more).
cards.flavor:
"Behold the Argonath, the Pillars of the Kings!"
-Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Cautious Halfling
cards.rulesText: Response: After Cautious Halfling enters play, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is not an enemy, draw a card.
cards.flavor:
"I thought I had been both careful and clever."
-Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Tom Bombadillo!
cards.rulesText: Play only if you control a Hobbit hero. You cannot play this card if there is a copy of Tom Bombadillo! in the victory display. Planning Action: Add Tom Bombadillo the the victory display to shuffle a set-aside copy of Tom Bombadil into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Durin's Axe
cards.rulesText: Guarded (enemy). Restricted. Guarded (enemy). Restricted. Attach to a hero. Attached hero gets +2 [attack]. Response: After attach hero attacks and destroys an enemy, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you.

cards.name: Charge into Battle
cards.rulesText: Play only after staging step. Quest Action: You may declare and resolve an attack against each non-unique enemy in the staging are as if it were engaged with you.
cards.flavor:
Panic came upon the Goblins; and even as they turned to meet this new attack, the elves charged again with renewed numbers.
-The Hobbit

cards.name: Silver Circlet
cards.rulesText: Restricted. Attach to a [spirit] hero. Limit 1 per hero. Restricted. Attached hero gets +2 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
His hair was dark as the shadows of twilight, and upon it was set a circlet of silver...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

cards.name: Inner Strength
cards.rulesText: Attach to the hero with The One Ring. Limit 1 per hero. Attached hero gets +1 [defense]. Response: Exhaust The One Ring and raise your threat by 1 to cancel a shadow effect just triggered during an attack that attached hero is defending.

cards.name: Tom Bombadil
cards.rulesText: Encounter. When Revealed: Choose a player. That player gains control of Tom Bombadil, ready and committed to the quest. At the end of the round, remove Tom Bombadil and a copy of Tom Bombadillo! in the victory display from the game. This effect cannot be cancelled.

cards.name: The Burglar's Turn
cards.rulesText: Side A You cannot include attachments in your deck. Setup: Choose 14 different Item or Artifact attachments from your collection and shuffle them together. This is your loot deck. Flip this card over and place your loot deck facedown under it. Side B The active location gets +1 quest point for each attachment attached to it. Forced: After you travel to a location, attach the top card of your loot deck faceup to that location as a guarded objective. If that attachment has the guarded X keyword, ignore it. Forced: When the active location is explored, you may put each guarded attachment on that location into play at no cost, or add it to your hand.
cards.flavor:
"And I assure you there is a mark on this door - the usual one in the trade, or used to be. Burglar wants a good job, plenty of Excitement and reasonably Reward, that"s how it is usually read.
-Glóin, The Hobbit

cards.name: Aragorn
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Refresh Action: Reduce your threat to your starting threat level. (Limit once per game.)
cards.flavor:
"I am older than I look, I might prove useful."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Grave Cairn
cards.rulesText: Response: After a character leaves play, add its [attack] to another character's [attack] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
"We have not the time or the tools to bury our comrade fitly, or to raise a mound up over him. A cairn we might build."
<cite>Legolas, The Two Towers</cite>

cards.name: Sword that was Broken
cards.rulesText:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a [leadership] resource icon.
If attached hero is Aragorn, each character you control gets +1 [willpower].
cards.flavor:
"For the Sword that was Broken is the Sword of Elendil that broke beneath him when he fell."
<cite>Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Watcher of the Bruinen
cards.rulesText: Sentinel. Watcher of the Bruinen does not exhaust to defend. Forced: After Watcher of the Bruinen defends, either discard it from play or discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Rivendell Bow
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Noldor or Silvan character, or to Aragorn. Limit 1 per character. Attached character gains ranged. If attached character has the printed ranged keyword, it gets +1 [attack] during a ranged attack.

cards.name: Arwen Undómiel
cards.rulesText: Response: After Arwen Undómiel exhausts, choose a character. That character gains sentinel and gets +1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.flavor:
...in whom it was said that the likeness of Lúthien had come on earth again...for she was the Evenstar of her people.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Elrond's Counsel
cards.rulesText: Action: If you control a unique Noldor character, give another character +1 [willpower] until the end of the phase and lower your threat by 3.
cards.flavor:
"Believe rather that it is so ordered that we, who sit here, and none others, must now find counsel for the peril of the world."
<cite>Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Short Cut
cards.rulesText: Response: After a location enters play, exhaust a Hobbit character to shuffle that location back into the encounter deck. Then, reveal 1 card from the encounter deck and add it to the staging area.
cards.flavor:
"I suppose we haven't lost more than two days by my short cut through the Forest!"
<cite>Frodo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Legacy of Durin
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Dwarf hero. Response: After you play a Dwarf character from your hand, exhaust Legacy of Durin to draw 1 card.

cards.name: Resourceful
cards.rulesText:
Secrecy 3.
Attach to a hero you control.
Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during the resource phase each round.

cards.name: Merry
cards.rulesText: Response: After an enemy is revealed from the top of the encounter deck, exhaust Merry to reduce your threat by that enemy's [threat].
cards.flavor:
"We have come a long way with you and been through some stiff times. We want to go on."
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ingold
cards.rulesText: Ingold gets +1 [willpower] for each hero you control with at least 1 resource in its resource pool.
cards.flavor:
"We wish for no strangers in the land at this time, unless they be mighty men of arms in whose faith and help we can trust."
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.rulesText: Response: After an ally leaves play, add it to its owner's hand instead of placing it in the discard pile. Valour Action: Until the end of the phase, add each ally that leaves play to its owner's hand instead of placing it in the discard pile.
cards.flavor:
He let blow the horns to rally all men to his banner that could come thither...
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Honour Guard
cards.rulesText: Response: Exhaust Honour Guard to cancel 1 point of damage just dealt to a character. Valour Response: Exhaust and discard Honour Guard to cancel up to 5 damage just dealt to a character.

cards.name: Raven-winged Helm
cards.rulesText: Attach a hero with Sentinel. Limit 1 per hero. Response: Exhaust Raven-winged Helm to prevent 1 point of damage just dealt to attached character.
cards.flavor:
He had a small hauberk, its rings of forged of steel, maybe, yet black as jet; and a high-crowned helm with small raven-wings on either side, set with a silver star in the centre of the circlet.
<cite>The Return of the King</cite>

cards.name: Curious Brandybuck
cards.rulesText: Forced: After the active location is explored, place Curious Brandybuck on the bottom of its owner's deck. Response: After you travel to a location, put Curious Brandybuck into play from your hand, under any player's control.

cards.name: Hobbit Pony
cards.rulesText: Attach to a Hobbit hero. Restricted. Quest Action: If attached hero is not committed to the quest, exhaust Hobbit Pony and attached hero to commit attached hero to the quest.
cards.flavor:
He was riding a pony, and a scarf was swathed round his neck and over his chin to keep out the fog.
<cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: East Road Ranger
cards.rulesText: East Road Ranger gets +2 [willpower] while committed to a side quest.
cards.flavor:
"If you bring a Ranger with you, it is well to pay attention to him..."
<cite>Gandalf, the Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Scout Ahead
cards.rulesText: Limit 1 per deck. Response: When this stage is defeated, the first player searches the top X cards of the encounter deck for 1 non-objective card worth no victory points and adds it to the victory display. Put the remaining cards back in any order. X is the number of players in the game plus 4.
cards.flavor: Strider made them take cover in a thicket at the side of the Road, while he went forward to explore. <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Ranger of Cardolan
cards.rulesText: Response: After you engage an enemy, if you control at least 1 Dúnedain hero, spend 1 resource to put Ranger of Cardolan into play from your hand, under your control. At the end of the round, if Ranger of Cardolan is still in play, shuffle it into its owner's deck.
